title_zh: 透气可拉伸纳米级各向异性导电膜用于室温无压互连
summary_zh: 该研究报道一种约300纳米厚的超薄各向异性导电膜，由银纳米线图案化圆盘与苯乙烯-乙烯-丁烯-苯乙烯嵌段共聚物复合而成，可在室温无压条件下实现保形粘附，兼具超过500%的拉伸性和高透气性，用于器件与皮肤及器件间互连。
research_details_zh: 随着可拉伸电子向可穿戴和软体机器人发展，互连技术需同时满足薄型化、可拉伸、透气及无损键合等要求，而传统方法受厚度、低透气性和苛刻键合条件限制。本研究提出一种纳米级各向异性导电膜，由银纳米线图案化圆盘渗入苯乙烯-乙烯-丁烯-苯乙烯嵌段共聚物构成。所得薄膜厚度约300纳米，机械与电学拉伸性超过500%应变，水蒸气透过率为1200克每平方米每天。基于液体挥发的键合工艺无需加热或外部压力即可与不平整表面保形粘附，实现器件-皮肤和器件-器件互连。使用该膜集成的可拉伸布线发光二极管在500%应变下仍保持导电和线间绝缘。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报道：采用银纳米线图案化圆盘渗入苯乙烯-乙烯-丁烯-苯乙烯嵌段共聚物制备纳米级各向异性导电膜；通过液体挥发驱动的键合工艺实现室温无压保形粘附；评估了薄膜厚度、机械与电学拉伸性、水蒸气透过率，并测试了集成可拉伸布线发光二极管在500%应变下的导电与绝缘性能。其他合成与表征细节摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该工作属于自组装与导电复合材料交叉方向，对可拉伸电子互连有实际价值，但其材料体系为银纳米线/嵌段共聚物复合膜，并非介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或介孔材料。与框架材料组装和电化学合成主线关联有限，可作为柔性互连与透气导电复合材料的拓展参考，是否精读取决于对可拉伸电子互连的兴趣。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征、数值、机制或结论。银纳米线尺寸、图案化方法、共聚物比例、键合工艺参数、电导率、循环稳定性及器件长期可靠性等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 所制纳米级各向异性导电膜厚度约300纳米，机械与电学拉伸性超过500%应变。
水蒸气透过率达到1200克每平方米每天。
基于液体挥发的键合工艺无需热或外部压力即可实现保形粘附。
使用该膜集成的可拉伸布线发光二极管在500%应变下仍保持导电和线间绝缘。

title: Modulating Sulfur Release Kinetics through Precursor Engineering for the Controlled Formation of 1 T /2H MoS2 Hybrids with Enhanced Charge Storage Properties
abstract: Abstract Molybdenum disulfide (MoS2) is a promising electrode material for electrochemical energy storage; however, its practical application is limited by the poor electrical conductivity of the thermodynamically stable 2H phase and the difficulty of achieving conductive 1T-rich structures through simple and scalable synthesis routes. In this work, a dual sulfur precursor strategy employing thioacetamide and thiourea was developed to regulate sulfur-release kinetics during hydrothermal synthesis, thereby controlling the phase evolution, microstructure, and electrochemical properties of MoS2. Structural characterization using X-ray diffraction, Raman spectroscopy, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, and transmission electron microscopy confirmed the formation of a mixed 1T/2H MoS2 hybrid containing approximately 39% metallic 1T phase at optimized precursor ratios. The dual precursor approach promoted enlarged interlayer spacing, hierarchical nanosheet assembly, and increased surface area (81 m2 g–1), resulting in a substantial enhancement in electrical conductivity from 4.5 × 10–5 to 1.3 × 10–1 S cm–1. The optimized 1T/2H hybrid delivered a specific capacitance of 353.8 F g–1 in 1 M H2SO4 and 89.4 F g–1 in 1 M KOH at a current density of 1 A g–1. Furthermore, an asymmetric supercapacitor assembled using the optimized material exhibited a capacitance of 309 F g–1, an energy density of 51.9 Wh kg–1, and a power density of 550 W kg–1, while retaining 94% of its initial capacitance after 10,000 charge–discharge cycles. These findings demonstrate that dual-sulfur precursor engineering provides a simple and effective route to tailoring phase composition, conductivity, and porous architecture in hydrothermally synthesized MoS2, for high-performance supercapacitor electrodes.

title_zh: 通过前驱体工程调控硫释放动力学以可控形成1T/2H MoS2杂化材料并增强电荷存储性能
summary_zh: 该研究采用硫代乙酰胺和硫脲双硫前驱体策略，在水热合成中调控硫释放动力学，控制MoS2的相演化、微结构和电化学性能。优化前驱体比例下形成含约39%金属性1T相的1T/2H MoS2杂化材料，电导率从4.5×10−5提升至1.3×10−1 S cm−1，在1 M H2SO4中比电容达353.8 F g−1。
research_details_zh: 二硫化钼是电化学储能的有前景电极材料，但热力学稳定的2H相电导率差，且通过简单可扩展路线获得富1T导电结构困难。本文开发硫代乙酰胺和硫脲双硫前驱体策略，在水热合成中调节硫释放动力学，从而控制MoS2的相演化、微结构和电化学性能。X射线衍射、拉曼光谱、X射线光电子能谱和透射电子显微镜确认，在优化前驱体比例下形成含约39%金属性1T相的1T/2H MoS2杂化材料。双前驱体方法促进层间距扩大、分级纳米片组装和比表面积增加至81 m2 g−1，电导率从4.5×10−5显著提升至1.3×10−1 S cm−1。优化杂化材料在1 M H2SO4和1 M KOH中于1 A g−1下比电容分别为353.8和89.4 F g−1。组装的非对称超级电容器电容为309 F g−1，能量密度51.9 Wh kg−1，功率密度550 W kg−1，10 000次充放电循环后保留94%初始电容。
methods_zh: 采用硫代乙酰胺和硫脲双硫前驱体进行水热合成，通过调节前驱体比例调控硫释放动力学。使用X射线衍射、拉曼光谱、X射线光电子能谱和透射电子显微镜表征相组成、微结构和形貌。测试电导率、比表面积及在1 M H2SO4和1 M KOH中的电化学性能，并组装非对称超级电容器进行循环测试。摘要未报告具体水热温度、时间及前驱体比例等细节。
relevance_zh: 该工作属于二维硫化物电极材料的相工程与电荷存储研究，与介孔导电MOF、共轭框架材料及框架组装主线关联较弱，但其中前驱体调控相演化和分级纳米片组装的思路对介孔材料合成有一定借鉴意义。可作为拓展阅读，不建议作为核心精读。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体水热温度、时间、前驱体比例、电解液测试条件细节及循环稳定性测试参数等关键信息，需查阅全文核实。

双前驱体方法促进层间距扩大、分级纳米片组装，比表面积达81 m2 g−1，电导率从4.5×10−5提升至1.3×10−1 S cm−1。
优化材料在1 M H2SO4和1 M KOH中于1 A g−1下比电容分别为353.8和89.4 F g−1。
非对称超级电容器电容309 F g−1，能量密度51.9 Wh kg−1，功率密度550 W kg−1，10 000次循环后保留94%初始电容。

title: Beyond Symmetric Motifs: Asymmetric Small-Molecule Recognition Directs a New Poly(adenine) Assembly
abstract: Abstract DNA/small-molecule hybrid materials provide a powerful route to reprogram nucleic acid structures without covalent modification. However, to date only two small molecules have been shown to direct such assemblies, both relying on symmetric hydrogen-bonding faces. Here, we report that 3-methylxanthine (3MeX), a purine-derived molecule with nonequivalent hydrogen-bonding faces, directs the assembly of poly(deoxyadenylic) acid into a new, cooperative arrangement. Through preorganization experiments, systematic modification of small-molecule binding faces, nucleobase engineering, and molecular dynamics simulations, we characterize key hydrogen-bonding interactions governing this structure. We propose a model in which two poly(deoxyadenylic) acid strands associate in an antiparallel arrangement, held together by hydrogen-bonded quartets, each comprising two adenine bases and two 3MeX molecules, similar to the G-quartets of G-quadruplex structures. The assembly exhibits pronounced thermal hysteresis consistent with a cooperative, nucleation–growth mechanism, and forms from a pharmacologically relevant molecule whereby the recognition process is exquisitely sensitive to small-molecule structure. This work establishes a new interaction motif in DNA/small-molecule hybrids, in which asymmetric, multi-face recognition enables new, directional assemblies of unmodified nucleic acids. We show that this interaction can be integrated into DNA nanotechnology to enable small-molecule-triggered dimerization, and higher-order polymerization of DNA nanostructures. The accessibility of this motif under neutral conditions, together with its tolerance to small-molecule modification, points to potential applications in programmable nanomaterials, and nucleic acid–based systems that interface with biological environments.

title_zh: 超越对称基序：不对称小分子识别导向新型聚腺嘌呤组装
summary_zh: 该研究报道3-甲基黄嘌呤这一具有非等价氢键面的嘌呤衍生小分子可导向聚脱氧腺苷酸组装成新型协同排列。通过预组织实验、小分子结合面系统修饰、核碱基工程和分子动力学模拟表征关键氢键相互作用，提出两条反平行链由氢键四联体连接、每个四联体含两个腺嘌呤和两个3MeX的模型。
research_details_zh: 研究问题是如何突破现有仅依赖对称氢键面的两种小分子导向DNA组装的限制，利用不对称小分子识别实现未修饰核酸的新定向组装。材料体系为聚脱氧腺苷酸与3-甲基黄嘌呤构成的DNA/小分子杂化材料。设计策略是利用3MeX具有非等价氢键面这一不对称多面识别特征，导向聚脱氧腺苷酸形成新的协同排列。研究过程包括预组织实验、小分子结合面的系统修饰、核碱基工程以及分子动力学模拟，以表征控制该结构的关键氢键相互作用，并提出两条聚脱氧腺苷酸链以反平行方式缔合、由氢键四联体连接、每个四联体包含两个腺嘌呤碱基和两个3MeX分子的模型，类似G-四链体的G-四联体。该组装表现出明显的热滞后，符合协同的成核—生长机制，且由药理学相关分子形成，识别过程对小分子结构极为敏感。研究还表明该相互作用可整合入DNA纳米技术，实现小分子触发的DNA纳米结构二聚化和高阶聚合。意义在于确立了DNA/小分子杂化物中新的相互作用基序，其中不对称多面识别可实现未修饰核酸的新定向组装，并指出该基序在中性条件下的可及性及对小分子修饰的耐受性，指向可编程纳米材料及与生物环境接口的核酸系统应用。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：预组织实验；小分子结合面的系统修饰；核碱基工程；分子动力学模拟；热滞后分析以推断协同成核—生长机制；将相互作用整合入DNA纳米技术实现小分子触发的二聚化和高阶聚合。具体表征手段、热滞后定量数值及模拟参数摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该工作与自组装技术及框架材料组装主线中的超分子识别与定向组装相关，展示了不对称小分子识别导向未修饰核酸新型组装基序，对可编程纳米材料和生物界面核酸系统有启发。局限在于其体系为DNA/小分子杂化材料，非MOF/COF/HOF框架材料，若关注超分子组装基序与协同机制可全文精读，若聚焦框架材料则相关性较低。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，属摘要级解读。3MeX与聚脱氧腺苷酸的具体浓度与缓冲条件、热滞后的定量数值、分子动力学模拟细节、四联体结构的具体表征证据及二聚化与聚合的验证方法等关键细节均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 3-甲基黄嘌呤这一具有非等价氢键面的嘌呤衍生小分子可导向聚脱氧腺苷酸组装成新型协同排列。
提出两条聚脱氧腺苷酸链以反平行方式缔合、由氢键四联体连接、每个四联体含两个腺嘌呤和两个3MeX分子的模型，类似G-四链体的G-四联体。
该组装表现出明显的热滞后，符合协同的成核—生长机制，且识别过程对小分子结构极为敏感。
该相互作用可整合入DNA纳米技术，实现小分子触发的DNA纳米结构二聚化和高阶聚合。

title: Periodic Mesoporous Metal Oxides With Consistent Structure and Complementary Sensing Selectivity for Reliable Artificial Olfactory
abstract: ABSTRACT The integration of functional materials and intelligent algorithms has endowed artificial olfactory systems with promising potential across various fields. Nevertheless, their accuracy and reliability in practical gas recognition remain constrained, primarily due to the unrefined combination of sensing materials and inadequate feature extraction from response curves. In this work, a series of periodic mesoporous metal oxides (PMMOs) with consistent structure and tunable compositions are synthesized by using polymer cubosomes as general templates. Within the periodic mesoporous channels, the target gases follow well‐defined diffusion pathways, so that the dynamic features of response curves can be leveraged to build a reliable multidimensional dataset, and the consistency across repeated measurement cycles and different devices can be well maintained. By tailoring the chemical microenvironment, a sensor array is constructed from seven distinct PMMOs with complementary sensing selectivity, achieving 97.1% accuracy in discriminating seven representative hazardous gases at 1–5 ppm with neural network model assistance. In complex environment, the established system can also accurately recognize the indicative gases. As a verification, it successfully realize the screening of diabetic patients by the exhaled breath analysis, with acetone serving as the key gaseous biomarker.

title_zh: 具有一致结构和互补传感选择性的周期性介孔金属氧化物用于可靠人工嗅觉
summary_zh: 该工作以聚合物立方体为通用模板合成一系列结构一致、组成可调的周期性介孔金属氧化物，利用其规整介孔通道中气体的明确扩散路径构建多维响应数据集，并结合七种互补选择性传感器阵列与神经网络，在1–5 ppm下对七种危险气体识别准确率达97.1%。
research_details_zh: 研究针对人工嗅觉系统在实际气体识别中准确性和可靠性不足的问题，指出原因在于传感材料组合不够精细以及响应曲线特征提取不充分。作者以聚合物立方体作为通用模板，合成了一系列周期性介孔金属氧化物（PMMOs），其结构保持一致而组成可调。在周期性介孔通道内，目标气体沿明确的扩散路径传输，因此可利用响应曲线的动态特征构建可靠的多维数据集，并在重复测量循环和不同器件之间保持良好一致性。通过调控化学微环境，作者用七种具有互补传感选择性的不同PMMOs构建传感器阵列，在神经网络模型辅助下实现对七种代表性危险气体的区分。在复杂环境中，所建立系统也能准确识别指示性气体。作为验证，该系统通过呼出气分析成功实现糖尿病患者筛查，其中丙酮作为关键气体生物标志物。该研究的意义在于将结构一致的介孔金属氧化物与智能算法结合，提高人工嗅觉的可靠性和实际应用潜力。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：使用聚合物立方体作为通用模板合成周期性介孔金属氧化物；通过调控化学微环境构建七种具有互补传感选择性的PMMOs传感器阵列；利用响应曲线动态特征构建多维数据集；采用神经网络模型辅助气体识别；在1–5 ppm范围内对七种代表性危险气体进行区分测试；在复杂环境中进行识别验证；通过呼出气分析筛查糖尿病患者，并以丙酮作为关键气体生物标志物。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段和器件制备细节。
relevance_zh: 该研究属于介孔材料与传感功能结合的方向，对关注介孔结构一致性、组成可调性及阵列化气体识别的研究主线有参考价值。其核心价值在于用聚合物立方体模板实现周期性介孔金属氧化物的通用合成，并展示介孔通道扩散行为与动态响应特征提取之间的关联。局限是摘要未报告具体材料组成、孔结构参数和器件稳定性细节。若关注介孔材料在人工嗅觉和呼出气诊断中的应用，值得全文精读。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体金属氧化物组成、模板去除条件、孔结构表征数据、传感器制备工艺、神经网络结构、重复性数值、复杂环境具体成分及临床样本规模等关键细节，仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 以聚合物立方体为通用模板合成了结构一致、组成可调的周期性介孔金属氧化物系列。
由七种具有互补传感选择性的PMMOs构建的传感器阵列，在神经网络模型辅助下对1–5 ppm的七种代表性危险气体识别准确率达到97.1%。
周期性介孔通道中目标气体遵循明确扩散路径，使响应曲线动态特征可用于构建可靠多维数据集，并在重复测量循环和不同器件间保持良好一致性。
在复杂环境中该系统可准确识别指示性气体，并通过呼出气分析成功筛查糖尿病患者，丙酮为关键气体生物标志物。

title_zh: 水诱导卟啉超分子自组装集成多价金属有机框架用于增强电化学发光及4-氟甲基苯丙胺超灵敏适配体传感

title: Amide-Pyridine Hydrogen-Bonded Organic Framework for Iodine Capture
abstract: Abstract Despite the rapid growth of hydrogen-bonded organic frameworks (HOFs), developing HOF adsorbents that integrate cost-effectiveness, environmental sustainability, and high uptake capacity remains a challenge. Herein, we report an amide-pyridine-based hydrogen-bonded organic framework (TPADPy-HOF) iodine adsorbent derived from the self-assembly of N1,N4-di(pyridin-4-yl)terephthalamide, which successfully reconciled the trade-off between efficient synthesis, ecological sustainability, and robust adsorption functionality. Relying on the cooperative effects of amide hydrogen bonds and π−π stacking, the obtained TPADPy-HOF featured robust crystallinity and uniform 1D channels with a pore size of around 5.874 Å × 6.027 Å, which collectively underpinned its outstanding adsorption performance toward iodine vapor and iodine species in both water and seawater. Its gaseous iodine adsorption capacity reached 5.2 g g−1, while the adsorption capacities for I2 and I3− in liquid media were 0.454 g g−1 and 0.685 g g−1, respectively, and the removal efficiency was as high as 99%. Meanwhile, the TPADPy-HOF adsorbent possessed good stability, regenerability, and recyclability, underscoring its long-term sustainability for practical applications. Mechanistic investigations revealed that the superior iodine adsorption performance of the TPADPy-HOF originated from the synergistic effect of supramolecular interactions between iodine and the heteroatoms in amide/pyridine groups, coupled with charge-transfer interactions stemming from its electron-rich architecture. These findings make the TPADPy-HOF a highly promising material for iodine pollution treatment and iodine resource recovery in seawater.

title_zh: 用于碘捕获的酰胺-吡啶氢键有机框架
summary_zh: 该研究报道由N1,N4-二(吡啶-4-基)对苯二甲酰胺自组装形成的酰胺-吡啶氢键有机框架TPADPy-HOF，用于碘捕获。其具有约5.874 Å × 6.027 Å的一维通道，碘蒸气吸附容量达5.2 g g−1，水中I2和I3−吸附容量分别为0.454 g g−1和0.685 g g−1，去除效率高达99%。
research_details_zh: 研究针对氢键有机框架吸附剂在成本效益、环境可持续性和高吸附容量之间难以兼顾的问题，报道了一种基于酰胺-吡啶的氢键有机框架TPADPy-HOF碘吸附剂。该材料由N1,N4-二(吡啶-4-基)对苯二甲酰胺自组装得到，依靠酰胺氢键和π−π堆叠的协同作用，获得稳健的结晶性和均匀的一维通道，孔径约为5.874 Å × 6.027 Å。这些结构特征共同支撑其对碘蒸气以及水和海水中碘物种的优异吸附性能。其气态碘吸附容量达到5.2 g g−1，液体介质中I2和I3−吸附容量分别为0.454 g g−1和0.685 g g−1，去除效率高达99%。同时，TPADPy-HOF吸附剂具有良好的稳定性、再生性和可循环使用性，体现长期实际应用可持续性。机理研究表明，其优异碘吸附性能源于碘与酰胺/吡啶基团中杂原子之间的超分子相互作用，以及其富电子结构带来的电荷转移相互作用的协同效应。该材料对碘污染处理和海水中碘资源回收具有潜力。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：由N1,N4-二(吡啶-4-基)对苯二甲酰胺自组装制备TPADPy-HOF；依靠酰胺氢键和π−π堆叠形成框架；表征其结晶性和一维通道孔径；测试对碘蒸气以及水和海水中碘物种的吸附性能；测定气态碘、液体介质中I2和I3−的吸附容量及去除效率；评估稳定性、再生性和可循环使用性；通过机理研究分析超分子相互作用和电荷转移相互作用。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征仪器和吸附测试细节。
relevance_zh: 该研究属于氢键有机框架自组装与吸附功能方向，对关注框架材料组装、超分子相互作用和碘捕获应用的研究主线有直接参考价值。其亮点是同时报告了明确的孔结构参数、多种介质中的碘吸附容量、去除效率以及再生循环性能，并给出超分子相互作用与电荷转移协同的机制解释。局限是摘要未报告合成规模、成本数据和长期稳定性细节。若关注HOF吸附剂设计，值得全文精读。

key_findings_zh: TPADPy-HOF由N1,N4-二(吡啶-4-基)对苯二甲酰胺自组装形成，依靠酰胺氢键和π−π堆叠协同作用，具有稳健结晶性和孔径约5.874 Å × 6.027 Å的均匀一维通道。
气态碘吸附容量达到5.2 g g−1，液体介质中I2和I3−吸附容量分别为0.454 g g−1和0.685 g g−1，去除效率高达99%。
TPADPy-HOF吸附剂具有良好的稳定性、再生性和可循环使用性。
机理研究揭示其优异碘吸附性能源于碘与酰胺/吡啶基团中杂原子之间的超分子相互作用，以及富电子结构带来的电荷转移相互作用的协同效应。

title: Chirality‐Matched Piezoelectric Responsiveness and Energy Transfer in Supramolecular Co‐Assembly of Dipeptides
abstract: ABSTRACT The concept of homochirality is fundamental to living systems, where biopolymers exhibit a uniform chiral signature. The absence of heterochiral or racemic biopolymers in nature highlights the importance of homochirality in precise molecular recognition, efficient packing, and controlled folding for maintaining cellular homeostasis and biological function. However, the role of homochirality in governing emergent functional properties in synthetic supramolecular nanomaterials has been less explored. Here, we investigate homochiral recognition of dipeptides at their co‐assembled state. Homochiral peptides on co‐assembly form supramolecular gels, whereas heterochiral peptides fail to gelify. Co‐assembly of homochiral peptides results in the formation of long‐range fibrillar network with high aspect ratios, while co‐assembly of heterochiral peptides produces short‐range, discrete morphology. Computational insight further reveals that dipeptides containing similar chiral α‐amino acids promote efficient molecular packing and long‐range π–π stacking, whereas dipeptides with opposite chirality disrupt these interactions, leading to short‐range assembly. The preference for like‐like interactions in homochiral co‐assemblies has been explored through FRET and piezoelectric measurements. Homochiral assembly exhibits significantly higher energy‐transfer efficiency and enhanced piezoelectric properties than heterochiral assembly. Overall, this study highlights the fundamental concept of homochirality in nature and its relationship with emergent functional properties.

title_zh: 二肽超分子共组装中的手性匹配压电响应与能量转移
summary_zh: 该研究考察二肽在共组装状态下的同手性识别。同手性肽共组装形成超分子凝胶和长程高长径比纤维网络，异手性肽不能凝胶化，仅形成短程离散形貌。FRET与压电测量表明同手性组装具有更高能量转移效率和增强的压电性能。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于同手性在合成超分子纳米材料中调控涌现功能性质的作用，而天然生物聚合物普遍表现均一手性特征。材料体系为二肽共组装体，通过同手性与异手性二肽的对比研究手性识别。设计策略是比较含相似手性α-氨基酸与相反手性α-氨基酸的二肽在共组装中的行为差异。研究过程包括共组装形成凝胶的能力测试、形貌观察、计算模拟分析分子堆积与π–π堆叠，以及FRET和压电性能测量。意义在于揭示同手性偏好like-like相互作用，并将手性匹配与能量转移和压电响应等涌现功能关联，为理解自然同手性及设计功能超分子纳米材料提供依据。
methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：二肽共组装制备超分子凝胶；形貌观察以区分长程纤维网络与短程离散结构；计算模拟分析分子堆积和π–π堆叠；FRET测量能量转移效率；压电测量评估压电性能。摘要未报告具体合成条件、溶剂、浓度、表征仪器型号及定量数值。
relevance_zh: 该工作属于自组装技术与超分子纳米材料主线，直接涉及共组装、手性识别及组装结构—功能关系，对理解框架材料之外的自组装基元设计有参考价值。其局限在于研究对象为二肽而非介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或介孔材料，且摘要未给出定量性能数据。若关注手性组装与能量转移/压电耦合，值得全文精读；若聚焦框架材料电化学合成，则相关性有限。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，未核查全文。关键细节如二肽序列、组装条件、凝胶测试方法、FRET效率数值、压电系数、计算模型与表征参数均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 同手性肽共组装形成超分子凝胶，异手性肽无法凝胶化。
同手性共组装形成长程、高长径比纤维网络，异手性共组装产生短程、离散形貌。
计算表明含相似手性α-氨基酸的二肽促进有效分子堆积和长程π–π堆叠，相反手性则破坏这些相互作用。
同手性组装相比异手性组装表现出显著更高的能量转移效率和增强的压电性能。

title: Deciphering Dynamic Self‐Healing for Crystallinity Control in β‐Ketoenamine‐Linked Covalent Organic Frameworks
abstract: ABSTRACT Covalent organic frameworks derived from triformylphloroglucinol (Tp‐COFs) represent a prominent branch of COFs due to their high potential in separation, energy storage, and optoelectronics. However, the development of Tp‐COFs is often hindered by limited crystallinity, resulting from the low reversibility of β‐ketoenamine bond formation. In this study, we report an unprecedented dynamic self‐healing mechanism during Tp‐COF formation, arising from a reversible Michael‐addition‐elimination (MAE) process. Building on this insight, a modulator‐mediated MAE pathway is further established for crystallinity control. As a representative example, Tp‐COF‐1 synthesized via this strategy (Tp‐COF‐1(H)) forms well‐defined columnar crystals with domain sizes up to 20 µm × 2 µm, and exhibits significantly improved structural order, as evidenced by a sharper powder x‐ray diffraction (PXRD) peak (full width at half maximum: 0.44° vs. 0.74°) and a higher specific surface area (1314 vs. 647 m 2 g −1 ), compared to Tp‐COF‐1 synthesized by the conventional method (Tp‐COF‐1(O)). Moreover, optical pump‐terahertz probe spectroscopy reveals a photoexcited charge‐carrier mobility of 10.84 cm 2 V −1 s −1 for Tp‐COF‐1(H), which is 1.77 times higher than that of Tp‐COF‐1(O). These findings identify dynamic self‐healing process via MAE as a key mechanism for governing Tp‐COF crystallization toward highly ordered Tp‐COFs for optoelectronic applications.

title_zh: 解析动态自愈合以实现β-酮烯胺连接共价有机框架的结晶度控制
summary_zh: 该研究揭示Tp-COF形成过程中由可逆迈克尔加成-消除过程驱动的动态自愈合机制，并据此建立调节剂介导的MAE路径以控制结晶度，所得Tp-COF-1(H)结晶性、比表面积和光生载流子迁移率均显著提升。
research_details_zh: 三甲酰基间苯三酚衍生共价有机框架因β-酮烯胺键形成可逆性低而常受结晶度限制。本研究报道Tp-COF形成过程中存在由可逆迈克尔加成-消除过程引起的动态自愈合机制，并基于此建立调节剂介导的MAE路径用于结晶度控制。代表性样品Tp-COF-1(H)形成域尺寸达20微米×2微米的柱状晶体，结构有序性显著改善，表现为更尖锐的粉末X射线衍射峰，半高宽为0.44°对比0.74°，比表面积更高，为1314对比647平方米每克。光学泵浦-太赫兹探针光谱显示Tp-COF-1(H)的光激发载流子迁移率为10.84平方厘米每伏每秒，是传统方法样品Tp-COF-1(O)的1.77倍。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报道：以三甲酰基间苯三酚为构筑单元合成Tp-COF；提出调节剂介导的迈克尔加成-消除路径控制结晶度；采用粉末X射线衍射评估结构有序性并比较半高宽；测定比表面积；使用光学泵浦-太赫兹探针光谱表征光激发载流子迁移率。具体合成条件、调节剂种类与用量、反应温度和时间等摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF的结晶度控制与光电性能，对理解框架材料动态键形成机制和自愈合过程具有重要价值。其MAE机制与调节剂策略可为高有序Tp-COF的可控合成提供设计思路，对共轭框架材料及光电应用主线高度相关，值得全文精读以获取合成细节与普适性验证。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征、数值、机制或结论。调节剂种类与用量、反应条件、晶体结构解析、载流子迁移率测试条件及材料稳定性等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 发现Tp-COF形成过程中由可逆迈克尔加成-消除过程驱动的动态自愈合机制。
调节剂介导的MAE路径使Tp-COF-1(H)形成域尺寸达20微米×2微米的柱状晶体。
Tp-COF-1(H)的PXRD半高宽为0.44°，优于Tp-COF-1(O)的0.74°；比表面积为1314平方米每克，高于647平方米每克。
Tp-COF-1(H)的光激发载流子迁移率为10.84平方厘米每伏每秒，是Tp-COF-1(O)的1.77倍。

title: Unlocking Water as Docking Sites in Covalent Organic Frameworks for Enhanced Physisorptive Carbon Capture under Wet Conditions
abstract: Abstract The physisorptive CO2 capture process frequently faces the challenge of competing with moisture adsorption. Incorporating strong nucleophiles into porous materials can circumvent this issue by forming bicarbonate in the presence of moisture. However, the moisture-enhanced carbon capture (MECC) in physisorptive systems is still rarely reported. Herein, we present a physisorptive MECC capable of operating at a wide range of relative humidity (RH), employing newly developed covalent organic frameworks (COFs) with Brønsted-acidic squaramide as linkage. Specifically, the squaramide linkage and a specific pore size jointly disrupt hydrogen bonds (HBs) in water molecules, thereby converting them into effective docking sites for CO2 adsorption within the amphiphilic pores. Comprehensive column breakthrough experiments highlight a substantial enhancement in CO2 uptake capacity in the squaramide-linked COFs in the presence of moisture (up to 75% RH) compared to dry conditions. The distinctive adsorption mechanism is further interpreted through in situ diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform spectroscopy (DRIFTS), solid-state 1H magic angle spinning nuclear magnetic resonance (ss 1H MAS NMR), dielectric analysis, and sorption simulation, demonstrating that the water around the squaramide linkage could play a crucial role in enhancing CO2 adsorption in the presence of moisture. This work provides new insight into converting water as an additional sorption site and a strategy for addressing the influence of moisture in physisorptive carbon capture processes.

title_zh: 解锁共价有机框架中水作为对接位点以增强潮湿条件下物理吸附碳捕获
summary_zh: 该研究开发了以Brønsted酸性方酰胺为连接键的新型共价有机框架，利用方酰胺连接键与特定孔径协同破坏水分子氢键，将水转化为CO2吸附的有效对接位点，在高达75%相对湿度下实现物理吸附碳捕获容量显著增强。
research_details_zh: 研究针对物理吸附CO2捕获中水分竞争吸附的难题，提出潮湿增强碳捕获策略。现有方法多通过引入强亲核试剂在潮湿条件下形成碳酸氢盐来规避水竞争，但物理吸附体系中的潮湿增强碳捕获鲜有报道。作者开发了以Brønsted酸性方酰胺为连接键的新型共价有机框架，方酰胺连接键与特定孔径共同破坏水分子中的氢键，将其转化为两亲性孔道内CO2吸附的有效对接位点。综合柱穿透实验表明，方酰胺连接COF在潮湿条件下（高达75%相对湿度）的CO2吸附容量较干燥条件显著增强。通过原位漫反射红外傅里叶变换光谱、固态1H魔角旋转核磁共振、介电分析和吸附模拟进一步阐释了独特吸附机制，表明方酰胺连接键周围的水在增强CO2吸附中起关键作用。该工作为将水转化为额外吸附位点及应对物理吸附碳捕获中水分影响提供了新思路。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：合成以Brønsted酸性方酰胺为连接键的新型共价有机框架；柱穿透实验评估干燥与潮湿条件下CO2吸附容量；原位漫反射红外傅里叶变换光谱、固态1H魔角旋转核磁共振、介电分析和吸附模拟阐释吸附机制。摘要未报告具体合成条件、孔径数值和表征参数。
relevance_zh: 该研究属于共轭COF框架材料，涉及框架连接键设计、孔道环境调控与吸附机制，对共轭框架材料主线的设计策略有直接参考价值，尤其是方酰胺连接键与孔径协同调控水-孔道相互作用的思路。与介孔导电MOF及电化学合成关联较弱，但作为高质量框架推荐值得精读全文。

title: High-Efficiency Host-to-Guest Energy Transfer within Complex Multicomponent Luminescent Metal–Organic Frameworks
abstract: Abstract Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) is a fundamental process in natural photosynthesis, inspiring the development of artificial energy transfer systems for the efficient utilization of light. High-porosity metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) with hierarchical pore structures and structural tunability have emerged as ideal platforms for constructing host-to-guest FRET systems, however it remains a challenge to rationally design high-efficiency luminescent MOF (LMOF)-based host–guest FRET systems. Herein, we report an anionic multicomponent LMOF─Zn-AD-TBPP─assembled from photosensitive octatopic pyrene-core-based TBPP linkers and zinc-adeninate vertex secondary building units─for the efficient encapsulation of cationic red-emitting dyes, yielding a host–guest system with a strong spectral overlap. The composite exhibits a high FRET efficiency exceeding 90% and a photoluminescence quantum yield of about 51.1%. This composite is used for constructing high-quality white-light-emitting diodes and exhibits prominent two-photon excited fluorescence emission. This work paves a way for the construction of complex donor-functionalized host LMOFs, accommodating acceptor chromophores, displaying high-efficiency host-to-guest energy transfer.

title_zh: 复杂多组分发光金属有机框架内高效主客体能量转移
summary_zh: 该研究报道了一种阴离子多组分发光MOF Zn-AD-TBPP，由光敏八齿芘核TBPP连接体和锌-腺嘌呤顶点次级构建单元组装而成，可高效封装阳离子红色发光染料，形成光谱重叠强的主客体体系，FRET效率超过90%，光致发光量子产率约51.1%。
research_details_zh: 研究问题是如何理性设计基于发光MOF的高效主客体FRET体系，以模拟自然光合作用中的能量转移并实现光能高效利用。材料体系为阴离子多组分LMOF Zn-AD-TBPP，由光敏八齿芘核TBPP连接体和锌-腺嘌呤顶点SBU组装，用于封装阳离子红色发光染料。设计策略利用高孔隙率、分级孔结构和结构可调性构建强光谱重叠的主客体FRET平台。研究过程包括组装多组分LMOF、封装阳离子染料形成复合材料、表征FRET效率和光致发光量子产率，并构建白光发光二极管及观察双光子激发荧光发射。意义在于为复杂供体功能化主体LMOF容纳受体生色团、实现高效主客体能量转移提供路径。
methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：组装阴离子多组分LMOF Zn-AD-TBPP；封装阳离子红色发光染料形成主客体复合材料；测量FRET效率和光致发光量子产率；构建白光发光二极管；观察双光子激发荧光发射。摘要未报告具体合成条件、染料种类、表征仪器、器件制备细节及稳定性测试。

title: Solubility-Driven Design of Multicomponent Self-Assembled Hydrogels
abstract: Abstract Nature has skillfully harnessed molecular social behavior, such as “co-assembly” and “self-sorting”, to achieve functional intricacy from simple building blocks. However, the rational control of such “social diversity” in synthetic supramolecular systems remains an unresolved problem. The entropy–enthalpy balance in hydrogelator self-assembly is a crucial thermodynamic parameter to control whether low molecular weight gelators (LMWGs) interact or act autonomously in multicomponent hydrogels. Here we propose that a simple inspection of the hydrogelator solubility vs temperature profile, as measured by 1H NMR, allows us to classify and select single-component hydrogelators in order to combine them at will. Thus, we demonstrate our hypothesis through an investigation of three individual LMWGs, with different solubility profiles, and their pairwise combinations to assess their assembly behavior over molecular, mesoscopic, and macroscopic length scales using a range of techniques. Our data show that one binary mixture exhibits co-assembly to form a unified network hydrogel material, whereas the other combinations display self-sorting, whereby each hydrogelator maintains its own structural integrity and intrinsic material properties. Crucially, temperature is used as an external stimulus to control these systems, providing direct and predictable control over material architecture. Our work highlights how simple NMR solubility measurements manifest the entropy–enthalpy balance as a rational approach to design multicomponent supramolecular materials with multifunctionality from simple and accessible molecular building blocks.

title_zh: 溶解度驱动的多组分自组装水凝胶设计
summary_zh: 该研究提出通过核磁共振测量水凝胶因子溶解度-温度曲线来分类和选择单组分水凝胶因子，从而理性设计多组分超分子水凝胶，并证明二元混合物可表现为共组装或自分类，温度可外部调控材料结构。
research_details_zh: 自然界利用共组装和自分类等分子社会行为从简单构筑单元实现功能复杂性，但合成超分子体系中此类社会多样性的理性控制仍未解决。水凝胶因子自组装中的熵-焓平衡是控制低分子量凝胶因子在多组分水凝胶中相互作用或独立行为的关键热力学参数。本研究提出通过核磁共振测量水凝胶因子溶解度-温度曲线，可对单组分水凝胶因子进行分类和选择，进而任意组合。作者研究三种具有不同溶解度曲线的低分子量凝胶因子及其两两组合，在分子、介观和宏观尺度评估组装行为。结果显示一种二元混合物共组装形成统一网络水凝胶材料，其他组合则发生自分类，各水凝胶因子保持自身结构完整性和固有材料性质。温度作为外部刺激可控制这些系统，实现对材料结构的直接可预测调控。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报道：采用核磁共振测量三种低分子量凝胶因子的溶解度-温度曲线；研究三种单组分水凝胶因子及其两两组合；在分子、介观和宏观尺度使用多种技术评估组装行为；以温度作为外部刺激调控材料架构。具体核磁共振条件、其他表征技术名称、凝胶因子化学结构及流变学等测试细节摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该工作属于超分子自组装与多组分水凝胶设计方向，对理解共组装与自分类的热力学控制有参考价值，但其体系为低分子量凝胶因子，并非介孔导电MOF、共轭框架或介孔材料。与框架材料组装和电化学合成主线关联较弱，可作为自组装方法学拓展阅读，是否精读取决于对超分子水凝胶理性设计的兴趣。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征、数值、机制或结论。凝胶因子化学结构、核磁共振溶剂与温度范围、其他表征技术、流变学数据、网络结构证据及温度响应可逆性等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 通过核磁共振测量水凝胶因子溶解度-温度曲线，可分类和选择单组分水凝胶因子以理性设计多组分体系。
一种二元混合物表现为共组装形成统一网络水凝胶材料，其他组合表现为自分类并保持各自结构完整性和固有性质。
温度可作为外部刺激直接且可预测地调控这些超分子材料的架构。

title: Colloidal Electrolyte Enables Bulk-to-Interface Stabilization for Aqueous Manganese Metal Batteries
abstract: Abstract Aqueous Mn metal batteries combine the potential for high safety and energy density, yet are limited by high water activity, sluggish Mn2+ desolvation, and severe interfacial parasitic reactions, which cannot be resolved by isolated strategies. Here we develop an ether-oxygen-rich colloidal electrolyte (EORC) whose nanoscale units couple bulk solvation regulation with interfacial stabilization. EORC disrupts the water hydrogen-bond network, partially replaces Mn2+ solvated waters, and enriches ether-oxygen species to reconstruct the electrical double layer. This continuous bulk-to-interface regulation reduces free water activity, lowers desolvation and nucleation barriers, promotes uniform Mn deposition, and suppresses interfacial parasitic reactions, e.g., corrosion and byproducts accumulation. Consequently, Mn∥Mn symmetric cells operate stably for over 3000 h and Mn∥AgVO full cells achieve over 11000 cycles with 93% capacity retention, along with enhanced low-temperature and pouch cell performance. This work offers a transformative strategy that bridges bulk electrolyte chemistry and interfacial electrochemistry for stable aqueous Mn anodes.

title_zh: 胶体电解质实现水系锰金属电池的体相到界面稳定化
summary_zh: 该工作开发了一种富醚氧胶体电解质，其纳米尺度单元将体相溶剂化调控与界面稳定化耦合，降低自由水活度与脱溶剂化及成核能垒，促进锰均匀沉积并抑制界面副反应，使对称电池稳定运行超3000小时，全电池循环超11000次且容量保持率达93%。
research_details_zh: 水系锰金属电池兼具高安全性与高能量密度潜力，但受高水活度、Mn2+脱溶剂化缓慢及严重界面寄生反应制约，单一策略难以解决。本研究提出富醚氧胶体电解质（EORC），其纳米尺度单元同时作用于体相与界面。EORC破坏水氢键网络，部分取代Mn2+溶剂化水，并富集醚氧物种以重构双电层。这种连续的体相到界面调控降低自由水活度，降低脱溶剂化与成核能垒，促进锰均匀沉积，抑制腐蚀与副产物积累等界面寄生反应。研究通过对称电池与全电池验证了循环稳定性，并考察了低温与软包电池性能。该工作为稳定水系锰负极提供了桥接体相电解质化学与界面电化学的变革性策略。
methods_zh: 摘要明确涉及：设计并制备富醚氧胶体电解质（EORC）；通过破坏水氢键网络、部分取代Mn2+溶剂化水及富集醚氧物种重构双电层；采用Mn∥Mn对称电池和Mn∥AgVO全电池进行电化学性能测试，评估循环稳定性与容量保持率；并考察低温和软包电池性能。摘要未报告具体合成步骤、表征手段及测试条件等细节。
relevance_zh: 该工作属于电解质与界面电化学调控范畴，与介孔导电MOF、共轭框架材料、自组装及框架材料电化学合成等主线无直接关联，匹配主题仅为胶体与成核。其价值在于提供体相到界面协同稳定金属负极的策略思路，但材料体系为胶体电解质而非框架材料。若关注水系金属电池电解质设计可参考，否则全文精读优先级较低。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目与摘要，属于摘要级解读。摘要未报告EORC的具体组成、纳米尺度单元结构、合成与组装方法、表征手段、电解液配方、测试条件及低温与软包电池的具体数值等关键细节，均需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: EORC破坏水氢键网络、部分取代Mn2+溶剂化水并富集醚氧物种重构双电层，实现体相到界面的连续调控。
该调控降低自由水活度与脱溶剂化、成核能垒，促进锰均匀沉积并抑制腐蚀和副产物积累等界面寄生反应。
Mn∥Mn对称电池稳定运行超过3000小时。
Mn∥AgVO全电池实现超过11000次循环且容量保持率达93%，并提升低温与软包电池性能。

title: Hierarchically porous Co–N–C catalysts from bimetallic Zn/Co zeolitic imidazolate frameworks for selective CO2 electroreduction to CO
abstract: The conversion of CO 2 to CO using electrochemistry requires the use of earth abundant catalysts with high selectivity, rapid reaction rate, and durability. In this work, hierarchically porous Co–N–C catalysts were synthesized via co-pyrolysis of a bimetallic zeolitic imidazolate framework (Zn/Co) and the dicyandiamide (DCD) followed by acid etching. By systematically adjusting the pyrolysis temperature (800 °C–1,000 °C) and the Co feed ratio (5–20 mol%), volcano-type activity relationships are found, which are controlled by the interplay of the three factors graphitization, nitrogen retention, and the density of Co–N x sites. The optimized catalyst CoNC-900 achieves a Faradaic efficiency of CO of 94.9% ± 1.0% at −0.75 V vs. RHE in CO 2 -saturated 0.5 M KHCO 3 with a CO partial current density of 16.0 mA cm −2 , a lower bound turnover frequency of ≥0.33 s −1 and ≈11% current decay FE_CO retained above 92% over 24 h. The observed selectivity can be rationalized, as the density functional theory calculations indicate that the barrier of the rate-determining step, namely the formation of COOH is lowered on the Co–N 4 moiety (0.42 eV, whereas ≥1.79 eV on the metal-free nitrogen sites). A transferable design rule is developed for CO 2 electrolysis that relates bimetallic MOF precursor chemistry, hierarchical porosity, and M–N x site engineering.

title_zh: 双金属Zn/Co沸石咪唑酯骨架衍生的多级孔Co–N–C催化剂用于CO2电还原选择性制CO
summary_zh: 该工作以双金属Zn/Co沸石咪唑酯骨架与双氰胺共热解并经酸蚀刻，制备多级孔Co–N–C催化剂，用于CO2电还原制CO。通过调控热解温度和Co投料比，发现火山型活性关系，最优催化剂CoNC-900在−0.75 V vs. RHE下CO法拉第效率达94.9%±1.0%，并给出DFT机制解释与可迁移设计规则。
research_details_zh: 研究针对CO2电还原制CO需高选择性、高活性且耐久的地球丰产元素催化剂这一问题，构建了双金属Zn/Co沸石咪唑酯骨架（ZIF）与双氰胺（DCD）共热解后酸蚀刻的合成路线，得到多级孔Co–N–C催化剂。设计策略是通过系统调节热解温度（800–1,000 °C）和Co投料比（5–20 mol%），考察石墨化程度、氮保留与Co–Nx位点密度三者相互作用对活性的影响，并据此发现火山型活性关系。研究过程包括前驱体共热解、酸蚀刻、电化学性能评价以及密度泛函理论计算。意义在于将双金属MOF前驱体化学、多级孔结构与M–Nx位点工程关联起来，提出可迁移的CO2电解设计规则。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：双金属Zn/Co沸石咪唑酯骨架与双氰胺共热解，随后酸蚀刻制备多级孔Co–N–C催化剂；系统调节热解温度800–1,000 °C和Co投料比5–20 mol%；在CO2饱和0.5 M KHCO3中进行电化学测试，评估CO法拉第效率、CO分电流密度、转换频率和24 h稳定性；采用密度泛函理论计算COOH形成步骤在Co–N4与无金属氮位点上的能垒。其他合成与表征细节摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该文直接关联介孔/多级孔导电MOF衍生材料与框架材料电化学应用主线，展示双金属MOF前驱体向M–N–C催化剂的转化及位点工程策略，对理解框架衍生多级孔结构与电催化选择性关系有实际参考价值。其局限在于摘要未报告孔结构定量参数、Co–Nx配位表征细节及完整稳定性机制。鉴于定量性能与设计规则较明确，值得全文精读以核查合成—结构—性能链条。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目与摘要，属摘要级信息。热解气氛、升温速率、酸蚀刻条件、孔结构数据、Co–Nx配位表征、电化学测试装置细节及DFT计算模型等关键信息摘要未报告，需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: 最优催化剂CoNC-900在CO2饱和0.5 M KHCO3、−0.75 V vs. RHE下CO法拉第效率为94.9%±1.0%，CO分电流密度为16.0 mA cm−2。
CoNC-900的转换频率下界≥0.33 s−1，24 h内电流衰减约11%，FE_CO保持高于92%。
热解温度与Co投料比调控呈现火山型活性关系，受石墨化、氮保留和Co–Nx位点密度三者相互作用控制。
DFT计算表明速率决定步骤COOH形成在Co–N4位点上能垒为0.42 eV，而在无金属氮位点上≥1.79 eV。

title: An Undergraduate Laboratory Experiment for the Fabrication of ZIF-8 SURMOF Thin Films via Layer-by-Layer Self-Assembly
abstract: Abstract Surface-mounted metal-organic framework (SURMOF) thin-films are receiving growing interest due to their unique structural characteristics and potential applications in advanced nanotechnology. A laboratory teaching experiment based on layer-by-layer (LBL) self-assembly method was developed for the fabrication of zeolitic imidazolate frameworks-8 (ZIF-8) SURMOF thin-films. The experiment integrates concepts from coordination chemistry, crystallography, materials science, and modern characterization techniques, providing students with an interdisciplinary learning experience. Through the automated LBL deposition process, students gain hands-on experience in the coordination-driven growth of SURMOF thin-films and learn the fundamental principles of SURMOF fabrication. Compared with conventional MOF synthesis experiments, this course provides a more intuitive understanding of interfacial coordination assembly and modern thin-film fabrication techniques. In addition, the teaching design emphasizes student-centered learning, scientific discussion, and literature-based problem analysis to enhance students’ critical thinking and research abilities. Assessment results demonstrated that the experiment effectively improved students’ understanding of MOF materials, characterization techniques, and thin-film growth mechanisms while simultaneously strengthening their interdisciplinary scientific reasoning and experimental skills.

title_zh: 通过层层自组装制备ZIF-8 SURMOF薄膜的本科实验教学
summary_zh: 该文报道一项本科实验教学项目，采用层层自组装法在基底上制备ZIF-8表面安装金属有机框架薄膜。实验融合配位化学、晶体学、材料科学与现代表征技术，通过自动化LBL沉积让学生实践配位驱动薄膜生长，评估结果显示其有效提升学生对MOF材料、表征技术和薄膜生长机制的理解。
research_details_zh: 该研究面向表面安装金属有机框架（SURMOF）薄膜在先进纳米技术中的潜在应用，开发了一项基于层层（LBL）自组装方法的本科实验教学项目，用于制备沸石咪唑酯骨架-8（ZIF-8）SURMOF薄膜。设计策略是将配位化学、晶体学、材料科学与现代表征技术整合为跨学科学习体验，通过自动化LBL沉积过程使学生获得配位驱动SURMOF薄膜生长的动手经验，并学习SURMOF制备基本原理。与传统MOF合成实验相比，该课程更直观地展示界面配位组装与现代薄膜制备技术。教学设计强调以学生为中心的学习、科学讨论和基于文献的问题分析，以提升批判性思维与研究能力。评估结果表明，该实验有效提高了学生对MOF材料、表征技术和薄膜生长机制的理解，同时增强了跨学科科学推理与实验技能。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：采用层层（LBL）自组装方法制备ZIF-8 SURMOF薄膜；使用自动化LBL沉积过程进行配位驱动薄膜生长；整合现代表征技术用于教学；通过评估结果考察教学效果。具体基底类型、前驱体浓度、沉积循环次数、表征手段种类及评估方式等摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该文与框架材料组装、自组装技术及MOF薄膜制备主线直接相关，可作为SURMOF界面配位组装的教学化范例，对理解LBL自组装原理和薄膜生长机制有参考价值。局限在于其定位为教学实验，摘要未报告薄膜结构或性能的定量研究数据，科研深度有限。若关注SURMOF制备教学或入门性组装方法，可全文精读；若关注高性能框架薄膜研究，则参考价值有限。

title: Lithiophilic Covalent Organic Framework-Bridged Interface Enables Fast Ion Transport in Ultrathin Gel Polymer Electrolyte Membranes
abstract: Abstract Gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs) require a homogeneous polymeric structure, processability, and excellent chemical stability for high-performance lithium metal battery configurations. However, heterogeneous electrolyte polymerization, which constrains ion transport, limits the practical deployment of GPEs. Herein, a universal interface engineering strategy is proposed to construct an oligomer-functionalized covalent organic framework bridging layer on PVDF nanofibers, which bridges the GPE and forms an integrated architecture. Its distinctive nanoconfinement effect efficiently immobilizes guest molecules and homogenizes the Li+ flux, thereby connecting the two phases to form a homogeneous, continuous ion-conductive network. The modified electrolyte with a minimal thickness of 17 μm exhibits significantly enhanced ionic conductivity, reaching 2.96 × 10–4 S cm–1 at 30 °C. Additionally, Li|Li symmetric cells with the modified electrolyte can achieve highly stable cycling over 1000 h at 0.2 mA cm–2, and the LFP|Li cells demonstrate exceptional electrochemical performance, achieving 98.35% capacity retention after 200 cycles at 1 C rate. As a broadly applicable approach, this strategy not only provides enhanced structural integrity but also forms continuous Li+ transport channels, offering considerable potential for practical application in high-performance energy storage systems.

title_zh: 亲锂共价有机框架桥接界面实现超薄凝胶聚合物电解质膜中的快速离子传输
summary_zh: 该研究提出通用界面工程策略，在PVDF纳米纤维上构建寡聚物功能化共价有机框架桥接层，桥接凝胶聚合物电解质形成一体化结构。纳米限域效应固定客体分子并均化锂离子通量，形成连续离子导电网络。17微米厚电解质在30摄氏度下离子电导率达2.96×10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹，对称电池稳定循环超1000小时，LFP全电池1C下200圈容量保持率98.35%。
research_details_zh: 凝胶聚合物电解质在高性能锂金属电池中需要均相聚合物结构、可加工性和优异化学稳定性，但异相电解质聚合限制离子传输，阻碍其实际应用。本研究提出一种通用界面工程策略，在PVDF纳米纤维上构建寡聚物功能化共价有机框架桥接层，该桥接层桥接凝胶聚合物电解质并形成一体化架构。其独特的纳米限域效应有效固定客体分子并均化锂离子通量，从而连接两相形成均相连续的离子导电网络。改性电解质最小厚度为17微米，在30摄氏度下离子电导率显著提升至2.96×10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹。采用该改性电解质的锂对称电池在0.2 mA cm⁻²下可实现超过1000小时的高度稳定循环，LFP锂金属电池在1C倍率下200次循环后容量保持率达98.35%。该策略作为广泛适用的方法，不仅增强结构完整性，还形成连续的锂离子传输通道，为高性能储能系统的实际应用提供了可观潜力。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：在PVDF纳米纤维上构建寡聚物功能化共价有机框架桥接层，桥接凝胶聚合物电解质形成一体化架构；通过纳米限域效应固定客体分子并均化锂离子通量；测试改性电解质的离子电导率、锂对称电池循环稳定性和LFP锂金属电池的电化学性能。摘要未报告具体的合成步骤、表征手段和组装工艺细节。
relevance_zh: 该工作属于共价有机框架在凝胶聚合物电解质中的界面工程应用，与共轭框架材料及框架材料组装主线相关。其核心价值在于利用COF桥接层解决凝胶电解质异相聚合导致的离子传输限制，并给出明确的电导率、循环稳定性和容量保持率数据。局限在于摘要未报告COF的具体结构、寡聚物种类及纳米限域机制的直接证据。对于关注框架材料在固态/凝胶电解质中界面调控的研究者，值得全文精读以核查合成与表征细节。

锂对称电池在0.2 mA cm⁻²下实现超过1000小时的高度稳定循环。
LFP锂金属电池在1C倍率下200次循环后容量保持率为98.35%。

title: Bio‐hybrid Nanostructures Orchestrate Photodynamic Remodeling of the Fusobacterium nucleatum ‐Associated Colorectal Tumor Niche
abstract: ABSTRACT The intratumoral microbiota acts as a microbial immune checkpoint in colorectal cancer (CRC), yet current strategies either kill silently without immune activation or permit bacterial rebound through incomplete targeting. Here we report a bio‐hybrid assembly designed to synchronize the eradication of CRC cells and their tumor‐associated Fusobacterium nucleatum . This system integrates a hemoglobin (Hb)‐augmented aggregation‐induced emission (AIE) photosensitizing module into cRGD‐functionalized ginger‐derived vesicles. This architecture couples Hb‐associated oxygen availability with molecular confinement of the photosensitizer while harnessing the intrinsic anti‐inflammatory components of the plant carrier to mitigate off‐target toxicity. Light activation initiates a dual cascade: it induces lysosomal pyroptosis in malignant cells and disrupts key F. nucleatum pathways related to membrane transport and DNA repair. This synchronized killing elicits the coordinated release of damage‐ and pathogen‐associated molecular patterns (PAMPs), effectively transforming an immunologically cold tumor into a robust in situ vaccine that drives dendritic cell maturation and systemic T‐cell immunity. Our findings demonstrate that the integration of natural bioactivity with supramolecular engineering provides a biocompatible strategy for coordinated tumor–bacterial disruption and immunogenic remodeling of the F. nucleatum ‐associated tumor niche in CRC.

title_zh: 生物杂化纳米结构协同调控具核梭杆菌相关结直肠肿瘤微环境的光动力重塑
summary_zh: 该研究构建了整合血红蛋白增强AIE光敏模块的cRGD功能化生姜囊泡生物杂化组装体，通过光激活同步杀伤结直肠癌细胞与具核梭杆菌，释放损伤与病原相关分子模式，将免疫冷肿瘤转化为原位疫苗，驱动树突细胞成熟与系统性T细胞免疫。
research_details_zh: 研究针对结直肠癌中瘤内微生物作为免疫检查点、现有策略无法同步清除肿瘤与细菌的问题，设计了一种生物杂化组装体。该体系将血红蛋白增强的聚集诱导发光光敏模块整合入cRGD功能化的生姜来源囊泡中，利用血红蛋白相关氧可用性与光敏剂的分子限域效应耦合，并借助植物载体固有抗炎组分减轻脱靶毒性。光激活后引发双重级联：诱导恶性细胞溶酶体焦亡，同时破坏具核梭杆菌膜转运和DNA修复相关关键通路。同步杀伤促使损伤相关和病原相关分子模式协调释放，将免疫冷肿瘤转化为稳健的原位疫苗，驱动树突细胞成熟和系统性T细胞免疫。该工作表明天然生物活性与超分子工程整合可为肿瘤-细菌协同破坏及具核梭杆菌相关肿瘤微环境免疫重塑提供生物相容性策略。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报告的方法包括：构建血红蛋白增强的聚集诱导发光光敏模块并整合入cRGD功能化生姜来源囊泡，形成生物杂化组装体；光激活引发双重级联反应；评估对结直肠癌细胞和具核梭杆菌的同步杀伤效果；检测损伤相关和病原相关分子模式释放、树突细胞成熟及系统性T细胞免疫。摘要未报告具体合成步骤、表征手段和性能测试细节。

title: Ambient Electrosynthesis of Pure 15 wt% H 2 O 2 Without Salt Using an Ultrathin Metal–Organic Framework Nanosheet Featuring Dicopper(I) Active Sites
abstract: ABSTRACT Electrochemical synthesis of hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ) is a promising alternative to the industrial anthraquinone process. Although current systems achieve near 100% selectivity and reach 300 mA cm −2 current density, the resulting H 2 O 2 often has low concentration or contains electrolyte impurities, requiring additional purification for practical use. We developed an ultrathin nanosheet (∼2.75 nm) with dicopper(I) sites (Cu‐tz NS) as an efficient electrocatalyst for the 2e − oxygen reduction reaction to produce high‐purity H 2 O 2 . Interestingly, Cu‐tz NS achieves excellent selectivity (95%–97%) and current density (up to 350 mA cm −2 at −0.3 V vs. RHE) in the flow‐cell, maintaining a yield rate of 17 mol g cat −1 h −1 over 70 hours. In a membrane electrode assembly solid–solid electrolyte system, it continuously produces pure 15 wt% H 2 O 2 without salt at 2 V over 50 hours, effectively avoiding ionic or organic contamination. Importantly, such H 2 O 2 concentration is three times higher than the average value reported in the literature. Mechanistic studies reveal a dual‐enhancement mechanism of Cu‐tz NS: (i) dicopper(I) sites promote *OOH intermediate formation, enhancing reaction kinetics; and (ii) the ultrathin MOF structure optimizes active site exposure, synergistically maximizing catalytic efficiency.

title_zh: 利用具有双铜(I)活性位点的超薄金属-有机框架纳米片在无盐条件下常温电合成纯15 wt%过氧化氢
summary_zh: 该研究开发了约2.75 nm厚、含双铜(I)位点的超薄MOF纳米片，用于2e⁻氧还原电合成高纯H₂O₂。在流动池中实现95%–97%选择性和350 mA cm⁻²电流密度，并在固态电解质膜电极体系中无盐连续产出纯15 wt% H₂O₂达50小时。
research_details_zh: 针对电化学合成H₂O₂虽可实现高选择性和高电流密度，但产物浓度低或含电解质杂质、需额外纯化的问题，作者设计了一种超薄金属-有机框架纳米片（Cu-tz NS，厚度约2.75 nm），其活性位点为双铜(I)结构，用于2e⁻氧还原反应制备高纯H₂O₂。在流动池中，Cu-tz NS在−0.3 V vs. RHE下表现出95%–97%的选择性和高达350 mA cm⁻²的电流密度，并在70小时内维持17 mol g_cat⁻¹ h⁻¹的产率。在膜电极组件的固-固电解质体系中，该催化剂在2 V下连续50小时产出无盐的纯15 wt% H₂O₂，有效避免离子或有机污染。该浓度是文献报道平均值的3倍。机理研究揭示双重增强机制：双铜(I)位点促进*OOH中间体形成以增强反应动力学，超薄MOF结构优化活性位点暴露，协同最大化催化效率。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：合成超薄Cu-tz MOF纳米片（厚度约2.75 nm）；在流动池中进行2e⁻氧还原电化学测试，评估选择性和电流密度；在膜电极组件固-固电解质体系中测试连续H₂O₂生产；通过机理研究探究*OOH中间体形成和活性位点暴露。摘要未报告具体的合成步骤、表征手段和测试仪器型号。

title: Coordination‐Driven Pt(II)‐Ru(II) Heterometallacycles With Ultrastrong Cathodic Electrochemiluminescence and Guest‐Responsive Signal Amplification
abstract: ABSTRACT Coordination‐driven self‐assembly enables the integration of multiple functional elements within a single supramolecular architecture. By combining emissive chromophores, optimized electronic structures, and confined microenvironments, it provides an effective strategy for enhancing cathodic electrochemiluminescence (ECL). Here, we report a discrete Pt(II)‐Ru(II) heterometallacycle constructed by embedding a Ru(II) polypyridyl luminophore into a positively charged Pt(II)‐based metallacyclic scaffold. The assembly reorganizes the frontier electronic structure through orbital redistribution and enhanced delocalization while preserving the intrinsic Ru(II)‐centered emissive excited state, thereby enabling efficient coupling between electrochemical reduction and excited‐state formation. Consequently, the heterometallacycle exhibits dramatically enhanced cathodic ECL, demonstrating that supramolecular electronic reconfiguration can overcome the intrinsic limitations of molecular luminophores. The positively charged cavity further enables 1:1 host–guest complexation with terephthalate dianions, and guest encapsulation modulates the local electronic environment to produce an additional ECL enhancement. Notably, the binding constant determined by ECL titration agrees well with that obtained from fluorescence titration, establishing ECL as a complementary signal transduction modality for probing host–guest recognition. This work demonstrates that coordination‐driven self‐assembly enables the synergistic integration of emissive chromophores, electronic regulation, and guest‐responsive supramolecular microenvironments, providing new design principles for supramolecular cathodic ECL systems.

title_zh: 配位驱动的Pt(II)-Ru(II)异金属大环具有超强阴极电化学发光和客体响应信号放大
summary_zh: 该研究通过配位驱动自组装构建了将Ru(II)多吡啶发光团嵌入正电性Pt(II)金属大环骨架的离散Pt(II)-Ru(II)异金属大环。该组装体通过轨道重分布增强阴极电化学发光，并利用正电性空腔与对苯二甲酸根阴离子进行1:1主客体络合实现信号放大。
research_details_zh: 针对增强阴极电化学发光（ECL）的需求，作者利用配位驱动自组装策略，将Ru(II)多吡啶发光团嵌入正电性Pt(II)基金属大环骨架中，构建了离散的Pt(II)-Ru(II)异金属大环。该组装体通过轨道重分布和增强离域化重组了前沿电子结构，同时保留Ru(II)中心的固有发光激发态，从而实现电化学还原与激发态形成之间的高效耦合。异金属大环表现出显著增强的阴极ECL，证明超分子电子重构可克服分子发光团的固有局限。正电性空腔进一步实现对苯二甲酸根阴离子的1:1主客体络合，客体封装调节局部电子环境产生额外ECL增强。值得注意的是，ECL滴定测定的结合常数与荧光滴定结果吻合良好，表明ECL可作为探测主客体识别的互补信号转导方式。该工作展示了配位驱动自组装可实现发光发色团、电子调控和客体响应超分子微环境的协同集成，为超分子阴极ECL体系提供了新设计原则。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：配位驱动自组装构建Pt(II)-Ru(II)异金属大环；阴极ECL测试；ECL滴定和荧光滴定测定主客体结合常数；对苯二甲酸根阴离子的主客体络合实验。摘要未报告具体的合成步骤、表征手段和ECL测试条件。

title: Investigating Ruthenium Nanoparticles Anchored on Functional Porous Carbon Nanospheres for the Oxygen Evolution Reaction
abstract: Abstract Ruthenium metal nanoparticles are among the most active catalysts for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) but suffer from poor stability due to Ru dissolution. Anchoring Ru nanoparticles onto functional porous carbon supports is therefore being explored to enhance stability while retaining high catalytic activity. A Ru-based electrocatalyst consisting of Ru nanoparticles decorated on nitrogen-doped functional mesoporous carbon spheres was synthesized via a one-pot nanoemulsion micelle-assembly method followed by pyrolysis. The nitrogen-doped functional porous carbon spheres facilitate coordination, as evidenced by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy mapping. Additionally, defects in the carbon matrix accelerate OER kinetics. Electrochemistry-mass spectrometry (EC-MS) measurements on the annealed sample at 1000 °C (Ru/C@1000) reveal the onset of oxygen evolution at 1.4 V vs. RHE. EC-MS reveals the onset of CO2 evolution at potentials above 1.2 V vs. RHE; however, the faradaic efficiency for oxygen evolution approaches unity above 1.4 V vs. RHE, indicating that the anodic current is predominantly due to OER. However, limited catalytic stability under prolonged testing may be attributed to carbon support instability against oxidation and partial oxidation/dissolution of Ru nanoparticles. This study evaluates the effectiveness of anchoring Ru nanoparticles on carbon supports and provides insights for developing stable, efficient Ru/C-based OER electrocatalysts.

title_zh: 功能化多孔碳纳米球锚定钌纳米颗粒用于析氧反应的研究
summary_zh: 该研究通过一锅法纳米乳液胶束组装结合热解，制备氮掺杂功能介孔碳球负载Ru纳米颗粒电催化剂，用于析氧反应。XPS与EDS mapping显示氮掺杂功能多孔碳球促进配位，碳基体缺陷加速OER动力学。EC-MS表明1000 °C退火样品Ru/C@1000在1.4 V vs. RHE出现析氧起始，但长期稳定性受碳载体氧化和Ru部分氧化/溶解限制。
research_details_zh: 研究针对Ru纳米颗粒虽为高活性OER催化剂但易因Ru溶解而稳定性差的问题，探索将其锚定于功能多孔碳载体以兼顾活性与稳定性。材料体系为氮掺杂功能介孔碳球负载Ru纳米颗粒，合成采用一锅法纳米乳液胶束组装后热解。研究通过X射线光电子能谱和能量色散X射线谱 mapping 证明氮掺杂功能多孔碳球促进配位，并提出碳基体缺陷可加速OER动力学。电化学—质谱联用测试显示，1000 °C退火样品Ru/C@1000在1.4 V vs. RHE出现析氧起始；1.2 V vs. RHE以上出现CO2析出，但1.4 V vs. RHE以上析氧法拉第效率接近1，表明阳极电流主要来自OER。意义在于评估碳载体锚定Ru策略的有效性，并为开发稳定高效Ru/C基OER电催化剂提供启示。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：一锅法纳米乳液胶束组装结合热解合成Ru纳米颗粒修饰的氮掺杂功能介孔碳球；采用X射线光电子能谱和能量色散X射线谱 mapping 表征配位与元素分布；对1000 °C退火样品进行电化学—质谱联用测试，考察析氧起始电位、CO2析出电位及析氧法拉第效率；并进行延长测试评估催化稳定性。其他合成参数、电化学测试条件及稳定性测试细节摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该文与介孔材料、自组装技术及碳基电催化主线相关，展示纳米乳液胶束组装构建介孔碳球并锚定金属纳米颗粒的策略，对理解载体功能化、配位作用与OER稳定性关系有参考价值。局限在于摘要未给出Ru负载量、孔结构参数、稳定性测试时长及法拉第效率数值等关键定量信息。可作为拓展阅读，全文精读价值取决于对Ru/C稳定性机制的关注程度。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目与摘要，属摘要级信息。热解温度程序、Ru负载量、介孔结构数据、电解液条件、稳定性测试时长、法拉第效率具体数值及Ru溶解定量证据等摘要未报告，需查阅全文核实。

EC-MS显示1.2 V vs. RHE以上出现CO2析出，但1.4 V vs. RHE以上析氧法拉第效率接近1，表明阳极电流主要来自OER。

title: Photoactive Metal–Organic Framework Heterojunctions for Optoelectronic Synapse and Neuromorphic Computing
abstract: ABSTRACT Metal–organic frameworks combine the structural tunability of organic materials with the periodic order of inorganic lattices, making them attractive candidates for neuromorphic devices. However, most MOF‐based synaptic devices reported to date have been limited to electrically driven memristors because conventional MOFs generally suffer from poor conductivity and inadequate film quality. Here, we report the in situ preparation of photoactive ZnO/Zn 3 (HHTP) 2 heterojunction that enables optoelectronic synaptic plasticity and neuromorphic computing. Two‐dimensional Zn 3 (HHTP) 2 framework is synthesized via the coordination reaction between 2,3,6,7,10,11‐hexahydroxytriphenylene and Zn 2+ derived from sacrificial ZnO nanorods, yielding a porous conductive MOF integrated directly with ZnO. The resulting ZnO/ZnHHTP heterojunction forms type‐II band alignment, facilitating efficient separation and transport of photo‐generated carriers. Combined with defect‐assisted trapping and relaxation processes, the device emulates key synaptic functions, including paired‐pulse facilitation, spike dependent plasticity, and transition from short‐term plasticity to long‐term plasticity. Benefiting from dual‐wavelength optical responses under 445 and 520 nm illumination, the device also realizes all‐optical “AND” and “OR” logic operations. Furthermore, when integrated into a reservoir computing framework, the nonlinear transient responses of the heterojunction enable handwritten digit recognition with an accuracy of ∼95% on the MNIST dataset. This work establishes conductive MOF‐based heterojunctions as promising platforms for neuromorphic information processing.

title_zh: 光活性金属–有机框架异质结用于光电突触与神经形态计算
summary_zh: 该研究通过牺牲性ZnO纳米棒原位制备ZnO/Zn3(HHTP)2异质结，二维导电MOF与ZnO形成II型能带排列，实现光电突触可塑性及全光逻辑操作，并在储备池计算中实现约95%的手写数字识别准确率。
research_details_zh: 金属–有机框架兼具有机材料的结构可调性与无机晶格的周期性有序，是神经形态器件的潜在候选，但多数已报道的MOF基突触器件受限于电驱动忆阻器，因传统MOF电导率差且薄膜质量不足。本文报道原位制备光活性ZnO/Zn3(HHTP)2异质结，实现光电突触可塑性与神经形态计算。二维Zn3(HHTP)2框架通过2,3,6,7,10,11-六羟基三亚苯与由牺牲性ZnO纳米棒衍生的Zn2+之间的配位反应合成，得到直接与ZnO集成的多孔导电MOF。所得ZnO/ZnHHTP异质结形成II型能带排列，促进光生载流子的高效分离与传输。结合缺陷辅助俘获与弛豫过程，器件模拟了关键突触功能，包括双脉冲易化、脉冲依赖可塑性以及从短时程可塑性到长时程可塑性的转变。得益于445和520 nm双波长光响应，器件还实现了全光“AND”和“OR”逻辑操作。此外，当集成到储备池计算框架中时，异质结的非线性瞬态响应在MNIST数据集上实现约95%的手写数字识别准确率。
methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：以牺牲性ZnO纳米棒提供Zn2+，与2,3,6,7,10,11-六羟基三亚苯通过配位反应原位合成二维Zn3(HHTP)2框架，构建ZnO/ZnHHTP异质结；进行光电突触性能测试，包括双脉冲易化、脉冲依赖可塑性及短时程到长时程可塑性转变；在445和520 nm双波长下测试全光逻辑操作；集成储备池计算框架进行MNIST手写数字识别。摘要未报告具体合成温度、时间、薄膜制备及器件结构细节。
relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联导电MOF、框架材料组装与光电应用主线，展示原位配位组装构建MOF/无机异质结并用于神经形态计算的策略，对介孔导电MOF及框架材料电化学/光电合成具有参考价值。其定量识别准确率与突触功能证据明确，值得全文精读以核查合成与器件细节。

key_findings_zh: 通过牺牲性ZnO纳米棒原位制备ZnO/Zn3(HHTP)2异质结，二维导电MOF与ZnO直接集成并形成II型能带排列，促进光生载流子高效分离与传输。
器件模拟了双脉冲易化、脉冲依赖可塑性及从短时程可塑性到长时程可塑性的转变，并在445和520 nm双波长光照下实现全光“AND”和“OR”逻辑操作。
集成到储备池计算框架后，异质结非线性瞬态响应在MNIST数据集上实现约95%的手写数字识别准确率。

title: Data‐Driven Discovery of MOF–Polymer Synergies Enabling High‐Performance Solid‐State Sodium Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Solid‐state batteries (SSBs) are widely regarded as a promising next‐generation energy storage technology owing to their intrinsic safety and high energy density. Solid polymer electrolytes (SPEs) have been esteemed as a cost‐effective route to realize commercial SSBs, however, it's hindered by the low ionic conductivity at room temperature. Here, we present a data‐driven strategy to screen a broad library of M‐MOF‐74 structures and identify Zn‐MOF‐74 as an optimal filler for poly(vinylidene difluoride)‐based electrolytes after comprehensive structure‐conductivity correlation analysis and performance prediction. The SPE‐Zn‐MOF electrolyte achieves an ionic conductivity of 1.02 × 10 −3 S cm −1 at room temperature and a high Na + transference number (t Na+ ) of 0.84. Various structural characterizations reveal that Zn‐MOF‐74 suppresses the formation of PVDF microcrystallinity and anomalously inhibits the re‐crystallinity of polymer during cycling, which also promotes anion dissociation through Lewis‐acidic metal sites and the formation of NaF‐rich interphase. These synergies extend the electrochemical stability window up to 5.1 V and support prolonged cycling stability beyond 4000 h in Na||Na cells. When integrated with layered oxide or Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 cathodes, the optimized SPE enables both full cells achieving superior cycling stability and excellent rate capability at room temperature.

title_zh: 数据驱动发现MOF-聚合物协同作用实现高性能固态钠电池
summary_zh: 该研究采用数据驱动策略筛选M-MOF-74库，识别Zn-MOF-74为PVDF基电解质最优填料。SPE-Zn-MOF电解质室温离子电导率达1.02×10⁻³ S cm⁻¹，钠离子迁移数0.84，电化学稳定窗口5.1 V，Na||Na电池循环超4000小时。Zn-MOF-74抑制PVDF微晶形成并异常抑制循环中聚合物再结晶，通过路易斯酸性金属位点促进阴离子解离并形成富NaF界面。
research_details_zh: 固态电池因本征安全性和高能量密度被视为有前景的下一代储能技术。固态聚合物电解质是实现商业化固态电池的成本有效途径，但受限于室温下低离子电导率。本研究提出数据驱动策略，筛选广泛的M-MOF-74结构库，经综合结构-电导率相关性分析和性能预测，识别Zn-MOF-74为聚偏氟乙烯基电解质的最优填料。SPE-Zn-MOF电解质在室温下实现1.02×10⁻³ S cm⁻¹的离子电导率和0.84的高钠离子迁移数。多种结构表征表明，Zn-MOF-74抑制PVDF微晶形成，并异常抑制循环过程中聚合物的再结晶，同时通过路易斯酸性金属位点促进阴离子解离和富NaF界面的形成。这些协同作用将电化学稳定窗口扩展至5.1 V，并支持Na||Na电池中超过4000小时的延长循环稳定性。当与层状氧化物或Na₃V₂(PO₄)₃正极集成时，优化后的SPE使全电池在室温下均实现优异的循环稳定性和出色的倍率性能。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：数据驱动策略筛选M-MOF-74结构库，进行结构-电导率相关性分析和性能预测；多种结构表征手段研究Zn-MOF-74对PVDF微晶和再结晶的影响；测试SPE的离子电导率、钠离子迁移数、电化学稳定窗口、Na||Na电池循环稳定性，以及与层状氧化物或Na₃V₂(PO₄)₃正极组装的全电池性能。摘要未报告具体合成步骤和表征技术名称。

title: Folding within Frameworks: Confinement in Zr-MOFs Reshapes Enzyme Structure and Catalytic Activity
abstract: Abstract Enhancing the robustness of functional proteins remains a central challenge in biotechnology, with implications for catalysis, pharmaceuticals, and industrial synthesis. Enzyme immobilization in porous materials such as metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) is widely used to enhance enzyme stability; however, the structural state of proteins within these environments is poorly understood and is often assumed to remain largely unchanged. Since enzyme functionality is closely linked to its 3D conformation, the lack of detailed structural information makes the design of enzyme@porous systems largely empirical. In this work, we demonstrate that in situ attenuated total reflectance infrared spectroscopy is a powerful tool for monitoring protein adsorption and confinement in the Zr-based MOF NU-1000. By tracking characteristic amide bands, we monitor changes in protein vibrational signatures that reflect alterations in protein structure and local environment during interaction with the framework. Our results reveal that MOFs are not passive hosts but can induce pronounced perturbations in the protein structure upon adsorption and confinement. We identified a framework-sensitive spectroscopic signature associated with protein uptake into the MOF pore environment and support this assignment through uptake kinetics, diffusion analysis, pore-size controls, and protease accessibility experiments. Protein uptake is governed not only by size compatibility but also by electrostatic interactions, ionic strength, and protein conformational state. Importantly, these immobilization- and confinement-associated structural perturbations correlate with changes in catalytic activity: enhanced catalytic activity for dynamically perturbed proteins and reduced activity for structurally constrained systems. These findings support a relationship between protein–MOF interactions, structural perturbation, and enzymatic function and provide guidelines for tuning protein behavior in MOF-based biocatalysis, separations, and sensing applications.

title_zh: 框架内的折叠：Zr-MOF中的限域重塑酶结构与催化活性
summary_zh: 该研究利用原位衰减全反射红外光谱监测蛋白质在Zr基MOF NU-1000中的吸附与限域，发现MOF并非被动宿主，而是诱导蛋白质结构显著扰动，且该扰动与催化活性变化相关：动态扰动蛋白活性增强，结构受限体系活性降低。
research_details_zh: 研究针对酶在MOF等多孔材料中固定化时其结构状态认识不足的问题，指出酶功能与三维构象密切相关，而酶@多孔体系的设计目前多凭经验。作者以Zr基MOF NU-1000为宿主，采用原位衰减全反射红外光谱监测蛋白质吸附与限域过程，通过追踪特征酰胺带变化反映蛋白质结构及局部环境改变。结果表明MOF并非被动宿主，吸附和限域可诱导蛋白质结构发生显著扰动。作者识别出与蛋白质进入MOF孔环境相关的框架敏感光谱特征，并通过摄取动力学、扩散分析、孔径对照和蛋白酶可及性实验支持该归属。蛋白质摄取不仅受尺寸兼容性控制，还受静电相互作用、离子强度和蛋白质构象状态影响。重要的是，这些固定化与限域相关的结构扰动与催化活性变化相关：动态扰动蛋白活性增强，结构受限体系活性降低。该发现支持蛋白质-MOF相互作用、结构扰动与酶功能之间的关系，并为MOF基生物催化、分离和传感中调控蛋白质行为提供指导。

title: Gradient Gyroid Aerogels With Programmable Multiscale Pore Architectures and Fibrillated Loss Networks for Electromagnetic, Thermal/Fire, and Mechanical Protection
abstract: ABSTRACT Airborne electronic systems operating in extreme environments require lightweight protective materials that combine efficient electromagnetic attenuation, thermal protection, and mechanical robustness. However, conventional aerogel absorbers typically rely on pore engineering at a single length scale, making it difficult to simultaneously optimize these properties. Herein, we develop a decoupled multiscale structural engineering strategy based on a custom‐built freeze‐printing platform, in which pore structures at different length scales are regulated through distinct mechanisms and subsequently integrated into a hierarchical Gyroid architecture spanning from the nanoscale to the millimeter scale. Notably, the amino‐functionalized metal–organic framework employed for nanopore regulation can also intercalate between MXene nanosheets through interactions between its amino groups and the polar surface terminations of MXene, thereby suppressing nanosheet restacking, generating abundant MX@MOF heterointerfaces, and realizing the coupling of structural regulation and functionality. Building on these heterointerfaces, trypan blue directs PPy growth from discrete particles into fibrillar bridges, linking MX@MOF units into continuous conductive pathways enriched with electromagnetic‐loss sites. As a result, the optimized CS‐4 aerogel achieved a minimum reflection loss of −71.5 dB at only 2.45 mm and an effective absorption bandwidth of 6.26 GHz, while maintaining excellent thermal insulation, compressive strength, flame retardancy, and smoke suppression.

title_zh: 具有可编程多尺度孔结构和纤维化损耗网络的梯度Gyroid气凝胶用于电磁、热/火和机械防护
summary_zh: 该工作通过定制冷冻打印平台实现解耦多尺度结构工程，构建从纳米到毫米级的梯度Gyroid气凝胶。氨基功能化MOF调控纳米孔并插层MXene抑制重堆叠，形成MX@MOF异质界面；台盼蓝引导PPy由颗粒生长为纤维桥。优化CS-4气凝胶最小反射损耗−71.5 dB（2.45 mm），有效吸收带宽6.26 GHz，并兼具隔热、抗压、阻燃和抑烟性能。
research_details_zh: 针对极端环境飞行电子系统对轻质防护材料同时兼顾电磁衰减、热防护和机械鲁棒性的需求，传统气凝胶吸收剂多依赖单一长度尺度的孔工程，难以协同优化多种性能。作者提出基于定制冷冻打印平台的解耦多尺度结构工程策略，不同长度尺度的孔结构通过不同机制调控，并集成为从纳米到毫米尺度的分级Gyroid结构。用于纳米孔调控的氨基功能化金属有机框架可通过其氨基与MXene极性表面端基的相互作用插层于MXene纳米片之间，抑制纳米片重堆叠，生成丰富的MX@MOF异质界面，实现结构调控与功能耦合。在此异质界面基础上，台盼蓝引导聚吡咯由离散颗粒生长为纤维桥，将MX@MOF单元连接为富含电磁损耗位点的连续导电通路。最终优化的CS-4气凝胶在仅2.45 mm厚度下实现最小反射损耗−71.5 dB和6.26 GHz有效吸收带宽，同时保持优异隔热、抗压强度、阻燃和抑烟性能。该研究意义在于以解耦多尺度结构工程实现电磁、热/火与机械防护的一体化。
methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：基于定制冷冻打印平台构建梯度Gyroid气凝胶；采用解耦多尺度结构工程策略调控不同长度尺度孔结构；使用氨基功能化金属有机框架进行纳米孔调控，并通过其氨基与MXene极性表面端基相互作用插层MXene纳米片；利用台盼蓝引导聚吡咯由离散颗粒生长为纤维桥；对优化CS-4气凝胶进行电磁性能评价，报告最小反射损耗和有效吸收带宽，并评估隔热、压缩强度、阻燃和抑烟性能。其他合成条件、表征手段和测试细节摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该文与介孔导电MOF、框架材料组装及多尺度孔工程主线高度相关，核心价值在于将MOF用于纳米孔调控并与MXene构建异质界面，再通过PPy纤维化形成连续导电损耗网络，同时实现电磁吸收、热/火防护和机械性能。其局限是摘要未报告MOF具体结构、孔尺寸、电导率及组装机制细节。鉴于定量电磁性能突出且多尺度设计策略明确，值得全文精读。

氨基功能化MOF可通过氨基与MXene极性表面端基相互作用插层于MXene纳米片间，抑制纳米片重堆叠并生成丰富MX@MOF异质界面。
台盼蓝引导PPy由离散颗粒生长为纤维桥，将MX@MOF单元连接为富含电磁损耗位点的连续导电通路。

title: Monomicellar Assembly for Hierarchically Meso‑Macroporous Spheres
abstract: ABSTRACT Hierarchically meso‐macroporous materials are attractive for catalysis, separations, and energy conversion, yet controlling multiple pore length scales within a single soft‐template system remains challenging. Here, we develop a molecularly guided monomicellar assembly strategy that couples amine‐mediated interfacial polymerization with molecular engineering of polyphenol precursors to construct hierarchically meso‐macroporous spheres. We show that precursor‐micelle interactions and solvent‐regulated interfacial dynamics govern the transition from individual micelle templating to intermicellar collision and fusion, allowing micelle‐derived mesopores to be preserved while larger macroporous domains are generated. Tuning the interactions enables programmable pore evolution from surface‐mesoporous and multichambered mesoporous architectures to hierarchically meso‐macroporous spheres. The resulting nitrogen‐doped carbon spheres possess uniform sizes (∼355 nm), high surface areas (379.2 m 2 g −1 ), and well‐defined hierarchical pore networks (∼36, ∼62, and ∼121 nm). As metal‐free electrocatalysts, they exhibit enhanced oxygen reduction activity. Our findings establish a general design principle for extending monomicellar assembly from mesoporous materials to hierarchical porous architectures and provide new opportunities for the rational synthesis of multi‐scale porous materials.

title_zh: 用于分级介孔-大孔球的一元胶束组装
summary_zh: 该工作提出分子引导的一元胶束组装策略，将胺介导界面聚合与多酚前驱体分子工程耦合，构建分级介孔-大孔球。前驱体-胶束相互作用和溶剂调控界面动力学控制从单胶束模板到胶束间碰撞融合的转变，保留胶束衍生介孔并生成大孔域。氮掺杂碳球尺寸约355 nm，比表面积379.2 m² g⁻¹，具有约36、62和121 nm分级孔网络，作为无金属电催化剂展现增强氧还原活性。
research_details_zh: 分级介孔-大孔材料在催化、分离和能量转化中具有吸引力，但在单一软模板体系中控制多个孔长度尺度仍具挑战。作者开发分子引导的一元胶束组装策略，将胺介导界面聚合与多酚前驱体的分子工程耦合，构建分级介孔-大孔球。研究表明前驱体-胶束相互作用和溶剂调控的界面动力学决定从单个胶束模板向胶束间碰撞和融合的转变，从而在保留胶束衍生介孔的同时生成更大的大孔域。通过调节相互作用，可实现从表面介孔、多腔介孔结构到分级介孔-大孔球的可编程孔演化。所得氮掺杂碳球具有均匀尺寸约355 nm、高比表面积379.2 m² g⁻¹以及明确的约36、62和121 nm分级孔网络。作为无金属电催化剂，它们表现出增强的氧还原活性。该发现建立了将一元胶束组装从介孔材料拓展至分级多孔结构的通用设计原则，为多尺度多孔材料的理性合成提供新机会。
methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：分子引导的一元胶束组装策略；胺介导界面聚合；多酚前驱体的分子工程；通过前驱体-胶束相互作用和溶剂调控界面动力学控制胶束模板、碰撞与融合；调节相互作用实现可编程孔演化；制备氮掺杂碳球；表征其尺寸、比表面积和分级孔网络；作为无金属电催化剂测试氧还原活性。具体前驱体种类、溶剂、聚合条件和电化学测试参数摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该文与介孔材料、自组装技术和多尺度孔结构主线相关，核心价值在于以一元胶束组装实现介孔-大孔分级结构，并给出前驱体-胶束相互作用和界面动力学调控孔演化的设计原则。其局限是摘要未报告具体多酚前驱体、溶剂体系、聚合条件及氧还原性能数值。对关注软模板组装和分级多孔碳的研究者具有参考价值，值得全文精读以获取机制与合成细节。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。多酚前驱体结构、胺种类、溶剂、界面聚合条件、胶束表征、孔结构形成机制、氮掺杂含量及氧还原测试条件与性能数值等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 前驱体-胶束相互作用和溶剂调控的界面动力学控制从单个胶束模板向胶束间碰撞和融合的转变，从而保留介孔并生成大孔域。
所得氮掺杂碳球尺寸约355 nm，比表面积379.2 m² g⁻¹，具有约36、62和121 nm的分级孔网络。
通过调节相互作用可实现从表面介孔、多腔介孔结构到分级介孔-大孔球的可编程孔演化。
该氮掺杂碳球作为无金属电催化剂表现出增强的氧还原活性。

title: Asymmetric‐Wall Nanoporous Polymer Capsules via AIEgen‑Assisted Assembly as High‑Performance Electrocatalytic Carriers
abstract: ABSTRACT Soft‐templating through the co‐assembly of surfactants and precursors is a powerful strategy for synthesizing ordered porous materials. However, the range of available precursors and materials is relatively limited, and the correlation between precursor structure and the resulting morphology remains largely unexplored. Herein, we design a water‐soluble, ammonium‐functionalized aggregation‑induced emission luminogen (AIEgen) that serves dual roles as a crosslinkable building block and an auxiliary fluorescence probe. Co‑assembled with Pluronic F127 in an emulsion, this system yields an asymmetric‑wall nanoporous polymer capsule (ANPC) with a mesoporous outer shell and a dense inner layer, a morphology rarely achieved in polymer‑based systems. Multi‐scale characterizations, spanning fluorescence monitoring, precursor structure variation, electron microscopy, crystallographic and computational analyses, collectively reveal that AIEgen‑solvent and AIEgen‑F127 interactions cooperatively govern this architecture evolution. Benefiting from its hollow cavity and nanoporous shell that promote mass transport and site accessibility, the cobalt phthalocyanine‐loaded ANPC catalyst achieves an impressive methanol Faradaic efficiency of 44.2% in acidic CO 2 electroreduction, markedly outperforming nonporous bulk (6.8%), nonporous capsules (14.8%), mesoporous nanospheres (17.5%), and sparse‐porous capsules (28.5%). Ultimately, this work establishes a rational co‐assembly strategy for engineering porous architectures, highlighting how precursor design dictates morphology and how such structural uniqueness directly boosts electrocatalytic performance.

title_zh: 通过AIEgen辅助组装制备不对称壁纳米多孔聚合物胶囊作为高性能电催化载体
summary_zh: 该工作设计水溶性铵功能化聚集诱导发光体，兼具可交联构筑单元和辅助荧光探针双重角色，与Pluronic F127在乳液中共组装，得到外壁介孔、内层致密的不对称壁纳米多孔聚合物胶囊。多尺度表征表明AIEgen-溶剂和AIEgen-F127相互作用协同控制结构演化。负载钴酞菁的ANPC催化剂在酸性CO₂电还原中甲醇法拉第效率达44.2%，显著优于非多孔块体、非多孔胶囊、介孔纳米球和稀疏多孔胶囊。
research_details_zh: 软模板法通过表面活性剂与前驱体共组装合成有序多孔材料，但可用前驱体和材料范围有限，前驱体结构与所得形貌之间的关系尚不明确。作者设计一种水溶性、铵功能化的聚集诱导发光体，其兼具可交联构筑单元和辅助荧光探针双重角色。该AIEgen与Pluronic F127在乳液中共组装，得到具有介孔外壳和致密内层的不对称壁纳米多孔聚合物胶囊，这种形貌在聚合物基体系中很少实现。跨越荧光监测、前驱体结构变化、电子显微镜、晶体学和计算分析的多尺度表征共同揭示，AIEgen-溶剂和AIEgen-F127相互作用协同控制该结构演化。得益于中空空腔和纳米多孔壳层促进传质和位点可及性，负载钴酞菁的ANPC催化剂在酸性CO₂电还原中实现44.2%的甲醇法拉第效率，显著优于非多孔块体6.8%、非多孔胶囊14.8%、介孔纳米球17.5%和稀疏多孔胶囊28.5%。该工作建立了工程化多孔结构的理性共组装策略，强调前驱体设计决定形貌，且这种结构独特性直接提升电催化性能。
methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：设计水溶性铵功能化AIEgen作为可交联构筑单元和辅助荧光探针；与Pluronic F127在乳液中共组装制备不对称壁纳米多孔聚合物胶囊；采用荧光监测、前驱体结构变化、电子显微镜、晶体学和计算分析等多尺度表征研究结构演化；将钴酞菁负载于ANPC作为催化剂；在酸性CO₂电还原中测试甲醇法拉第效率，并与非多孔块体、非多孔胶囊、介孔纳米球和稀疏多孔胶囊对比。具体乳液条件、交联方式和电化学测试参数摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该文与介孔材料、自组装技术及框架材料组装主线相关，核心价值在于以AIEgen辅助共组装构建不对称壁纳米多孔聚合物胶囊，并明确前驱体设计对形貌和电催化性能的调控。其局限是摘要未报告AIEgen具体结构、交联条件、孔尺寸及电化学稳定性。对关注软模板共组装、多孔聚合物胶囊和电催化载体的研究者具有参考价值，值得全文精读。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据题目和摘要，属于摘要级解读。AIEgen化学结构、乳液组成、交联条件、胶囊壁厚与孔尺寸、钴酞菁负载量、酸性CO₂电还原测试条件及稳定性等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 水溶性铵功能化AIEgen与Pluronic F127在乳液中共组装，得到外壁介孔、内层致密的不对称壁纳米多孔聚合物胶囊。
AIEgen-溶剂和AIEgen-F127相互作用协同控制不对称壁结构的演化。
负载钴酞菁的ANPC催化剂在酸性CO₂电还原中甲醇法拉第效率为44.2%。
该性能显著优于非多孔块体6.8%、非多孔胶囊14.8%、介孔纳米球17.5%和稀疏多孔胶囊28.5%。

title: Co‐Assembled Helical Polymer Nanofibers Enable Efficient CO 2 Photoreduction Through Interchain Energy Transfer
abstract: ABSTRACT One‐dimensional (1D) nanofibers have shown bright prospects for artificial CO 2 photoreduction but still face formidable challenge in achieving high performance. Herein, a series of polymer nanofibers are prepared via the helical co‐assembly of chiral poly{1,2‐bis(4‐ethynylphenyl)‐1,2‐diphenylethene‐ co ‐( S )‐dinaphtho[2,1‐ d :1',2'‐ f ][1,3]dioxepine} (P1) and poly[(9,9’‐dioctylfluorenyl‐2,7‐diyl)‐ co ‐4,7‐di(2‐thienyl)‐2,1,3‐benzothiadiazole] (P2) using interchain energy transfer strategy. The helical nanostructure arranged through intermolecularly layered packing endows the polymer nanofibers with expansive surface area, strong light harvesting ability, and great mass diffusion kinetics arising from the abundant active sites. In comparison with the model polymer P1, the binary polymers exhibit not only minimized radiative energy loss, broaden solar light absorption, but also significantly boosted charge transport during the photoreduction process. Under simulated solar light (100 mW/cm 2 ), P1‐0.3P2 nanofibers achieved an excellent CO yield of 1165.31 µmol h −1 g −1 , which is superior to that of P1 nanofibers (76.28 µmol h −1 g −1 ) and previously reported nanofiber photocatalysts under similar conditions. This study presents a novel strategy to fabricate conjugated polymer‐based nanofibers as a promising photocatalyst for highly efficient CO 2 conversion.

title_zh: 共组装螺旋聚合物纳米纤维通过链间能量转移实现高效CO₂光还原
summary_zh: 该研究通过手性聚合物P1与P2的螺旋共组装制备了一系列聚合物纳米纤维，利用链间能量转移策略提升CO₂光还原性能。P1-0.3P2纳米纤维在模拟太阳光下CO产率达1165.31 µmol h⁻¹ g⁻¹，远优于P1纳米纤维的76.28 µmol h⁻¹ g⁻¹。
research_details_zh: 针对一维纳米纤维在人工CO₂光还原中性能提升困难的问题，作者通过手性聚合物P1（聚{1,2-双(4-乙炔基苯基)-1,2-二苯基乙烯-co-(S)-二萘并[2,1-d:1',2'-f][1,3]二氧杂环庚烯}）与P2（聚[(9,9'-二辛基芴基-2,7-二基)-co-4,7-二(2-噻吩基)-2,1,3-苯并噻二唑]）的螺旋共组装，利用链间能量转移策略制备了一系列聚合物纳米纤维。螺旋纳米结构通过分子间层状堆积排列，赋予纳米纤维大比表面积、强光捕获能力和由丰富活性位点带来的良好传质动力学。与模型聚合物P1相比，二元聚合物不仅最小化辐射能量损失、拓宽太阳光吸收，还显著增强光还原过程中的电荷传输。在模拟太阳光（100 mW/cm²）下，P1-0.3P2纳米纤维实现优异的CO产率1165.31 µmol h⁻¹ g⁻¹，优于P1纳米纤维（76.28 µmol h⁻¹ g⁻¹）及此前报道的类似条件下纳米纤维光催化剂。该研究提出了制备共轭聚合物基纳米纤维作为高效CO₂转化光催化剂的新策略。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报道的方法包括：手性聚合物P1与P2的螺旋共组装制备聚合物纳米纤维；在模拟太阳光（100 mW/cm²）下进行CO₂光还原性能测试，以CO产率评估性能；对比P1纳米纤维与二元聚合物纳米纤维的性能。摘要未报告具体的组装条件、表征手段和光还原反应器细节。
relevance_zh: 该工作涉及共轭聚合物的自组装技术及链间能量转移策略，对共轭框架材料/聚合物的组装与光催化应用具有参考价值。其螺旋共组装提升光吸收和电荷传输的设计思路可启发共轭COF/聚合物纳米结构的构建。局限在于摘要未报告纳米纤维的具体形貌表征、能量转移机制的直接证据和长期稳定性数据，值得全文精读以获取完整机理和结构-性能关系。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据摘要内容，未补充摘要未报告的实验条件、表征手段、数值或机制。摘要未报告纳米纤维的具体形貌尺寸、能量转移效率、电荷传输表征及稳定性数据，这些关键细节需查阅全文核实。
key_findings_zh: P1-0.3P2纳米纤维在模拟太阳光（100 mW/cm²）下CO产率达1165.31 µmol h⁻¹ g⁻¹，远高于P1纳米纤维的76.28 µmol h⁻¹ g⁻¹。
二元聚合物相比P1最小化辐射能量损失、拓宽太阳光吸收并显著增强电荷传输。
螺旋纳米结构通过分子间层状堆积赋予大比表面积、强光捕获能力和良好传质动力学。

title: Proton‐Transfer Inhibition by Imine‐Linked Covalent Organic Frameworks Enables Efficient C 2+ Production From Acidic CO 2 Electroreduction
abstract: ABSTRACT Acidic CO 2 electroreduction offers a compelling route to mitigate carbonate formation and improve carbon efficiency, yet the high proton concentration intensifies hydrogen evolution reaction (HER), severely suppressing multi‑carbon (C 2+ ) production. While covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are explored to modulate the reaction microenvironment, existing studies primarily focus on the confinement of alkali cations, CO 2 , and CO intermediates, largely overlooking the critical role of proton‑transport. Herein, we demonstrate that an imine‑linked COF (TAPB–BTCA) anchored on Cu electrocatalysts functions as a proton‑regulating interlayer. Combined experimental and molecular dynamics simulation analyses reveal that the reversible protonation of its C═N bonds retards H + diffusion to the Cu surface, suppressing HER and preserving a locally alkaline environment conducive to C─C coupling. The Cu/TAPB–BTCA electrode achieves 74.0% Faradaic efficiency for C 2+ at −250 mA cm −2 , a 58% improvement over bare Cu, and outperforms previously reported COF‑based electrocatalysts under similar acidic conditions. Comparison with two other imine‐linked COFs (LZU‑1 and CQN) shows that the protonation capability, dictated by the conjugated framework structure, governs proton‑blocking efficacy, local microenvironment, and consequently CO 2 RR performance. This work highlights proton‑transport management via rationally designed COF frameworks as a promising strategy to achieve efficient acidic CO 2 electroreduction.

title_zh: 亚胺连接共价有机框架的质子转移抑制实现酸性CO2电还原高效C2+生成
summary_zh: 该研究将亚胺连接的TAPB–BTCA COF锚定于Cu电极作为质子调控层，利用C=N键可逆质子化延缓H+向Cu表面扩散，抑制析氢并维持局部碱性环境，从而促进C–C偶联，在酸性条件下实现74.0%的C2+法拉第效率。
research_details_zh: 酸性CO2电还原可减少碳酸盐生成并提高碳效率，但高质子浓度加剧析氢反应，严重抑制多碳产物生成。现有COF调控反应微环境的研究主要关注碱金属阳离子、CO2和CO中间体的限域，忽视了质子传输的关键作用。本文在Cu电催化剂上锚定亚胺连接的TAPB–BTCA COF作为质子调控中间层，通过实验与分子动力学模拟相结合，揭示其C=N键的可逆质子化可延缓H+向Cu表面扩散，抑制HER并保持有利于C–C偶联的局部碱性环境。Cu/TAPB–BTCA电极在−250 mA cm−2下C2+法拉第效率达74.0%，较裸Cu提升58%，并优于此前报道的类似酸性条件下COF基电催化剂。与LZU-1和CQN两种亚胺连接COF的对比表明，由共轭框架结构决定的质子化能力主导质子阻断效果、局部微环境及CO2RR性能。该工作凸显了通过合理设计COF框架进行质子传输管理以实现高效酸性CO2电还原的策略。
methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：将亚胺连接COF（TAPB–BTCA）锚定于Cu电催化剂上构建Cu/TAPB–BTCA电极；结合实验与分子动力学模拟分析质子化行为与质子传输；在酸性条件下进行CO2电还原性能测试，以法拉第效率评价C2+生成；并与LZU-1和CQN两种亚胺连接COF进行对比。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征手段及电解装置细节。
relevance_zh: 该工作直接关联共轭COF、框架材料组装与电化学合成主线，提出以亚胺COF的质子化能力调控酸性CO2电还原微环境的新机制，并给出明确的定量性能与结构—性能对比。对介孔导电MOF、共轭框架及电化学合成方向具有较高参考价值，值得全文精读以核查合成、表征与模拟细节。
evidence_note_zh: 本解读仅依据提供的题目与摘要，属摘要级解读。COF的具体合成条件、孔结构参数、表征手段、电解装置、模拟细节及稳定性数据等关键信息仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: Cu/TAPB–BTCA电极在−250 mA cm−2下C2+法拉第效率达74.0%，较裸Cu提升58%，并优于此前报道的类似酸性条件下COF基电催化剂。
亚胺连接COF的C=N键可逆质子化延缓H+向Cu表面扩散，抑制HER并保持有利于C–C偶联的局部碱性环境。
与LZU-1和CQN对比表明，由共轭框架结构决定的质子化能力主导质子阻断效果、局部微环境及CO2RR性能。

title: Lithography‐Compatible Conductive Metal–Organic Frameworks for Scalable Electronics
abstract: ABSTRACT Conductive metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) have emerged as promising electronic materials, yet their integration as functional components in semiconductor devices remains limited by challenges in device‐level fabrication. Here, we demonstrate chemical vapor deposition (CVD)‐grown Cu 3 (C 6 O 6 ) 2 thin films, a highly conductive two‐dimensional (2D) MOF, as gate electrodes, enabled by their suitable work function and stable electronic structure. A sequential APS–Cr etching strategy enables high‐conformity patterning of MOF thin films fully compatible with standard photolithographic processes, while preserving the integrity of the underlying device layers. Field‐effect transistors were realized across three technologically relevant semiconductor platforms, including n ‐type MoS 2 , p ‐type MoTe 2 , and indium gallium zinc oxide (IGZO), demonstrating the generality of Cu 3 (C 6 O 6 ) 2 MOF as a gate electrode material. The resulting devices exhibit transfer characteristics and charge mobilities comparable to conventional metal gates in MoS 2 , while large‐area IGZO transistor arrays show uniform and highly reproducible electrical performance. These results establish conductive MOF thin films as viable gate materials and expand their potential toward source–drain electrodes and even channel materials, in next‐generation semiconductor devices.

title_zh: 光刻兼容的导电金属有机框架用于可扩展电子器件
summary_zh: 该工作展示CVD生长的Cu3(C6O6)2二维导电MOF薄膜可作为栅电极，利用其合适功函数和稳定电子结构。通过APS-Cr顺序刻蚀实现与标准光刻兼容的高保形图案化，并在MoS2、MoTe2和IGZO三类半导体平台上实现场效应晶体管，IGZO阵列表现均匀可重复。
research_details_zh: 研究针对导电金属有机框架作为电子材料在半导体器件中功能集成受限，尤其是器件级制造困难的问题，展示化学气相沉积CVD生长的Cu3(C6O6)2薄膜，这是一种高导电二维MOF，可作为栅电极，得益于其合适的功函数和稳定的电子结构。作者采用顺序APS-Cr刻蚀策略，实现MOF薄膜与标准光刻工艺完全兼容的高保形图案化，同时保持底层器件层的完整性。在三种技术相关半导体平台上实现场效应晶体管，包括n型MoS2、p型MoTe2和铟镓锌氧化物IGZO，证明Cu3(C6O6)2 MOF作为栅电极材料的通用性。所得器件在MoS2中表现出与传统金属栅极相当的转移特性和电荷迁移率，大面积IGZO晶体管阵列显示均匀且高度可重复的电学性能。这些结果确立导电MOF薄膜作为可行栅极材料，并拓展其在下一代半导体器件中作为源漏电极甚至沟道材料的潜力。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报告：采用化学气相沉积CVD生长Cu3(C6O6)2二维导电MOF薄膜；使用顺序APS-Cr刻蚀策略进行高保形图案化，并与标准光刻工艺兼容；在n型MoS2、p型MoTe2和IGZO三种半导体平台上构建场效应晶体管；评估转移特性、电荷迁移率以及大面积IGZO晶体管阵列的电学均匀性和可重复性。其他薄膜表征、器件制备参数和稳定性测试细节摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该文契合导电MOF与框架材料器件集成主线，提供CVD生长Cu3(C6O6)2薄膜作为栅电极并与光刻工艺兼容的明确方案，对导电MOF在可扩展电子器件中的应用具有实际价值。局限在于摘要未报告MOF薄膜的导电率、功函数数值、器件尺寸及长期稳定性，建议全文精读以核查器件级集成细节和性能边界。

key_findings_zh: CVD生长的Cu3(C6O6)2二维导电MOF薄膜可作为栅电极，具有合适功函数和稳定电子结构。
顺序APS-Cr刻蚀策略实现与标准光刻工艺兼容的高保形MOF薄膜图案化，并保持底层器件层完整性。
在n型MoS2、p型MoTe2和IGZO三种半导体平台上实现场效应晶体管，证明该MOF作为栅电极材料的通用性。
MoS2器件转移特性和电荷迁移率与传统金属栅极相当，大面积IGZO晶体管阵列表现均匀且高度可重复的电学性能。

title: Molecularly Engineered Dual-Network Polydimethylsiloxane Composites with Recoverable Thermal Transport and Low Contact Thermal Resistance
abstract: Abstract Thermal interface materials (TIMs) require both efficient heat transfer, reliable interfacial contact, and long-term damage tolerance, yet highly filled polymer composites often suffer from poor deformability, irreversible interfacial damage, and increased contact thermal resistance. Herein, a dual-network self-healing polydimethylsiloxane (SH-PDMS) matrix was designed using a dual-functional cross-linker that integrates permanent covalent cross-links with reversible Diels–Alder (DA) dynamic bonds. The permanent network provided structural stability, while the reversible DA bonds enabled thermally triggered network rearrangement and self-healing. Thermally conductive composites containing Al2O3, boron nitride, and ZnO/carbon fiber fillers were further prepared to examine how filler architecture affects self-healing behavior, recoverable thermal transport, and interfacial contact thermal resistance. Among the tested composites, ZnO/carbon fiber/SH-PDMS achieved the highest thermal conductivity of 2.5 W·m–1·K–1 owing to the formation of long-range conductive pathways and local thermal bridges. After mechanical damage, the thermal conductivity of all composites decreased substantially but recovered to more than 90% of the original value after healing, demonstrating efficient restoration of disrupted heat-transfer pathways. Notably, the thermal conductivity recovery was much higher than the corresponding mechanical recovery, indicating that heat-transfer restoration does not require complete recovery of the load-bearing network. The thermally treated SH-PDMS-based TIMs also exhibited reduced contact thermal resistance under mild pressure, with ZnO/carbon fiber/SH-PDMS reaching 0.205 K·cm2·W–1 at 70 psi. In an LED–TIM–heat sink assembly, the ZnO/carbon fiber/SH-PDMS TIM reduced the maximum LED temperature from 68.1 °C to 51.8 °C. These results demonstrate that the dual-network SH-PDMS matrix provides a promising route for self-healing TIMs with recoverable thermal transport and low contact thermal resistance.

title_zh: 分子工程双网络聚二甲基硅氧烷复合材料：可恢复热传输与低接触热阻
summary_zh: 该研究设计双功能交联剂构建含永久共价交联与可逆Diels–Alder动态键的双网络自修复PDMS基体，并填充Al2O3、氮化硼、ZnO/碳纤维等导热填料，实现损伤后热导率恢复至90%以上及低接触热阻。
research_details_zh: 热界面材料需兼顾高效传热、可靠界面接触与长期损伤容忍性，但高填充聚合物复合材料常面临变形性差、界面损伤不可逆及接触热阻升高等问题。本文设计双网络自修复聚二甲基硅氧烷（SH-PDMS）基体，采用双功能交联剂整合永久共价交联与可逆Diels–Alder（DA）动态键：永久网络提供结构稳定性，可逆DA键实现热触发网络重排与自修复。进一步制备含Al2O3、氮化硼及ZnO/碳纤维填料的导热复合材料，考察填料结构对自修复行为、可恢复热传输及界面接触热阻的影响。在测试复合材料中，ZnO/碳纤维/SH-PDMS因形成长程导热通路与局部热桥而获得最高热导率2.5 W·m–1·K–1。机械损伤后所有复合材料热导率显著下降，但愈合后恢复至原始值的90%以上，表明受损传热通路可有效恢复。值得注意的是，热导率恢复程度远高于相应机械恢复，说明传热恢复不要求承载网络完全恢复。经热处理的SH-PDMS基TIM在温和压力下还表现出降低的接触热阻，ZnO/碳纤维/SH-PDMS在70 psi下达到0.205 K·cm2·W–1。在LED–TIM–散热器组件中，ZnO/碳纤维/SH-PDMS TIM将LED最高温度从68.1 °C降至51.8 °C。
methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括：采用双功能交联剂设计含永久共价交联与可逆Diels–Alder动态键的双网络SH-PDMS基体；制备含Al2O3、氮化硼及ZnO/碳纤维填料的导热复合材料；测试热导率、机械损伤后自修复恢复率、接触热阻及LED–TIM–散热器组件中的降温性能。摘要未报告具体合成配比、表征手段及自修复条件细节。
relevance_zh: 该工作与自组装技术及框架材料组装主线关联较弱，主要涉及聚合物复合材料与热界面材料，但其双网络动态键设计与可恢复热传输概念对框架材料复合组装及界面工程有一定借鉴意义。若研究主线聚焦介孔导电MOF、共轭框架及电化学合成，则相关性有限，可按需选读。

机械损伤后所有复合材料热导率显著下降，但愈合后恢复至原始值的90%以上，且热导率恢复程度远高于相应机械恢复。
ZnO/碳纤维/SH-PDMS在70 psi下接触热阻为0.205 K·cm2·W–1，并在LED–TIM–散热器组件中将LED最高温度从68.1 °C降至51.8 °C。

title: Overcoming Salt Precipitation in CO 2 Reduction Membrane Electrode Assembly Electrolyzer Enables Over 4200 Hours Stable Operation
abstract: ABSTRACT Alkali metal cations (AMCs) are widely recognized as critical promoters of CO 2 electroreduction. Yet, salt precipitation severely undermines membrane electrode assembly (MEA) electrolyzer stability, while limited mechanistic understanding of how the interfacial cation is sustained hinders efforts to address this challenge. Here, we reveal that sustained AMC‐enabled CO 2 reduction in MEA systems relies on a dynamic interfacial cation replenishment mechanism, in which continuous cation transport from the anolyte to the cathode compensates for the rapid depletion of interfacial cations, a process particularly pronounced in CEM–MEA systems. Guided by these insights, we demonstrate that (CH 3 ) 4 N + can serve as an effective alternative to AMCs, achieving CO 2 RR performance comparable to that of Cs + in MEA systems. Crucially, the high solubility and strong hygroscopicity of (CH 3 ) 4 NHCO 3 , together with the reduced crossover of (CH 3 ) 4 N + , effectively suppress salt precipitation. Integrating this precipitation‐free cation system with a continuous cation recovery unit enabled long‐term CO 2 electrolysis: an AEM–MEA operated continuously for over 4200 h without disassembly at 100 mA cm −2 , with the CO Faradaic efficiency (FE CO ) maintained above 90%, and a CEM–MEA operated intermittently for a cumulative 380 h at 50 mA cm −2 with FE CO above 80%. These results open a promising route toward durable, precipitation‐free CO 2 electrolysis.

title_zh: 克服CO2还原膜电极组件电解器中的盐析出实现超过4200小时稳定运行
summary_zh: 该工作揭示MEA系统中碱金属阳离子促进CO2还原依赖动态界面阳离子补充机制，阳极液到阴极的连续阳离子传输补偿界面阳离子快速消耗。提出(CH3)4N+替代碱金属阳离子，利用(CH3)4NHCO3高溶解度和强吸湿性及降低的跨膜渗透抑制盐析出，AEM-MEA在100 mA cm-2下连续运行超过4200小时，FE CO保持90%以上。
research_details_zh: 研究针对碱金属阳离子虽广泛促进CO2电还原，但盐析出严重损害膜电极组件MEA电解器稳定性，且界面阳离子如何维持的机制理解有限，阻碍解决该挑战的问题。作者揭示MEA系统中持续碱金属阳离子促进的CO2还原依赖动态界面阳离子补充机制，其中从阳极液到阴极的连续阳离子传输补偿界面阳离子的快速消耗，该过程在CEM-MEA系统中尤为明显。基于此认识，作者证明(CH3)4N+可作为碱金属阳离子的有效替代，在MEA系统中实现与Cs+相当的CO2RR性能。关键的是，(CH3)4NHCO3的高溶解度和强吸湿性，以及(CH3)4N+降低的跨膜渗透，有效抑制盐析出。将该无盐析出阳离子系统与连续阳离子回收单元集成，实现长期CO2电解：AEM-MEA在100 mA cm-2下连续运行超过4200小时无需拆卸，CO法拉第效率FE CO保持90%以上；CEM-MEA在50 mA cm-2下间歇运行累计380小时，FE CO保持80%以上。这些结果开辟了通向耐久、无盐析出CO2电解的途径。
methods_zh: 摘要明确报告：研究MEA系统中碱金属阳离子促进CO2还原的界面阳离子补充机制；比较(CH3)4N+与Cs+在MEA系统中的CO2RR性能；利用(CH3)4NHCO3的高溶解度和强吸湿性以及(CH3)4N+降低的跨膜渗透抑制盐析出；将无盐析出阳离子系统与连续阳离子回收单元集成；在AEM-MEA和CEM-MEA中分别于100 mA cm-2和50 mA cm-2下进行长期CO2电解，监测运行时间和CO法拉第效率。其他电解器结构、膜材料、阳离子浓度和表征细节摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该文与电化学合成及膜电极组装主线相关，提供克服MEA电解器盐析出的阳离子替代策略和超长稳定运行数据，对CO2电解耐久性研究有实际参考价值。局限在于摘要未报告膜材料、电解液组成、阳离子回收单元结构及盐析出表征细节，建议全文精读以核查机制证据和系统集成细节。

key_findings_zh: 揭示MEA系统中持续碱金属阳离子促进的CO2还原依赖动态界面阳离子补充机制，阳极液到阴极的连续阳离子传输补偿界面阳离子快速消耗，该过程在CEM-MEA系统中尤为明显。
(CH3)4N+可作为碱金属阳离子的有效替代，在MEA系统中实现与Cs+相当的CO2RR性能。
(CH3)4NHCO3的高溶解度和强吸湿性以及(CH3)4N+降低的跨膜渗透，有效抑制盐析出。
集成无盐析出阳离子系统与连续阳离子回收单元后，AEM-MEA在100 mA cm-2下连续运行超过4200小时无需拆卸，FE CO保持90%以上；CEM-MEA在50 mA cm-2下间歇运行累计380小时，FE CO保持80%以上。

title: Luminescence Vapochromism of a Cu(I)/Na Phosphane Iodide Assembly Based on a Secondary‐Sphere Sodium Response
abstract: ABSTRACT Photoluminescent compounds showing distinct and selective optical response to external perturbation are essential components for sensing applications. Herein, we present a copper(I) iodide–sodium luminescent complex assembled with a hybrid phosphane‐phosphinate ligand. The photoemission of the tetrametallic {Cu 2 I 2 Na 2 } aggregate is consistent with the thermally activated delayed fluorescence that originates from the [CuI(phosphane)] motifs but strongly depends on the coordination environment of sodium ions completed by O‐donor solvent molecules, Na–π(phenyl) interactions, and/or Na–I bonds. The reversible removal and vapor‐phase addition of methanol, ethanol, water, and dimethoxyethane as Na‐bound ligands alter the solid‐state luminescence from blue (461 nm) to yellow (570 nm) with quantum yields reaching 0.73. Importantly, different photoemission responses to methanol (522 nm) and ethanol (492 nm) are complemented by preferred binding of methanol and its detection in up to 1:10 methanol:ethanol mixtures. Variations of luminescence among the studied solvates are attributed to the alterations of secondary sphere interactions involving sodium ions and illustrate a new approach to stimuli‐responsive metal complexes constructed from soft‐hard donor ligands.
