title_zh: 共价有机框架聚酰胺纳米复合膜：从化学与结构调控到高效水分离
summary_zh: 本文综述了COF基聚酰胺纳米复合膜在水分离领域的研究进展，聚焦COF结构设计、掺入策略、调控机制及膜结构-分离性能关系。COF的有序晶体结构和可调孔道功能为聚酰胺膜提供分子级调控机会，协同提升水渗透性、溶质截留、抗污染性和结构稳定性。
research_details_zh: 研究针对聚酰胺复合膜在脱盐和废水回收中存在的渗透性与选择性权衡、小分子中性溶质截留不足、易污染和化学稳定性差等固有局限，系统综述COF基聚酰胺纳米复合膜的研究进展。COF具有有序晶体结构、可调孔道功能和化学稳定性，为聚酰胺膜的分子级调控提供机遇。将COF纳米材料引入聚酰胺层可构建有序传输通道，实现快速水渗透和选择性溶质筛分；COF填料还作为界面改性剂，在界面聚合过程中调控单体扩散和聚酰胺交联，重塑膜物理化学性质。这些协同效应同时改善水渗透通量、溶质截留率、抗污染性和结构稳定性。综述重点讨论COF结构设计、掺入策略、调控机制以及膜结构与分离性能之间的关系，并指出界面化学、规模化制备和长期稳定性方面的关键挑战及未来研究方向。
methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的方法包括：COF纳米材料的合成与结构设计；将COF掺入聚酰胺层的方法；界面聚合过程中COF对单体扩散和交联的调控；膜结构表征与分离性能测试；水渗透性、溶质截留、抗污染性和稳定性评价。
relevance_zh: 该综述聚焦COF在聚酰胺膜中的应用，与共轭COF框架材料主线直接相关，系统总结了COF结构设计与膜性能关系，对理解COF在实际分离应用中的价值有参考意义。但作为综述，缺乏原始实验数据，适合作为背景阅读而非精读对象。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，关键细节如具体COF种类、掺入量、膜制备条件、性能数值及长期稳定性数据均需查阅原文综述内容。
key_findings_zh: COF的有序晶体结构和可调孔道功能可实现聚酰胺膜的分子级调控，构建有序传输通道
COF填料作为界面改性剂可调控单体扩散和聚酰胺交联，重塑膜物理化学性质
COF引入协同提升水渗透性、溶质截留、抗污染性和结构稳定性
界面化学、规模化制备和长期稳定性仍是实际应用的关键挑战

title: Programmable mesoporous carbon architectures from liquefied wood via reactive-emulsion-mediated self-assembly
abstract: Abstract Developing biomass-derived programmable self-assembly systems for precise control of carbon morphology and architecture remains challenging, primarily because of the intrinsic heterogeneity that hinders controllable assembly. Here, we report a biomass-enabled reactive-emulsion-mediated strategy for converting liquefied wood into various mesoporous carbon nanomaterials. This synthesis features the introduction of trioctyl phosphate (TOP) as a hydrophobic swelling agent for composite micelles and an interfacial modifier, shifting the preferred micelle curvature/packing tendency and biasing the assembly pathway from homogeneous aqueous self-assembly toward interface-associated anisotropic organization. This coupled regulation progressively reduces the density of ordered mesochannels within the fibrous framework and promotes the evolution from ordered mesoporous nanofibers to hollow nanofibers and bowl-like architectures. The fabricated hollow carbon nanofiber-based mixed ion-electron thermoelectric generator (MTEG) exhibits a high thermopower of 12.33 mV K –1 (across 40 kΩ). This strategy provides a versatile route for constructing biomass-derived mesoporous carbon materials with tunable morphologies and pore architectures.

title_zh: 液化木材经反应性乳液介导自组装制备可编程介孔碳结构
summary_zh: 本研究提出一种生物质驱动的反应性乳液介导策略，将液化木材转化为多种介孔碳纳米材料。通过引入磷酸三辛酯调控胶束曲率与堆积倾向，实现从有序介孔纳米纤维到空心纳米纤维及碗状结构的形貌演化，所得空心碳纳米纤维基混合离子电子热电器件具有高热电势。
research_details_zh: 研究针对生物质衍生可编程自组装体系难以精确控制碳形貌与架构的问题，提出以液化木材为碳源的反应性乳液介导合成策略。材料体系涉及复合胶束、磷酸三辛酯疏水溶胀剂及界面改性剂，设计策略是通过调控胶束曲率与堆积倾向，使组装路径从均相水相自组装转向界面相关的各向异性组织。研究过程表明，这种耦合调控逐步降低纤维骨架内有序介孔通道密度，促进形貌从有序介孔纳米纤维向空心纳米纤维和碗状结构演化。该策略为构建形貌和孔结构可调的生物质基介孔碳材料提供了通用途径，对可持续纳米碳材料合成具有方法学意义。
methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的合成方法为反应性乳液介导自组装，以液化木材为前驱体，引入磷酸三辛酯作为疏水溶胀剂和界面改性剂。表征与性能测试方面，摘要报告了所得碳纳米材料的形貌演化观察，以及基于空心碳纳米纤维的混合离子电子热电器件的热电势测试。具体表征手段如电子显微镜、氮气吸附等细节摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该研究为介孔碳材料的形貌与孔结构可控制备提供了生物质基新路线，与介孔材料及自组装技术主线高度契合。其反应性乳液介导策略可能对框架材料的组装设计有借鉴价值，但材料体系为碳而非MOF/COF，相关性为拓展层面。建议精读以获取组装机制细节，但需注意摘要未报告孔径分布、比表面积等定量孔结构数据。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅依据摘要内容整理。热电势数值和形貌演化结论来自摘要明确报告，但具体合成条件、表征手段、孔径参数、器件结构细节及稳定性数据均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 引入磷酸三辛酯作为疏水溶胀剂和界面改性剂，可改变胶束曲率与堆积倾向，使组装从均相水相自组装转向界面相关各向异性组织。
耦合调控逐步降低纤维骨架内有序介孔通道密度，驱动形貌从有序介孔纳米纤维演化为空心纳米纤维和碗状结构。
基于空心碳纳米纤维的混合离子电子热电器件在40 kΩ下表现出12.33 mV K⁻¹的高热电势。

title: Conformation‐Locking in Thiazole‐Rich Mixed‐Linkage Covalent Organic Frameworks for Spontaneous Exciton Dissociation and Efficient Photocatalysis
abstract: ABSTRACT The formidable exciton effect inherent in organic semiconductors fundamentally restricts free charge carrier generation, thereby impeding photocatalytic redox efficiency. Facilitating spontaneous exciton dissociation and lowering exciton binding energy are essential for maximizing charge utilization. Herein, we report a conformation‐locking strategy to engineer a thiazole‐rich mixed‐linkage donor–acceptor conjugated covalent organic framework (SBt‐Tapt) via post‐synthetic cyclization. The seamless integration of sulfur heteroatoms into a rigid, thiazole‐bridged framework significantly enhances π‐conjugated and electronic polarizability. Crucially, this structural reinforcement lowers the exciton activation energy below to 25 meV, triggering spontaneous exciton dissociation, extending carrier lifetimes, and yielding a proliferation of free charge carriers at room temperature. Mechanistic insights elucidate that the thiazole moieties synergistically activate adjacent phenyl units for O 2 reduction while simultaneously lowering the energy barrier for H 2 O oxidation at benzothiophene sites. This dual‐pathway mechanism drives efficient H 2 O 2 photosynthesis with robust operational stability exceeding 100 h. Notably, utilizing phenolic pollutants as proton donors, SBt‐Tapt delivers an exceptional H 2 O 2 evolution rate of 8.99 mmol g cat −1 h −1 alongside effective pollutant mineralization. This study elucidates a profound structure–activity relationship (SAR) and establishes conformation locking as a potent excitonic engineering paradigm for developing high performance organic photocatalysts.

title_zh: 噻唑丰富混合连接共价有机框架中的构象锁定用于自发激子解离和高效光催化
summary_zh: 本研究提出构象锁定策略，通过后合成环化构建富含噻唑的混合连接供体-受体共轭共价有机框架SBt-Tapt。该策略将硫杂原子整合入刚性噻唑桥连框架，增强π共轭和电子极化率，将激子活化能降至25 meV以下，实现自发激子解离和高效H₂O₂光合作用。
research_details_zh: 研究针对有机半导体中强激子效应限制自由载流子生成、阻碍光催化氧化还原效率的问题，提出构象锁定策略。材料体系为噻唑丰富的混合连接供体-受体共轭共价有机框架SBt-Tapt，通过后合成环化制备。设计策略是将硫杂原子无缝整合入刚性噻唑桥连框架，以增强π共轭和电子极化率。研究过程表明，这种结构强化将激子活化能降至25 meV以下，触发自发激子解离，延长载流子寿命，在室温下产生大量自由载流子。机制研究阐明噻唑部分协同激活相邻苯基单元用于O₂还原，同时降低苯并噻吩位点H₂O氧化的能垒，双路径机制驱动高效H₂O₂光合作用，运行稳定性超过100小时。
methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的合成方法为后合成环化策略，用于构建噻唑丰富的混合连接供体-受体共价有机框架SBt-Tapt。表征与测试方面，摘要报告了激子活化能测量、载流子寿命测试、光催化H₂O₂生成性能测试、污染物矿化测试以及运行稳定性测试。具体光谱表征、电化学测试等细节摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该研究与共轭COF及导电框架材料主线高度契合，构象锁定策略为激子工程提供了新范式，对光催化应用有重要价值。摘要明确报告了激子活化能、H₂O₂生成速率和稳定性等关键定量数据，结构-性能关系清晰，值得全文精读。但需注意摘要未报告材料电导率、比表面积、孔径等框架材料常规表征数据。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅依据摘要内容整理。激子活化能、H₂O₂生成速率和稳定性数据来自摘要明确报告，但具体合成条件、环化效率、光谱表征、能带结构、活性位点定量分析等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 构象锁定策略将激子活化能降至25 meV以下，触发自发激子解离并延长载流子寿命，室温下产生大量自由载流子。
噻唑部分协同激活相邻苯基单元用于O₂还原，同时降低苯并噻吩位点H₂O氧化能垒，形成双路径H₂O₂光合作用机制。
以酚类污染物为质子供体时，SBt-Tapt实现8.99 mmol g_cat⁻¹ h⁻¹的H₂O₂生成速率，同时有效矿化污染物。
SBt-Tapt在H₂O₂光合作用中表现出超过100小时的稳健运行稳定性。

title: Solar‐Powered Water Depollution Through a Bioinspired Device Based on ZIF‐8 Loaded Macroporous Hydrogels Prepared via Ice‐Templating
abstract: ABSTRACT Water pollution poses a constant threat to the environment and is one of the central causes for global shortage of clean water. Metal–Organic Frameworks (MOFs) have emerged as highly efficient adsorbents; however, their application is limited by their common production as fine powders, which hinders recovery and reuse. Here, we report a bioinspired strategy to overcome this limitation by embedding high loadings of ZIF‐8 microparticles (up to 90 wt%) within macroporous polysaccharide hydrogels prepared via ice‐templating and topotactic Ca 2 + crosslinking. The resulting monoliths exhibit highly aligned microporous channels and homogeneously distributed ZIF‐8 particles whose crystallinity and microporosity are preserved. The polysaccharide/ZIF‐8 hydrogel showed superior adsorption for methylene blue (MB) and methyl orange (MO) compared to bare polysaccharide hydrogel, while being easier to recover and recycle than ZIF‐8 powder offering recyclability and structural integrity over multiple cycles. Under simulated solar irradiation, the hydrogels achieve up to 76% degradation of MB within 2 h. Finally, integration of a carbon‐based paper on top of the hydrogel, working as a highly efficient vapor generator, drives the water transport through the device, enabling the design of a solar‐powered depollution device that simultaneously purifies contaminated water and generates clean condensed water. This scalable, eco‐compatible approach opens new perspectives for multifunctional MOF–biopolymer architectures in sustainable water treatment technologies.

title_zh: 基于冰模板法制备的ZIF-8负载大孔水凝胶的生物启发太阳能水净化器件
summary_zh: 本研究通过冰模板法和拓扑Ca²⁺交联制备负载高达90 wt% ZIF-8微粒的大孔多糖水凝胶整体材料。所得材料保持ZIF-8结晶性和微孔性，对亚甲基蓝和甲基橙的吸附性能优于纯多糖水凝胶，在模拟太阳光照射下2小时内实现76%的亚甲基蓝降解，并集成碳基纸实现太阳能驱动水净化。
research_details_zh: 研究针对MOF粉末形态限制其回收和再利用的问题，提出生物启发策略，将高负载量ZIF-8微粒嵌入大孔多糖水凝胶中。材料体系为ZIF-8/多糖复合水凝胶，通过冰模板法和拓扑Ca²⁺交联制备。设计策略是利用冰模板形成高度取向的微孔通道，并通过Ca²⁺交联维持结构完整性，实现ZIF-8颗粒的均匀分布。研究过程表明，所得整体材料中ZIF-8的结晶性和微孔性得到保持，对亚甲基蓝和甲基橙的吸附性能优于纯多糖水凝胶，且比ZIF-8粉末更易回收和循环使用。在模拟太阳光照射下，水凝胶在2小时内实现76%的亚甲基蓝降解。进一步集成碳基纸作为蒸汽发生器，驱动水传输，实现同时净化污染水和产生清洁冷凝水的太阳能驱动净化器件。
methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的制备方法为冰模板法和拓扑Ca²⁺交联，用于构建负载ZIF-8的大孔多糖水凝胶。表征方面，摘要报告了ZIF-8结晶性和微孔性的保持、颗粒分布均匀性以及高度取向微孔通道的形成。性能测试包括亚甲基蓝和甲基橙吸附测试、模拟太阳光下降解测试、循环使用测试以及太阳能驱动水净化器件性能测试。具体吸附容量数值、孔径分布等细节摘要未报告。
relevance_zh: 该研究将MOF与生物聚合物水凝胶结合，解决了MOF粉末回收难题，对框架材料的宏观组装和实际应用有重要参考价值。冰模板法作为自组装技术的一种，与本研究主线相关。摘要报告了负载量、降解效率等关键数据，但缺乏吸附容量、循环次数等定量细节，建议精读以评估其实际应用潜力。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅依据摘要内容整理。ZIF-8负载量、降解效率等数据来自摘要明确报告，但具体吸附容量、循环次数、孔径分布、机械强度、水蒸发速率等关键参数均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 冰模板法和拓扑Ca²⁺交联可制备负载高达90 wt% ZIF-8微粒的大孔多糖水凝胶，ZIF-8结晶性和微孔性得到保持。
多糖/ZIF-8水凝胶对亚甲基蓝和甲基橙的吸附性能优于纯多糖水凝胶，且比ZIF-8粉末更易回收和循环使用。
在模拟太阳光照射下，水凝胶在2小时内实现76%的亚甲基蓝降解。
集成碳基纸作为蒸汽发生器，可实现同时净化污染水和产生清洁冷凝水的太阳能驱动净化功能。

title: Active Learning‐Accelerated Discovery of Antifungal Polymers With Self‐Assembly Capacity for Tackling Invasive Fungal Diseases
abstract: ABSTRACT Invasive fungal diseases (IFD) are life‐threatening infections with limited clinical management. Antifungal peptide (AFP)‐mimicking polymers are promising candidates for tackling IFD. However, due to the structural diversity of polymers, it remains a great challenge to discover new polymers with potent antifungal activity and biocompatibility. Herein, we propose a novel active learning‐guided framework PolyCAML for accelerated discovery of antifungal polymers. Inspired by AFPs, we construct a quaternary copolymer library comprising 516,114 combinations with different side chains. By integrating automated synthesis platform, Graph Transformer machine learning model, and greedy algorithm, 11 top‐performing candidates are screened via the Design‐Build‐Test‐Learn (DBTL) intelligent iterative workflow within merely 18 days. Through further data mining, key factors that influence antifungal potency and biocompatibility of polymers are identified. By more rigorous biological evaluation, four target polymers are screened, exhibiting a minimum fungicidal concentration ≤ 8 µg/mL and a 50% inhibitory concentration of L929 cells ≥ 512 µg/mL. These polymers are self‐assembled into positively charged nanoparticles for delivering fluconazole, which exhibit synergistic anti‐biofilm activity by enhanced biofilm penetration. The in vivo therapeutic efficacy is confirmed by a fungemia model and a fungal keratitis model. Overall, we establish a multi‐task intelligent prediction platform PolyCAML to discover antifungal polymers for tackling IFD.

title_zh: 主动学习加速发现具有自组装能力的抗真菌聚合物以应对侵袭性真菌疾病
summary_zh: 该研究提出主动学习框架PolyCAML，结合自动化合成、图Transformer模型和贪心算法，在18天内从516114种四元共聚物组合中筛选出高效抗真菌聚合物。四种目标聚合物具有低杀菌浓度和高生物相容性，可自组装为纳米颗粒递送氟康唑，并在体内模型中验证了协同抗生物膜疗效。
research_details_zh: 研究针对侵袭性真菌疾病临床管理有限的问题，聚焦抗真菌肽模拟聚合物的发现。由于聚合物结构多样性，传统方法难以高效筛选兼具抗真菌活性和生物相容性的候选物。作者受天然抗真菌肽启发，构建了包含516114种不同侧链组合的四元共聚物库。通过集成自动化合成平台、图Transformer机器学习模型和贪心算法，采用设计-构建-测试-学习智能迭代工作流，仅用18天筛选出11个高性能候选物。进一步数据挖掘识别出影响抗真菌效力和生物相容性的关键因素。经更严格的生物学评估，筛出四种目标聚合物，其最低杀菌浓度不超过8微克/毫升，对L929细胞的半数抑制浓度不低于512微克/毫升。这些聚合物自组装成带正电荷的纳米颗粒用于递送氟康唑，通过增强生物膜穿透表现出协同抗生物膜活性。体内疗效通过真菌血症模型和真菌性角膜炎模型得到确认。该工作建立了多任务智能预测平台PolyCAML，为应对侵袭性真菌疾病提供新策略。
methods_zh: 研究采用主动学习框架PolyCAML，构建四元共聚物库，集成自动化合成平台进行聚合物制备，使用图Transformer机器学习模型进行性能预测，结合贪心算法进行候选筛选。通过设计-构建-测试-学习智能迭代工作流加速发现过程。对筛选出的聚合物进行生物学评估，包括最低杀菌浓度和细胞毒性测试。自组装纳米颗粒的制备及氟康唑递送实验，以及抗生物膜活性评价。体内疗效通过真菌血症模型和真菌性角膜炎模型验证。
relevance_zh: 该研究与自组装技术主题直接相关，展示了聚合物自组装纳米颗粒在药物递送中的应用价值。主动学习加速材料发现的方法论对框架材料的智能筛选具有借鉴意义。虽然研究对象是共聚物而非导电MOF或共轭框架，但其设计-构建-测试-学习工作流和自组装策略值得关注。建议精读以获取主动学习框架和自组装递送体系的详细设计思路。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。摘要未报告聚合物的具体化学结构、自组装纳米颗粒的尺寸和形貌表征数据、氟康唑载药量和释放行为、体内实验的具体给药方案和统计细节，以及关键影响因素的具体化学含义。这些细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 四种目标聚合物表现出最低杀菌浓度不超过8微克/毫升，对L929细胞半数抑制浓度不低于512微克/毫升
聚合物自组装为带正电荷纳米颗粒递送氟康唑，通过增强生物膜穿透实现协同抗生物膜活性
体内疗效在真菌血症模型和真菌性角膜炎模型中得到确认
数据挖掘识别出影响抗真菌效力和生物相容性的关键因素，但具体因素内容摘要未报告

title: Bimetallic Conductive Co/Fe‐HITP for Sensitive H 2 S Detection at Low Temperature
abstract: ABSTRACT The metal nodes in conductive metal‐organic (c‐MOFs) play a crucial role in determining surface chemical activity. Tuning the metal sites of Co 3 (HITP) 2 is expected to enhance its low‐temperature gas sensing performance. Here, a series of bimetallic Co/Fe‐HITP materials are synthesized by partially substituting Co with Fe ions at varying Fe/Co ratios. Gas sensing tests reveal that the Fe incorporation not only improves the response of H 2 S at low temperature but also reduces the fluctuations caused by low temperatures. The optimal Co 1.5 Fe 1.5 ‐HITP 9.5 sensor delivers a response of 10.05 toward 20 ppm H 2 S at room temperature (25°C) and 9.69 at a refrigerating temperature (0°C), with corresponding LODs of 18.9 ppb and 16.8 ppb, respectively. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations on Co‐HITP, Co 2 Fe 1 ‐HITP 9.5 , and Co 1 Fe 2 ‐HITP 9.5 show that increasing the Fe content leads to a larger absolute adsorption energy, rationalizing the enhanced low‐temperature sensing performance. Furthermore, band structure analysis elucidates the origin of the higher surface catalytic activity upon Fe substitution. This work establishes bimetallic Co/Fe‐HITP as a promising platform for sensitive, low‐temperature H 2 S detection.

title_zh: 双金属导电Co/Fe-HITP用于低温下灵敏检测H2S
summary_zh: 该研究通过部分取代Co离子合成系列双金属Co/Fe-HITP导电MOF材料。Fe掺入改善了低温H2S传感性能，最优Co1.5Fe1.5-HITP在室温和0摄氏度下对20 ppm H2S分别响应10.05和9.69，检测限达18.9 ppb和16.8 ppb。DFT计算揭示Fe含量增加导致更大吸附能，解释了低温传感性能增强机制。
research_details_zh: 研究聚焦导电金属有机框架中金属节点对表面化学活性的决定性作用。以Co3(HITP)2为基础，通过部分取代Co离子合成不同Fe/Co比例的双金属Co/Fe-HITP材料系列。研究问题是Fe取代能否增强低温柔性气体传感性能。气敏测试表明Fe掺入不仅提高了低温下对H2S的响应，还减少了低温引起的信号波动。最优Co1.5Fe1.5-HITP传感器在室温25摄氏度下对20 ppm H2S响应为10.05，在0摄氏度下响应为9.69，对应检测限分别为18.9 ppb和16.8 ppb。密度泛函理论计算对Co-HITP、Co2Fe1-HITP和Co1Fe2-HITP进行分析，显示Fe含量增加导致绝对吸附能增大，从理论上解释了低温传感性能增强的原因。能带结构分析阐明了Fe取代后表面催化活性提高的起源。该工作确立了双金属Co/Fe-HITP作为低温灵敏H2S检测的可行平台。
methods_zh: 研究通过部分取代Co离子合成不同Fe/Co比例的双金属Co/Fe-HITP材料系列。采用气敏测试评估材料对H2S的响应性能，测试条件包括室温25摄氏度和低温0摄氏度。使用密度泛函理论计算对Co-HITP、Co2Fe1-HITP和Co1Fe2-HITP进行吸附能分析，并通过能带结构分析研究电子结构变化。检测限通过气敏响应数据计算获得。
relevance_zh: 该研究与介孔导电MOF和导电框架材料主题高度相关，直接涉及导电MOF金属节点调控与气敏性能优化。双金属策略为导电MOF功能化提供了可行路径，低温传感性能对实际应用具有价值。DFT计算与实验结合的研究范式值得借鉴。建议精读以获取详细的合成条件、传感测试方法和DFT计算细节。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。摘要未报告Co/Fe-HITP的晶体结构表征数据、比表面积和孔径分布、H2S传感的选择性测试结果、响应恢复时间、湿度影响、DFT计算的具体泛函和模型细节，以及不同Fe/Co比例样品的完整性能对比数据。这些关键细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 最优Co1.5Fe1.5-HITP传感器在25摄氏度下对20 ppm H2S响应为10.05，在0摄氏度下响应为9.69
Co1.5Fe1.5-HITP在室温和0摄氏度下对H2S的检测限分别为18.9 ppb和16.8 ppb
DFT计算显示Fe含量增加导致绝对吸附能增大，从理论上解释了低温传感性能增强

title: Metal-free redox active covalent organic frameworks for electrocatalytic oxygen reduction reaction
abstract: Designing efficient, metal-free covalent organic framework (COF) electrocatalysts is a promising strategy for the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) due to their structural tunability and stability. Herein, we report two redox-active donor–acceptor COFs, TAPA-DHTD and TTT-DHTD, incorporating a thiophene-based dithiophenedione (DHTD) unit. Among them, TTT-DHTD exhibits superior ORR performance with a half-wave potential (E 1/2 ) of 0.82 V vs RHE, approaching that of 20% Pt/C (0.85 V) and surpassing most reported metal-free COFs. It also demonstrates excellent methanol tolerance and long-term durability, maintaining activity over 120 hours. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that the donor–acceptor framework optimizes the p -band center, enhances charge separation, and improves adsorption of oxygenated intermediates, thereby accelerating ORR kinetics. This work provides a rational strategy for designing durable, high-performance metal-free electrocatalysts for sustainable energy applications.

title_zh: 无金属氧化还原活性共价有机框架用于电催化氧还原反应
summary_zh: 报道两种含噻吩基二噻吩二酮单元的氧化还原活性供体-受体COF（TAPA-DHTD和TTT-DHTD）。其中TTT-DHTD表现出优异ORR性能，半波电位0.82 V vs RHE，接近20% Pt/C（0.85 V），并具有优异甲醇耐受性和超过120小时的长期稳定性。DFT计算揭示供体-受体框架优化p带中心、增强电荷分离并改善含氧中间体吸附，加速ORR动力学。

title: Lignin-degrading-inspired dehydrogenative photocatalysis via reductive quenching of donor-acceptor covalent organic framework
abstract: Achieving a photocatalytic reductive quenching cycle that enables direct oxidation of the photocatalyst radical anion by H(I) species, without requiring stoichiometric oxidants or cocatalysts, remains a long-standing challenge in artificial photoredox catalysis. Here we report a bioinspired approach based on the lignin-degrading-mediated proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) process, implemented through a perylene-based covalent organic framework (NPy-Per-COF) with precisely engineered donor-acceptor characteristics. This heterogeneous photocatalyst sustains a reductive quenching cycle in which controlled radical generation, catalyst regeneration and hydrogen evolution are intrinsically coupled. The system enables dehydrogenative radical cascade reactions between lignin-inspired precursors and structurally diverse unsaturated partners, providing access to a broad range of functionalized aromatic architectures. Further synthetic modifications and in silico analyses confirm the biological relevance and medicinal potential of the synthesized scaffolds. Beyond model substrates, the photocatalytic system can be extended to lignin-derived motifs, highlighting its potential relevance to complex biomass-related chemical space. Mechanistic investigations support the view that donor-acceptor polarization within the COF promotes efficient charge separation, stabilizes the photocatalyst radical anion and facilitates a PCET-initiated reductive quenching cycle. By abstracting and translating key elements of enzymatic redox control into a fully artificial, heterogeneous photocatalytic framework, this work establishes mechanistically informed design guideline for photocatalytic reductive quenching cycle and advances the development of bioinspired systems for controlled dehydrogenative transformations.

title_zh: 受木质素降解启发的脱氢光催化：供体-受体共价有机框架的还原猝灭机制
summary_zh: 报道一种基于苝的供体-受体COF（NPy-Per-COF），模拟木质素降解中的质子耦合电子转移（PCET）过程，实现无需化学计量氧化剂或助催化剂的光催化还原猝灭循环。该体系将自由基生成、催化剂再生和析氢内在耦合，实现木质素启发前体与不饱和底物的脱氢自由基级联反应，并拓展至木质素衍生基元。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于实现光催化还原猝灭循环，使光催化剂自由基阴离子能被H(I)物种直接氧化，无需化学计量氧化剂或助催化剂，这是人工光氧化还原催化的长期挑战。材料体系为基于苝的供体-受体COF（NPy-Per-COF），通过精确设计供体-受体特性实现仿生功能。设计策略借鉴木质素降解介导的PCET过程，将酶促氧化还原控制的关键要素抽象并转化为全人工异相光催化框架。研究过程包括合成该COF、验证其维持还原猝灭循环的能力（自由基生成、催化剂再生和析氢内在耦合）、实现脱氢自由基级联反应、进行合成修饰和计算分析验证生物相关性及药用潜力，并将体系拓展至木质素衍生基元。机制研究支持供体-受体极化促进电荷分离、稳定光催化剂自由基阴离子并促进PCET引发的还原猝灭循环。该研究为光催化还原猝灭循环提供了机制指导的设计准则，推进了仿生系统在受控脱氢转化中的发展。
methods_zh: 摘要明确提及合成了基于苝的供体-受体COF（NPy-Per-COF），但未报告具体合成条件。性能测试包括光催化脱氢自由基级联反应评估，涉及木质素启发前体与不饱和底物的反应。机制研究采用实验和计算相结合的方法，包括合成修饰、in silico分析以及机制研究以验证电荷分离和PCET过程。摘要未报告COF的结构表征方法（如X射线衍射、氮气吸附）、光催化反应的具体条件（光源、溶剂、温度）以及析氢的定量数据。

该体系实现木质素启发前体与结构多样的不饱和伙伴之间的脱氢自由基级联反应，获得多种功能化芳香骨架

title: Ultralow‐Dose Direct Photopatterning of Metal–Organic Frameworks for Scalable Device Integration
abstract: ABSTRACT The integration of metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) into microelectronic and optoelectronic devices requires patterning strategies that combine high sensitivity, structural preservation, and compatibility with scalable fabrication. Direct optical patterning offers a photoresist‐free route to achieve this, yet existing approaches are limited by inefficient photochemical processes that require high irradiation doses, thereby constraining throughput and risking material degradation. Here, we report an ultralow‐dose direct patterning for MOFs that enables high‐fidelity feature definition at exposure doses down to 0.6 mJ cm −2 . The approach relies on a molecularly engineered thiol–ene click‐induced crosslinking mechanism that generates strong solubility contrast under light irradiation, allowing negative‐tone pattern formation while preserving the intrinsic crystallinity and porosity of MOFs. By establishing a structure‐excitation‐reactivity relationship, we identify key molecular parameters governing photopatterning sensitivity, enabling rational tuning of the process. The resulting platform supports large‐area, multipixel patterning on rigid and flexible substrates and enables direct integration of patterned MOF films into diffraction grating‐based photonic devices. This study introduces a molecularly guided photochemical design principle for low‐dose photopatterning, providing a platform for the scalable integration of MOFs into next‐generation electronic and photonic devices.

title_zh: 超低剂量金属有机框架直接光图案化用于可扩展器件集成

title: Precise size-matching of platinum nanoparticles in pyrene-based covalent organic frameworks for pH-universal hydrogen evolution
abstract: Abstract Hydrogen is a promising clean energy carrier, and electrocatalytic water splitting via the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) represents a sustainable production strategy. While platinum nanoparticles (PtNPs) typically exhibit superior HER performance, their immobilization requires meticulous consideration due to an inherent aggregation tendency in solution. In this work, precise size-control of PtNPs was achieved by employing pyrene-based covalent organic frameworks (COFs) as effective hosts. Two COFs with similar mesoporous skeletons (IL-COF-2 and Azo-COF) and their sulfur-rich derivatives (TIL-COF-2 and TAzo-COF) were synthesized. These COFs feature ordered one-dimensional channels with diameters between 2.4 and 2.9 nm. Benefiting from the synergistic effects of spatial confinement and heteroatomic interactions, ultrafine PtNPs were uniformly immobilized within these COFs, with average particles sizes ranging from 1.7 to 1.9 nm. The resulting Pt@COFs all demonstrated excellent catalytic activities across a universal pH range, including acidic (0.5 M H2SO4), alkaline (1 M KOH) and neutral (1 M phosphate buffered saline (PBS)) media. Among them, the heteroatom-rich Pt@TAzo-COF exhibited the most outstanding HER performance. This study realizes the precise size-matching between PtNPs and COFs, providing a robust strategy for effective Pt immobilization and enhanced pH-universal HER efficiency.

title_zh: 基于芘的共价有机框架中铂纳米颗粒的精确尺寸匹配用于全pH析氢反应
summary_zh: 本研究利用两种芘基介孔COF及其富硫衍生物作为主体，通过空间限域和杂原子相互作用的协同效应，将铂纳米颗粒（PtNPs）均匀固定并精确控制尺寸至1.7–1.9 nm。所得Pt@COFs在酸性、碱性和中性介质中均表现出优异的析氢反应催化活性，其中富硫的Pt@TAzo-COF性能最佳。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于铂纳米颗粒在溶液中易团聚、难以有效固定并保持高HER性能的挑战。材料体系为两种具有相似介孔骨架的芘基COF（IL-COF-2和Azo-COF）及其硫代衍生物（TIL-COF-2和TAzo-COF），这些COF具有有序一维孔道，直径在2.4至2.9 nm之间。设计策略是利用COF的介孔通道作为纳米反应器，通过空间限域效应和骨架中杂原子（如硫）与铂的相互作用，实现PtNPs的尺寸精确控制和均匀分散。研究过程包括合成四种COF主体、在其孔道内原位生长PtNPs，并系统评估所得Pt@COFs在0.5 M H2SO4、1 M KOH和1 M PBS中的HER催化性能。该研究的意义在于实现了PtNPs与COF孔道之间的精确尺寸匹配，为高效铂固定和全pH范围HER电催化提供了一种稳健的材料设计策略。
methods_zh: 合成了两种芘基COF（IL-COF-2和Azo-COF）及其硫代衍生物（TIL-COF-2和TAzo-COF），利用其有序一维介孔通道（直径2.4–2.9 nm）作为主体。通过原位生长方法将PtNPs负载于COF孔道内，形成Pt@COFs复合材料。采用透射电子显微镜等手段表征PtNPs的粒径和分布（平均尺寸1.7–1.9 nm）。电化学性能测试在0.5 M H2SO4、1 M KOH和1 M PBS三种电解液中进行，评估HER催化活性。
relevance_zh: 该研究直接契合介孔导电MOF/COF框架材料在电催化领域的应用主线，展示了介孔COF作为纳米限域平台精确调控金属纳米颗粒尺寸的可行性，对设计高效全pH析氢电催化剂具有实际参考价值。摘要未报告具体过电位、塔菲尔斜率或稳定性数据，建议全文精读以获取定量性能指标和结构-性能关联的详细证据。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。摘要未报告PtNPs的详细负载量、具体HER过电位和塔菲尔斜率数值、长期稳定性测试结果、COF的比表面积和孔容数据，以及PtNPs与COF骨架之间相互作用的直接光谱证据，这些关键细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: PtNPs在COF内平均粒径范围为1.7至1.9 nm，实现了尺寸的精确控制。
所得Pt@COFs在酸性（0.5 M H2SO4）、碱性（1 M KOH）和中性（1 M PBS）介质中均表现出优异的HER催化活性。
富杂原子的Pt@TAzo-COF在所有样品中展现出最优异的HER性能。
空间限域与杂原子相互作用的协同效应是PtNPs均匀固定和尺寸控制的关键机制。

title: Ultrasound‐Triggered Heterojunction Helices With Inverted Supramolecular Chirality and Significantly Amplified Circularly Polarized Luminescence
abstract: ABSTRACT Developing circularly polarized luminescence (CPL) materials with large luminescent dissymmetry factors ( g lum ) through hierarchical self‐assembly remains a significant challenge. Herein, we report an ultrasound‐triggered hierarchical assembly strategy that enables the construction of heterojunction helices exhibiting inverted supramolecular chirality and substantially amplified CPL. A tetraphenylethylene‐alanine derivative forms chiral nanohelices upon heating‐cooling in DMSO. The addition of MeCN promotes the growth of nanohelices along with residual monomers into microhelices. Notably, ultrasound following MeCN addition induces reorganization at the termini of the nanohelices, leading to heterojunction helices composed of core and dendritic helical subunits with opposite handedness. These heterojunction helices display inverted and amplified CPL, with a g lum value of 0.2 and a fluorescence quantum yield of 50%. Experimental and density functional theory calculations suggest that the ultrasound mechanical force changes the types of hydrogen bonds within extended monomers, thereby redirecting the self‐assembly pathway from the ends of nanohelices and newly generated folded monomers. Enhanced interchromophoric interactions and well‐ordered dendritic helices contribute to the inversion and amplification of CPL. This study not only presents the first example of heterojunction helices derived from the same chiral molecule but also provides new insights into an ultrasound‐triggered pathway for amplifying CPL via hierarchical assembly.

title_zh: 超声触发异质结螺旋体：倒转的超分子手性与显著放大的圆偏振发光
summary_zh: 本研究报道了一种超声触发的层级自组装策略，利用四苯乙烯-丙氨酸衍生物构建了具有倒转超分子手性和显著放大圆偏振发光（CPL）的异质结螺旋体。该螺旋体由相反手性的核和树枝状亚基组成，g_lum值达0.2，荧光量子产率为50%。超声机械力改变氢键类型，重定向自组装路径。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于通过层级自组装构建具有大发光不对称因子（g_lum）的CPL材料这一挑战。材料体系为四苯乙烯-丙氨酸衍生物，在DMSO中通过加热-冷却形成手性纳米螺旋体。设计策略是结合溶剂调控（加入MeCN促进纳米螺旋体与残余单体生长为微螺旋体）和超声触发（诱导纳米螺旋体末端重组），从而构建由相反手性的核和树枝状螺旋亚基组成的异质结螺旋体。研究过程包括：首先制备手性纳米螺旋体，然后加入MeCN促进生长，最后施加超声处理引发末端重组，形成异质结结构。实验和DFT计算表明，超声机械力改变了扩展单体中氢键的类型，从而将自组装路径从纳米螺旋体末端重定向，产生新折叠的单体。增强的分子间发色团相互作用和有序树枝状螺旋体共同导致了CPL的倒转和放大。该研究首次报道了由同一手性分子衍生的异质结螺旋体，为通过层级组装放大CPL提供了超声触发的新途径。
methods_zh: 采用四苯乙烯-丙氨酸衍生物，在DMSO中通过加热-冷却过程形成手性纳米螺旋体。加入MeCN促进纳米螺旋体与残余单体生长为微螺旋体。随后施加超声处理，诱导纳米螺旋体末端重组，构建异质结螺旋体。通过圆偏振发光光谱测量g_lum值和荧光量子产率，并结合密度泛函理论计算分析氢键类型变化和自组装路径重定向机制。
relevance_zh: 该研究属于自组装技术领域，展示了超声作为外部机械力调控超分子手性和CPL放大的新策略，对框架材料的层级组装和手性功能化具有方法学参考价值。摘要未报告螺旋体的具体尺寸、形貌表征细节和超声参数，建议全文精读以评估其可重复性和对框架材料组装的适用性。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。摘要未报告纳米螺旋体和微螺旋体的具体尺寸分布、超声处理的频率和功率参数、异质结螺旋体的形貌表征图像、g_lum值测量波长和温度条件，以及DFT计算的具体基组和模型细节，这些关键信息需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 超声触发使纳米螺旋体末端重组，形成由相反手性核和树枝状亚基组成的异质结螺旋体。
异质结螺旋体表现出倒转且放大的CPL，g_lum值达0.2，荧光量子产率为50%。
超声机械力改变扩展单体中氢键类型，重定向自组装路径，这是手性倒转的机制基础。
增强的分子间发色团相互作用和有序树枝状螺旋体是CPL倒转和放大的关键因素。

title: The Strategies of Improving Chemical Stability of Imine‐Linked Covalent Organic Frameworks
abstract: ABSTRACT Imine‐linked covalent organic frameworks (COFs) have wide applications in molecular separation, gas storage, photocatalysis, electrocatalysis, energy storage, and optoelectronic devices because of their unique advantages such as good crystallinity, permanent porosity, and tunable pore structure. However, the practical applications of imine‐linked COFs in chemical catalysis and gas separation may be hindered due to their reduced chemical stability in acidic or basic conditions. Recently, various effective strategies have been developed to improve chemical stability of imine‐linked COFs. In this review, we summarize the important advances in improving the stability of imine‐linked COFs from the viewpoint of design strategies, including electron‐donating group substitution, steric tuning, fluorine substitution, redox conversion, six‐membered cyclization, five‐membered cyclization, and so on. Moreover, the challenges and perspectives are also described to promote the realization of stable imine‐linked COFs, which will meet the requirements of these materials in practical applications.

title_zh: 提高亚胺键连共价有机框架化学稳定性的策略
summary_zh: 本综述系统总结了提高亚胺键连COF化学稳定性的设计策略，包括供电子基团取代、空间位阻调控、氟取代、氧化还原转化、六元环化和五元环化等。这些策略旨在解决亚胺COF在酸碱条件下稳定性不足的问题，以拓展其在化学催化和气体分离等实际应用中的可行性。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于亚胺键连COF在酸性或碱性条件下化学稳定性降低，从而限制其在化学催化和气体分离等实际应用中的问题。材料体系为亚胺键连COF，其具有良好结晶性、永久孔隙率和可调孔结构等优点，但亚胺键的化学不稳定性是主要瓶颈。设计策略综述涵盖多种化学修饰方法：电子供体基团取代可增强亚胺键的电子密度，空间位阻调控可保护亚胺键免受攻击，氟取代可改变电子环境，氧化还原转化可改变键的化学性质，六元环化和五元环化则通过形成更稳定的环状结构来保护亚胺键。研究过程为系统梳理这些策略的原理、实施方式和效果，并讨论各自的优缺点。该综述的意义在于为设计稳定亚胺COF提供系统性的设计指南，推动其在分子分离、气体存储、光催化、电催化、能量存储和光电器件等领域的实际应用。
methods_zh: 该文为综述性论文，未报告具体的实验合成或表征方法。内容基于对已发表文献中多种提高亚胺COF化学稳定性策略的归纳和总结，包括电子供体基团取代、空间位阻调控、氟取代、氧化还原转化、六元环化和五元环化等设计方法，并讨论了各策略的原理和应用效果。
relevance_zh: 该综述对共轭COF框架材料的稳定性设计具有直接指导意义，为研究者提供了提高亚胺COF在严苛条件下稳定性的系统策略，有助于推动其在电催化和分离等领域的实际应用。摘要未报告具体稳定性提升的定量数据或对比，建议全文精读以获取各策略的详细效果和适用条件。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。摘要未报告各策略的具体稳定性提升数值、适用的酸碱浓度范围、对COF结晶性和孔隙率的影响，以及不同策略之间的对比数据，这些关键细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 电子供体基团取代、空间位阻调控、氟取代、氧化还原转化、六元环化和五元环化是提高亚胺COF化学稳定性的有效策略。
这些策略通过改变亚胺键的电子环境或引入保护性结构来增强其耐酸碱能力。
实现稳定亚胺COF仍需克服挑战，以满足实际应用需求。

title: Solvent‐Directed Modulation of Stacking Isomers in Single‐Crystal One‐Dimensional Covalent Organic Frameworks
abstract: ABSTRACT Stacking isomerism in covalent organic frameworks (COFs) has long remained elusive, with no unambiguous single‐crystal structure confirmation to date. Herein, we present the first definitive structural resolution of stacking isomers in one‐dimensional COFs, enabled by a solvent‐directed modulation strategy. Two distinct stacking isomers were obtained: one exhibiting AA′‐stacking (synthesized in mesitylene) and the other featuring an ABCD quadruple stacking mode (synthesized in anisole/n‐butanol). Their atomic structures were determined by continuous rotation electron diffraction (cRED) at resolutions of 0.98 and 1.02 Å, respectively, with all non‐hydrogen atoms directly located. Compared to the AA′‐stacked isomer, the ABCD‐stacked counterpart displays broader optical absorption, a narrower bandgap, and approximately twofold higher charge‐separation efficiency, resulting in significantly enhanced visible‐light photocatalytic activity for H 2 O 2 production and N‐benzylbenzaldimine synthesis. Mechanistic studies reveal that the ABCD stacking configuration narrows the bandgap, weakens electron localization, and substantially increases the dipole moment, thereby inducing strong interlayer charge transfer and polarization effects.

title_zh: 溶剂导向调控单晶一维共价有机框架中的堆积异构体
summary_zh: 本研究首次通过溶剂导向策略在单晶一维共价有机框架中实现了堆积异构体的明确结构解析，获得AA′堆积和ABCD四重堆积两种异构体，并发现ABCD堆积显著增强光催化活性，为COF堆积工程提供了新思路。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于共价有机框架中长期 elusive 的堆积异构现象，此前缺乏明确的单晶结构证据。材料体系为一维共价有机框架单晶。设计策略采用溶剂导向调控，分别以均三甲苯合成AA′堆积异构体，以苯甲醚/正丁醇合成ABCD四重堆积异构体。研究过程通过连续旋转电子衍射技术解析原子结构，分辨率分别达0.98和1.02 Å，所有非氢原子被直接定位。意义在于首次提供堆积异构体的单晶结构确认，并揭示堆积模式对光电性质及催化性能的调控机制，为框架材料堆积工程奠定基础。
methods_zh: 合成方法采用溶剂导向的溶剂热合成，分别使用均三甲苯和苯甲醚/正丁醇作为反应溶剂。结构表征采用连续旋转电子衍射技术，分辨率分别为0.98和1.02 Å，直接定位所有非氢原子。性能测试包括光学吸收、带隙、电荷分离效率及可见光光催化活性测试，涉及H2O2生产和N-苄基苯甲亚胺合成。机理研究通过分析堆积构型对带隙、电子局域化、偶极矩及层间电荷转移的影响。
relevance_zh: 该研究对框架材料组装主线具有重要价值，首次提供堆积异构体的单晶证据，并建立溶剂导向的堆积模式调控策略，为COF光电性能优化提供新维度。局限在于仅针对一维COF体系，且光催化具体条件未在摘要中详述。值得全文精读以获取合成细节和催化测试条件。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，关键细节如具体合成温度、时间、产率、光催化反应条件、量子效率、带隙数值及偶极矩定量结果均需全文核查，摘要未报告相应数据。
key_findings_zh: 首次获得一维COF堆积异构体的单晶结构确认，AA′堆积由均三甲苯合成，ABCD四重堆积由苯甲醚/正丁醇合成
ABCD堆积相比AA′堆积显示更宽的光吸收、更窄的带隙和约两倍的电荷分离效率
ABCD堆积显著增强可见光光催化H2O2生产和N-苄基苯甲亚胺合成的活性
机理研究表明ABCD堆积窄化带隙、弱化电子局域化并大幅增加偶极矩，诱导强层间电荷转移和极化效应

title: Mechanism‐Selective Self‐Assembly of Amphiphilic Dendronized Brush Block Copolymers Into Lamellar and Porous Photonic Pigments
abstract: ABSTRACT Polymeric photonic microspheres with visible structural colors offer safe and vibrant alternatives to traditional toxic pigments. These materials are commonly fabricated through confined self‐assembly of block copolymers (BCPs) in evaporative emulsions, which can proceed by either microphase separation or organized spontaneous emulsification (OSE) to yield lamellar or porous structures with complementary optical responses. In this study, we show that amphiphilic dendronized brush block copolymers (den‐BBCPs) exhibit mechanism‐selective self‐assembly governed by the volume fraction ( f) of hydrophilic segment. At f < 50%, den‐BBCPs follow the OSE pathway, generating photonic microspheres with short‐range‐ordered porous structures and angle‐independent structural colors. In contrast, at f > 50%, microphase separation dominates, producing concentric lamellar microspheres with strong specular reflections. This pathway transition arises from the rigid dendronized architecture: increasing the volume fraction of hydrophilic segment amplifies intermolecular repulsions at the highly curved water‐in‐oil nanodroplet interface, destabilizing interfacial association and redirecting assembly toward microphase separation. This work establishes architectural engineering of den‐BBCPs as a powerful strategy for programming self‐assembly pathways and creating polymeric photonic pigments with diverse structures and optical properties.

title_zh: 两亲性树枝化刷状嵌段共聚物的机制选择性自组装：层状与多孔光子颜料
summary_zh: 本研究报道两亲性树枝化刷状嵌段共聚物（den-BBCPs）可通过机制选择性自组装形成层状或多孔光子微球。亲水段体积分数（f）决定组装路径：f<50%时经organized spontaneous emulsification（OSE）形成短程有序多孔结构，呈现角度无关结构色；f>50%时微相分离主导，形成同心层状微球，具有强镜面反射。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于如何通过分子架构工程调控嵌段共聚物在蒸发乳液中的受限自组装路径，以获得不同结构及光学响应的聚合物光子颜料。材料体系为两亲性树枝化刷状嵌段共聚物（den-BBCPs），其刚性树枝化结构赋予独特的界面行为。设计策略是通过调节亲水段体积分数f来切换自组装机制：当f<50%时，体系遵循OSE路径，生成短程有序多孔结构，产生角度无关的结构色；当f>50%时，微相分离占主导，形成同心层状微球，呈现强镜面反射。研究过程包括在蒸发乳液中进行受限自组装，并通过结构表征与光学性能测试验证路径转变。该工作确立了den-BBCPs架构工程作为编程自组装路径和制备多样化结构及光学性质聚合物光子颜料的策略，对理解刚性拓扑对自组装的调控具有重要意义。
methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的方法包括：通过蒸发乳液中的受限自组装制备光子微球；利用den-BBCPs的两亲性进行自组装；通过结构表征（具体技术未报告）和光学性能测试（如结构色和反射特性）评估所得微球。合成方法、具体表征仪器及定量光学参数未在摘要中报告。
relevance_zh: 该研究与自组装技术及介孔/多孔结构主题直接相关，展示了通过分子架构调控自组装路径的策略，对框架材料的有序结构设计具有借鉴意义。摘要未提供定量光学性能数据及详细表征，但机制性结论清晰，值得全文精读以获取具体实验条件和结构-性能定量关系。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。关键细节如den-BBCPs的具体合成步骤、分子量及分散度、f的精确调控范围、结构表征手段（如SEM/TEM/SAXS）、光学性能的定量数值（反射率、颜色坐标）等均需全文核查，摘要未报告相应数据。

f>50%时，微相分离主导，产生同心层状微球，具有强镜面反射

title: Integrating Scalable Dry‐Processing and Metal‐Organic Framework Glass Enables Stable High‐Voltage Cathodes in Sodium‐Ion Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT High‐voltage NASICON‐type Na 3 (VOPO 4 ) 2 F (NVOPF) has emerged as a promising cathode for sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs) because it enables higher energy density. However, its practical application is still hindered by limited cycling stability and cycling capability, which primarily stem from interfacial instability under high cut‐off voltages during charging and sluggish Na + desolvation kinetics during discharging, respectively. Herein, we design an integrated metal‐organic framework (MOF) glass interface to concurrently stabilize the cathode/electrolyte interphase and accelerate Na + desolvation. A mix‐melt‐quench transformation converts low‐melting crystalline MOF (Zn‐P‐dmbIm) into MOF glasses, which is coupled in situ with dry‐processed NVOPF electrode fabrication to achieve a uniform and ultrathin coating from the particle to the electrode level. The conformal glassy layer promotes efficient Na + desolvation while suppressing solvent co‐intercalation, solvent decomposition, and transition‐metal dissolution. Meanwhile, the dry‐processed electrode fabrication establishes a dense yet low‐tortuosity ion‐transport network, ensuring continuous Na + transport and accelerated reaction kinetics. Benefiting from this dual regulation mechanism, the modified NVOPF cathode exhibits outstanding rate capability and long‐term cycling stability, achieving 86% capacity retention after over 1000 cycles at 5 C with a high cutoff voltage of 4.3 V. This work provides a scalable, manufacturing‐compatible channel for constructing robust high‐voltage cathodes in SIBs.

title_zh: 集成可规模化干法加工与金属有机框架玻璃实现钠离子电池稳定高压正极
summary_zh: 本研究设计集成MOF玻璃界面，通过混合-熔融-淬火将低熔点结晶MOF转化为玻璃态，并与干法电极制备原位耦合，在NVOPF正极上形成均匀超薄涂层。该玻璃层促进Na+去溶剂化并抑制溶剂共嵌入和过渡金属溶解，结合干法电极的低迂曲度离子传输网络，实现5C下1000次循环86%容量保持率。
research_details_zh: 研究问题针对高压NASICON型Na3(VOPO4)2F（NVOPF）正极在钠离子电池中循环稳定性差和倍率性能受限的瓶颈，其根源在于高截止电压下的界面不稳定和放电时Na+去溶剂化动力学缓慢。材料体系包括NVOPF正极、低熔点结晶MOF（Zn-P-dmbIm）及其玻璃态转化产物。设计策略是构建集成MOF玻璃界面，通过混合-熔融-淬火将MOF转化为玻璃，并与干法电极制备原位耦合，实现从颗粒到电极级别的均匀超薄包覆。该玻璃层促进Na+去溶剂化，同时抑制溶剂共嵌入、溶剂分解和过渡金属溶解；干法电极构建致密低迂曲度离子传输网络，确保连续Na+传输和加速反应动力学。研究过程涉及材料转化、电极制备、电化学性能测试及机制验证。该工作为构建稳健高压正极提供了可规模化、与制造兼容的途径。
methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的方法包括：混合-熔融-淬火转化将低熔点结晶MOF（Zn-P-dmbIm）转化为MOF玻璃；干法电极制备工艺与MOF玻璃原位耦合；电化学性能测试（包括倍率性能和长循环测试，具体条件如5C、4.3V截止电压）。表征方法（如SEM、TEM、XRD等）及详细电化学测试参数未在摘要中报告。
relevance_zh: 该研究与MOF框架材料及电化学应用直接相关，展示了MOF玻璃作为界面材料的创新应用，对框架材料的功能化设计具有参考价值。摘要报告了明确的循环稳定性数据，但缺乏离子电导率、界面阻抗等定量指标，建议全文精读以获取完整的电化学表征和机制证据。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。关键细节如MOF玻璃的制备条件（温度、时间）、涂层厚度及均匀性的定量表征、Na+去溶剂化动力学的具体测量方法、干法电极的组成和工艺参数、以及阻抗谱等电化学数据均需全文核查，摘要未报告相应数据。
key_findings_zh: MOF玻璃界面促进Na+去溶剂化，同时抑制溶剂共嵌入、溶剂分解和过渡金属溶解
干法电极构建致密低迂曲度离子传输网络，确保连续Na+传输和加速反应动力学
改性NVOPF正极在4.3V高截止电压、5C倍率下循环超过1000次后容量保持率为86%

title: Covalent Organic Framework Electrolytes for Solid‐State Lithium Batteries: Designing Ion Highways for Next‐Generation Energy Storage
abstract: ABSTRACT Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are emerging as a programmable platform for solid electrolytes in solid‐state lithium batteries, since their crystalline, periodically ordered nanochannels can be engineered to enable directional ion transport. These low‐resistance pathways promote directional lithium‐ion (Li + ) migration through a narrower, more spatially ordered distribution of coordination environments, achieved via site‐to‐site hopping and/or guest‐assisted vehicular motion within the channels. This review presents a design‐oriented framework linking COF structural descriptors to ion‐transport metrics through a cause‐effect‐performance relationship. We first summarize the Li + transport mechanism in confined COF channels, covering site‐to‐site hopping along pore walls and guest‐assisted vehicular motion in filled channels. We then correlate (i) topology and channel architecture, (ii) pore‐wall chemical functionality and framework charge, (iii) crystallinity, stacking registry, and channel alignment, and (iv) hybrid COF architectures with performance indicators including ionic conductivity (σ), activation energy (Ea), lithium‐ion transference number (tLi + ), transport anisotropy, and effective conductivity in working membranes (σeff). Through representative case studies, we highlight cases where high intrinsic channel transport does and does not translate into device‐relevant σeff. Finally, we propose standardized reporting practices and device‐level benchmarks to accelerate the shift from empirical materials discovery toward predictive ion‐highway engineering for next‐generation solid‐state lithium batteries.

title_zh: 用于固态锂电池的共价有机框架电解质：设计下一代储能离子高速公路
summary_zh: 本文综述了共价有机框架（COFs）作为固态锂电池电解质的进展，提出设计导向框架，通过因果-效应-性能关系将COF结构描述符与离子传输指标关联。系统总结了COF通道内Li+传输机制，包括沿孔壁的位点间跳跃和填充通道内的客体辅助运载，并讨论了结构参数对离子电导率、活化能等性能的影响。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于如何通过COF结构设计实现固态锂电池中方向性离子传输，以克服传统电解质的低离子电导率和界面问题。材料体系为具有结晶性、周期性有序纳米通道的COFs，其通道可工程化以实现定向Li+迁移。设计策略是建立因果-效应-性能关系框架，将COF结构描述符（拓扑和通道架构、孔壁化学功能性和框架电荷、结晶度、堆叠排列和通道取向、杂化COF架构）与性能指标（离子电导率σ、活化能Ea、锂离子迁移数tLi+、传输各向异性、工作膜有效电导率σeff）关联。研究过程包括总结Li+传输机制（位点间跳跃和客体辅助运载），通过案例研究展示高本征通道传输是否转化为器件相关σeff，并提出标准化报告实践和器件级基准。该综述旨在推动从经验材料发现向预测性离子高速公路工程转变。
methods_zh: 摘要明确提及的方法包括：综述性文献分析，涵盖COF电解质的设计策略和性能评估；通过案例研究对比不同COF架构的离子传输表现；提出标准化报告实践和器件级基准。具体合成方法、表征技术和测试条件未在摘要中报告，属于综述范畴。
relevance_zh: 该综述与COF框架材料及离子传输主题高度相关，为COF电解质设计提供了系统框架，对框架材料在能源存储中的应用具有指导价值。摘要未提供具体数值数据，但结构-性能关系的梳理对研究者有参考意义，值得全文精读以获取详细的案例数据和设计准则。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。关键细节如具体COF材料的合成方法、离子电导率数值、活化能数据、迁移数测量方法、以及案例研究中具体材料的性能对比等均需全文核查，摘要未报告相应数据。
key_findings_zh: COF通道内Li+传输机制包括沿孔壁的位点间跳跃和填充通道内的客体辅助运载
COF结构描述符（拓扑、孔壁化学、结晶度、堆叠排列、杂化架构）与离子传输性能指标（σ、Ea、tLi+、σeff）存在因果-效应-性能关系

title: Three‐Dimensional Covalent Organic Framework Film for Fast and Ultrastable Near‐Infrared Electrochromism
abstract: ABSTRACT Electrochromic (EC) covalent organic framework (COF) films provide ordered porous platforms for coupling redox‐active skeletons with ion transport, yet their long‐term operation is often limited by inefficient counterion compensation, sluggish electron transport, and redox‐induced structural instability. Herein, we report a metal‐free three‐dimensional (3D) COF film for fast and ultrastable near‐infrared (NIR) electrochromism. The 3D‐COF TPDA‐TFPB film integrates bis(triphenylamine)‐derived TPDA redox centers into a crystalline fmj‐type framework with interconnected micro/mesoporous channels. This 3D architecture promotes electrolyte penetration and counterion‐coupled charge compensation, while the imine‐linked conjugated skeleton enhances charge delocalization and stabilizes oxidized states. Consequently, the optimized film delivers a large optical contrast of 73% at 1020 nm, rapid coloration/bleaching time of 0.54/0.27 s, a high coloration efficiency of 648.3 cm 2 C −1 , and an open‐circuit optical memory of 4.6 h. Notably, it retains 97.6% of its maximum optical modulation after 10,300 switching cycles, demonstrating outstanding cycling durability among COF‐based EC films. In situ Raman, X‐ray photoelectron spectroscopy and theoretical calculations reveal that the EC response originates from reversible TPDA‐centered polaron/bipolaron evolution stabilized within the 3D framework. A quasi‐solid‐state device further preserves distinct optical modulation. This work establishes 3D COF films as a promising platform for fast, efficient, and durable electrochromism.

title_zh: 三维共价有机框架薄膜用于快速且超稳定的近红外电致变色
summary_zh: 本研究报道了一种无金属三维共价有机框架（3D COF）薄膜，用于快速且超稳定的近红外电致变色。该薄膜通过将双三苯胺氧化还原中心整合到结晶fmj型框架中，实现了大光学对比度、快速响应、高着色效率和优异循环稳定性，为高性能电致变色材料提供了新平台。
research_details_zh: 研究针对电致变色COF薄膜长期运行受限于反离子补偿不足、电子传输缓慢及氧化还原诱导结构不稳定的问题，提出并制备了一种无金属三维COF薄膜TPDA-TFPB。该材料体系将双三苯胺衍生的TPDA氧化还原中心整合到结晶fmj型框架中，形成具有互连微/介孔通道的三维结构。设计策略是利用三维架构促进电解质渗透和反离子耦合电荷补偿，同时通过亚胺连接的共轭骨架增强电荷离域并稳定氧化态。研究过程包括薄膜制备、结构表征、电致变色性能测试以及原位拉曼、X射线光电子能谱和理论计算以揭示机理。该工作确立了三维COF薄膜作为快速、高效且耐用近红外电致变色平台的重要价值。
methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的合成方法包括制备3D COF TPDA-TFPB薄膜。表征方法包括原位拉曼光谱、X射线光电子能谱以及理论计算。性能测试方法包括电致变色性能测试，具体涉及光学对比度、着色/褪色时间、着色效率、开路光学记忆和循环稳定性测试。此外，还构建了准固态器件进行性能验证。
relevance_zh: 该工作直接契合研究主线中关于共轭COF框架材料及其电化学合成与组装的研究方向，展示了三维COF薄膜在电致变色领域的优异性能，为框架材料在光电器件中的应用提供了重要参考。摘要报告了详细的定量性能数据和机理证据，具有较高精读价值，但关于薄膜的具体合成条件、厚度控制及器件组装细节仍需全文核查。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，摘要未报告薄膜的具体合成条件（如溶剂、温度、时间）、厚度、形貌细节、孔径分布数据、准固态器件的具体组成与性能参数，以及理论计算的具体方法。这些关键细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 优化后的薄膜在1020 nm处实现73%的大光学对比度，着色/褪色时间分别为0.54/0.27秒，着色效率为648.3 cm² C⁻¹，开路光学记忆为4.6小时。
经过10,300次开关循环后，薄膜仍保持最大光学调制的97.6%，展现出优异的循环耐久性。
原位拉曼、X射线光电子能谱和理论计算表明，电致变色响应源于可逆的TPDA中心极化子/双极化子演化，且该演化被三维框架稳定。
准固态器件进一步保持了明显的光学调制能力。

title: Defined Dinuclear Nickel Sites on Mesoporous Silica Translate Molecular Surface Mimics to Heterogeneous Catalysis
abstract: ABSTRACT Metal–metal cooperativity in dinuclear transition‐metal systems offers unique opportunities for controlling reactivity and selectivity in catalytic transformations. Here, we report, inspired by molecular chemistry, the assembly of a bimetallic nickel system grafted onto mesoporous SBA‐15 (Ni‐NDI‐APTES@SBA‐15 250 ). The well‐defined mesostructure of SBA‐15 enables the immobilization of dinuclear nickel units while preserving their proximity and cooperative reactivity. Comprehensive characterization, including PXRD, N 2 physisorption, DRIFT‐IR, S/TEM, XPS, EA, ICP‐OES, TGA, and solid‐state NMR, confirms the successful incorporation of Ni 2 species and retention of the mesoporous framework. The catalytic performance of Ni‐NDI‐APTES@SBA‐15 250 was evaluated in the cyclotrimerization of terminal alkynes and compared with representative homogeneous mono‐ and dinuclear nickel catalysts. Ni‐NDI‐APTES@SBA‐15 250 preserves the cooperative reactivity and high regioselectivity of the molecular dinuclear catalyst while the surface‐bound environment introduces a distinct, substrate‐dependent chemoselectivity, as exemplified by the selective monocyclotrimerization of diyne substrates instead of the double cyclization favored by the homogeneous analogue. Moreover, Ni‐NDI‐APTES@SBA‐15 250 combines excellent catalytic performance with operational stability, recyclability, and negligible nickel leaching demonstrating that an immobilized catalyst can preserve molecular bimetallic reactivity while modulating catalytic pathways through the local supported environment.

title_zh: 介孔二氧化硅上的明确双核镍位点将分子表面模拟转化为多相催化
summary_zh: 本研究受分子化学启发，将双核镍单元组装到介孔SBA-15上，制备了Ni-NDI-APTES@SBA-15催化剂。该催化剂在末端炔烃环三聚反应中保留了分子双核催化剂的协同反应性和高区域选择性，同时表面环境引入了独特的底物依赖性化学选择性，并兼具优异催化性能、稳定性、可回收性和极低镍浸出。
research_details_zh: 研究旨在利用双核过渡金属体系中的金属-金属协同性来控制催化转化中的反应性和选择性。受分子化学启发，研究者将双核镍单元组装到介孔SBA-15上，制备了Ni-NDI-APTES@SBA-15催化剂。SBA-15的良好介观结构使得双核镍单元得以固定化，同时保持其邻近性和协同反应性。研究过程包括催化剂的制备、全面表征（包括PXRD、N₂物理吸附、DRIFT-IR、S/TEM、XPS、EA、ICP-OES、TGA和固态NMR）以及催化性能评估。在末端炔烃环三聚反应中，该催化剂与代表性的均相单核和双核镍催化剂进行了比较。该工作证明了固定化催化剂可以保留分子双金属反应性，同时通过局部载体环境调节催化路径。
methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的合成方法包括将双核镍单元组装到介孔SBA-15上。表征方法包括PXRD、N₂物理吸附、DRIFT-IR、S/TEM、XPS、EA、ICP-OES、TGA和固态NMR。催化性能测试为末端炔烃的环三聚反应，并与均相单核和双核镍催化剂进行对比。
relevance_zh: 该工作涉及介孔材料（SBA-15）作为载体固定双核金属催化剂，与介孔材料研究方向直接相关，展示了介孔结构在稳定金属活性位点和调控催化选择性方面的价值。虽然不涉及导电或共轭框架，但对介孔材料的功能化应用有参考意义。摘要提供了明确的表征和催化结果，值得精读以获取详细的催化剂制备和性能数据。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，摘要未报告Ni-NDI-APTES@SBA-15的具体制备步骤（如嫁接条件、镍负载量）、催化反应的详细条件（如温度、溶剂、底物浓度）、转化率和选择性的具体数值、循环使用次数及镍浸出的定量数据。这些关键细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: Ni-NDI-APTES@SBA-15保留了分子双核催化剂的协同反应性和高区域选择性。
表面结合环境引入了独特的底物依赖性化学选择性，例如对二炔底物选择性单环三聚，而均相类似物则倾向于双环化。
该催化剂兼具优异催化性能、操作稳定性、可回收性和可忽略的镍浸出。
多种表征手段确认了Ni₂物种的成功引入和介孔框架的保留。

title: Photopatterning Block Copolymer Enables Mechanical Enhancement
abstract: ABSTRACT Soft–hard integrated architectures provide a powerful route to mechanical enhancement, but current fabrication methods often suffer from interfacial failure and limited mechanical tunability. We propose a multiscale strategy by combining molecular photoisomerization, nanoscale phase separation, and macroscopic photopatterning in block copolymers. Molecular photoisomerization allows for reversible conformational changes from trans to cis and mechanical tuning from stiffness to soft elastics. Microphase‐separated nanodomains permit switching of hard and soft microphases and alter the energy dissipation. Macroscale photopatterning enhances the toughness and guides the cracks. This establishes a multiscale coupling paradigm of molecular response‐nanoscale dissipation‐macroscopic geometry, addressing interfacial failure and broadening the tunable mechanical region. Using kirigami cutting and conductive layer coating, the system is integrated with complex surfaces to convert mechanical deformation into electrical signals, highlighting its potential in flexible sensing and electronics.

title_zh: 光图案化嵌段共聚物实现机械增强
summary_zh: 本研究提出一种多尺度策略，通过结合分子光异构化、纳米尺度相分离和宏观光图案化，在嵌段共聚物中实现软硬集成架构的机械增强。该策略解决了界面失效问题并拓宽了机械可调区域，结合kirigami切割和导电层涂层，展示了在柔性传感和电子学中的应用潜力。
research_details_zh: 研究针对软硬集成架构在机械增强中面临的界面失效和机械可调性有限的问题，提出了一种多尺度策略。该策略在嵌段共聚物体系中结合了三个层次的设计：分子光异构化实现从反式到顺式的可逆构象变化，从而在刚性和软弹性之间进行机械调节；微相分离的纳米域允许硬/软微相切换并改变能量耗散；宏观光图案化增强韧性并引导裂纹扩展。研究过程涉及材料制备、光图案化处理、机械性能测试以及通过kirigami切割和导电层涂层将系统与复杂表面集成，将机械变形转换为电信号。该工作建立了分子响应-纳米尺度耗散-宏观几何的多尺度耦合范式，为柔性传感和电子学提供了新思路。
methods_zh: 摘要明确出现的方法包括分子光异构化处理、微相分离自组装、宏观光图案化技术、kirigami切割以及导电层涂层。性能测试涉及机械性能测试（包括刚度、弹性、韧性）和电信号转换测试。摘要未报告具体的表征手段和定量测试参数。
relevance_zh: 该工作涉及嵌段共聚物自组装和导电层集成，与自组装技术及导电材料应用方向有一定关联，但核心聚焦于机械增强而非框架材料。其多尺度耦合策略对理解组装结构-性能关系有参考价值，但相关性有限。摘要缺乏定量数据，建议根据具体需求决定是否精读。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，摘要未报告具体的嵌段共聚物种类、分子量、光异构化条件、光图案化参数、机械性能的定量数值（如模量、韧性提升倍数）、电信号转换的具体性能指标以及任何表征手段。这些关键细节需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 分子光异构化允许从反式到顺式的可逆构象变化，实现从刚度到软弹性的机械调节。
微相分离的纳米域可切换硬/软微相并改变能量耗散。
宏观光图案化增强了韧性并引导裂纹扩展，解决了界面失效问题并拓宽了机械可调区域。
通过kirigami切割和导电层涂层，系统可集成到复杂表面，将机械变形转换为电信号。

title: Linker Engineering of Copper‐Based 2D Conductive Metal–Organic Frameworks for Modular Photo‐Mediated Properties and Multimodal Antibacterial Effects
abstract: ABSTRACT Photoactive metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) have gained increasing attention in advanced photocatalysis and phototherapeutic applications. However, these MOFs suffer from insufficient structural tunability, which originates from the use of photoactive precursors with limited light absorption ranges or the incorporation of inorganic semiconductors to enhance light‐harvesting performance. Therefore, the fabrication of intrinsic semiconducting MOFs with broadband light absorption and tunable photophysical properties represents a crucial endeavor for advancing photo‐based technologies. Herein, we report a series of antibacterial agents derived from two‐dimensional conductive metal–organic frameworks (2D c‐MOFs) via linker engineering, employing commercially available linkers with distinct aromatic cores, namely tetrahydroxy‐1,4‐benzoquinone (THQ) and hexahydroxytriphenylene (HHTP). All three materials display broadband light‐harvesting and good photothermal conversion capacity, and further exhibit light‐enhanced and structural‐dependent antibacterial activity. Mechanistic studies reveal that their measurable differences in antibacterial efficacy can be ascribed to linker‐mediated variations in structural porosity, stability, and electronic delocalization that govern their photoelectronic properties and photocatalytic pathways. These 2D c‐MOFs offer a materials paradigm and mechanistic basis for tailoring photo‐mediated properties and multimodal antibacterial effects, and provide valuable insights for advanced photocatalysis and phototherapeutic applications.
recommendation: 同时命中导电/共轭框架，建议优先检查其合成路径与孔结构证据。
title_zh: 基于铜的二维导电金属有机框架的配体工程用于模块化光介导性质和多模式抗菌效应
summary_zh: 本研究通过配体工程，利用两种商业配体THQ和HHTP制备了系列二维导电MOF抗菌剂。三种材料均显示宽带光捕获和良好光热转换能力，并表现出光增强且结构依赖的抗菌活性。机制研究表明抗菌效能差异源于配体介导的结构孔隙率、稳定性和电子离域变化，为光催化和光治疗应用提供了材料范式和机制基础。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于光活性MOF结构可调性不足的瓶颈，该瓶颈源于光活性前驱体吸收范围有限或需引入无机半导体增强光捕获。材料体系为铜基二维导电MOF，设计策略是采用具有不同芳香核心的商业配体THQ和HHTP进行配体工程，构建本征半导体MOF以实现宽带吸收和可调光物理性质。研究过程包括合成三种MOF材料，系统表征其光捕获、光热转换和抗菌性能，并通过机制研究揭示配体介导的结构孔隙率、稳定性和电子离域如何调控光电子性质和光催化路径。意义在于这些二维导电MOF为定制光介导性质和多模式抗菌效应提供了材料范式和机制依据，对先进光催化和光治疗应用具有重要启示。
methods_zh: 合成方法为配体工程，使用商业配体THQ和HHTP制备二维导电MOF。表征方法涵盖光捕获性能测试、光热转换能力评估以及抗菌活性测定。机制研究通过分析结构孔隙率、稳定性和电子离域来阐释抗菌效能差异。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征仪器型号或性能测试详细参数。
relevance_zh: 该研究直接契合介孔导电MOF和框架材料组装主线，通过配体工程实现光介导性质模块化调控，为设计多功能导电MOF提供了可借鉴策略。局限在于摘要未提供定量性能数据，抗菌机制细节需全文确认。鉴于其材料范式和机制基础价值，值得全文精读以获取完整实验条件和性能参数。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅依据摘要内容整理。具体合成条件、表征数据、抗菌活性定量结果、光热转换效率数值及机制验证实验细节均需全文核查确认。
key_findings_zh: 三种材料均显示宽带光捕获和良好的光热转换能力
抗菌活性具有光增强和结构依赖性特征
抗菌效能差异归因于配体介导的结构孔隙率、稳定性和电子离域变化，这些因素调控光电子性质和光催化路径
摘要未报告具体抗菌效率数值或光热转换效率定量数据

title: Flux-mediated ligand exchange restructures metal–organic framework glasses
abstract: Abstract Melt-quenched glasses derived from metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) combine the processability of glasses with the modularity and microporosity of MOFs, yet remain structurally and functionally less diverse than crystalline analogues. Here we show that the chelating ligand 1,10-phenanthroline acts as an organic flux that lowers the glass transition temperature of selected MOFs and induces ligand exchange during melting, thereby enabling control over local coordination and global topology in MOF glasses. In Co 2+ -based systems, phenanthroline coordinates to the metal nodes, increases the coordination number and reduces network connectivity by forming terminal ligands. This coordination sphere engineering affords a level of structural control not readily achievable in conventional inorganic or organic glasses. Crucially, the lower processing temperature suppresses thermal decomposition, enabling the synthesis of Co 2+ -based MOF glasses free of magnetic impurities. These glasses exhibit antiferromagnetic coupling and represent unique examples of magnetic MOF glasses formed by melt quenching. Finally, we extend the strategy to otherwise non-meltable carboxylate-based MOFs, establishing flux-mediated ligand exchange as a versatile route to hybrid glasses with tailored connectivity and properties.
recommendation: 与晶态多孔框架主题相关，建议根据摘要判断是否进一步阅读。
title_zh: 通量介导的配体交换重构金属有机框架玻璃
summary_zh: 本研究发现螯合配体1,10-菲咯啉可作为有机通量，降低MOF玻璃转变温度并在熔融过程中诱导配体交换，从而控制MOF玻璃的局部配位和全局拓扑。在Co²⁺体系中，菲咯啉配位金属节点、增加配位数并形成端基配体降低网络连通性。该策略还扩展到原本不可熔融的羧酸基MOF，为杂化玻璃提供了通用合成路线。
research_details_zh: 研究问题针对MOF玻璃结构和功能多样性不足的现状，其源于熔融淬火MOF玻璃缺乏对局部配位和全局拓扑的有效控制。材料体系为Co²⁺基MOF玻璃及羧酸基MOF。设计策略是引入螯合配体1,10-菲咯啉作为有机通量，在降低玻璃转变温度的同时诱导熔融过程中的配体交换。研究过程包括验证菲咯啉对玻璃转变温度的影响、分析配位球工程对结构连通性的调控、评估低温加工对热分解的抑制效果、表征磁性性质，并将策略扩展到非可熔融MOF体系。意义在于配位球工程提供了传统无机或有机玻璃难以实现的结构控制水平，建立了通量介导配体交换作为定制杂化玻璃连接性和性能的通用途径。
methods_zh: 合成方法为熔融淬火结合通量介导配体交换，使用1,10-菲咯啉作为有机通量。结构表征涉及配位球分析和拓扑控制验证。性能测试包括玻璃转变温度测定、磁性性质表征（反铁磁耦合确认）以及热分解抑制效果评估。摘要未报告具体合成温度、配体比例、表征仪器或磁性测量详细条件。
relevance_zh: 该研究拓展了框架材料玻璃化的结构调控手段，通量介导配体交换策略对MOF玻璃的组装和功能化具有方法论价值，与框架材料组装主线相关。局限在于摘要未提供定量结构数据和磁性参数，且策略普适性需更多体系验证。鉴于其发表在Nature Materials且提出新机制，值得全文精读。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅依据摘要内容整理。具体玻璃转变温度数值、配位数变化定量数据、反铁磁耦合强度、扩展至羧酸基MOF的具体条件及结构表征细节均需全文核查确认。
key_findings_zh: 1,10-菲咯啉作为有机通量可降低所选MOF的玻璃转变温度并在熔融过程中诱导配体交换
在Co²⁺体系中，菲咯啉配位金属节点、增加配位数并通过形成端基配体降低网络连通性
较低加工温度抑制热分解，可合成无磁性杂质的Co²⁺基MOF玻璃
所得玻璃显示反铁磁耦合，是熔融淬火形成的磁性MOF玻璃的独特实例

title: Reaction–Transport Coupling Drives Spatiotemporal Organization in Fuel‐Driven Supramolecular Polymerization
abstract: ABSTRACT Chemically fueled supramolecular systems provide a versatile platform for generating nonequilibrium structures and dynamical instabilities, including chemical oscillations and traveling waves reminiscent of biological organization. However, a minimal mechanistic framework capable of capturing the emergence of such spatiotemporal order is still lacking. Here, we develop a minimal reaction–transport framework for fuel‐driven supramolecular polymerization that couples activation–deactivation chemistry with cooperative assembly, fragmentation, and polymer length‐dependent diffusion. The model captures autonomous oscillations arising through a Hopf bifurcation and demonstrates how temporal instabilities evolve into spatial self‐organization upon inclusion of transport. We show that the nonlinear interplay between reaction kinetics and state‐dependent mobility gives rise to traveling polymerization fronts, oscillatory wave dynamics, and complex spatiotemporal patterns. The propagating fronts exhibit near‐ballistic dynamics, revealing a fundamentally nonequilibrium transport mechanism emerging from reactive feedback and dynamically evolving diffusivity. These findings establish a minimal physical framework connecting dissipative self‐assembly, nonlinear transport, and active matter, while providing design principles for programmable supramolecular materials capable of autonomous spatiotemporal organization.

title_zh: 反应-传输耦合驱动燃料驱动超分子聚合中的时空组织
summary_zh: 本研究构建了燃料驱动超分子聚合的最小反应-传输模型，耦合激活-去活化化学与协同组装、断裂及长度依赖扩散，捕捉到Hopf分岔引发的自主振荡，并展示时间不稳定性如何演化为空间自组织，揭示反应动力学与状态依赖迁移率之间的非线性相互作用产生传播聚合前沿、振荡波和复杂时空图案。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于化学燃料驱动的超分子体系如何产生非平衡结构和动力学不稳定性（如化学振荡和行波），但缺乏能够捕捉这种时空秩序涌现的最小机制框架。材料体系为燃料驱动的超分子聚合物，设计策略是建立最小反应-传输框架，将激活-去活化化学与协同组装、断裂和聚合物长度依赖扩散相耦合。研究过程通过模型分析捕捉到经Hopf分岔产生的自主振荡，并证明在引入传输后时间不稳定性可演化为空间自组织。该模型揭示了反应动力学与状态依赖迁移率之间的非线性相互作用如何产生传播聚合前沿、振荡波动力学和复杂时空图案，传播前沿表现出近弹道动力学，揭示了一种源于反应反馈和动态演化扩散率的根本性非平衡传输机制。其意义在于建立了连接耗散自组装、非线性传输和活性物质的最小物理框架，为可编程超分子材料的设计提供原理。
methods_zh: 摘要未明确报告具体实验方法，主要涉及理论建模：建立最小反应-传输框架，耦合激活-去活化化学、协同组装、断裂和聚合物长度依赖扩散，通过动力学分析（包括Hopf分岔分析）和数值模拟研究振荡、波传播和时空图案形成。
relevance_zh: 该研究为理解框架材料中耗散自组装和非平衡传输提供了理论框架，与自组装技术主线高度相关，但属于理论模型研究，缺乏实验验证。对设计可编程超分子材料具有指导价值，但需结合实验体系进一步验证模型预测，值得全文精读以获取模型细节和设计原则。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，模型的具体参数、数值模拟细节、Hopf分岔的定量条件、近弹道动力学的具体数值等关键细节仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 模型捕捉到经Hopf分岔产生的自主振荡，证明时间不稳定性在引入传输后可演化为空间自组织
反应动力学与状态依赖迁移率的非线性相互作用产生传播聚合前沿、振荡波动力学和复杂时空图案
传播前沿表现出近弹道动力学，揭示了一种源于反应反馈和动态演化扩散率的非平衡传输机制

title: A Stage‐Coupled View of Interfacial Reconstruction in Anode‐Free Sodium Metal Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Anode‐free sodium metal batteries (AFSMBs) remove the excess metal anode and increase projected cell‐level energy density, but they place reversibility on a transient negative‐electrode interface. In each cycle, Na is deposited on a foreign current collector and removed to a highly depleted state. Cell failure is governed by whether continuity can be preserved across a sequence of short‐lived interfacial states, including bulk coordination, interfacial desolvation, heterogeneous nucleation, metallic coalescence, Na isolation, and recurrent solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) renewal. AFSMBs are therefore better understood as dynamically reconstructed interfacial systems, where non‐uniformity introduced during interfacial entry can propagate through later plating and stripping. This review examines AFSMBs through three coupled stages: solvation‐controlled interfacial entry, current collector regulated Na reconstruction, and SEI renewal controlled by reaction–pathway selectivity and mechanical coherence. Current density, stripping depth, pressure, temperature, sodium inventory, and cell architecture are treated as boundary conditions that determine whether local interfacial gains persist under practical operation. By linking coordination chemistry, metallic continuity, interphase renewal, and device‐level constraints, this review provides a mechanistic framework for predictive AFSMB design.

title_zh: 无负极钠金属电池界面重构的阶段耦合视角
summary_zh: 本综述提出无负极钠金属电池应被理解为动态重构的界面系统，通过三个耦合阶段审视：溶剂化控制的界面进入、集流体调控的Na重构、以及反应路径选择性和机械一致性控制的SEI再生。电流密度、剥离深度、压力、温度、钠库存和电池架构作为边界条件，决定局部界面增益能否在实际操作中持续。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于无负极钠金属电池（AFSMBs）中，由于去除过量金属负极，可逆性依赖于瞬态负极界面，每循环中Na在异质集流体上沉积并剥离至高度耗尽状态，电池失效由一系列短暂界面状态的连续性决定，包括体相配位、界面去溶剂化、异质成核、金属聚结、Na隔离和反复SEI再生。材料体系为无负极钠金属电池。设计策略是提出阶段耦合视角，将AFSMBs视为动态重构的界面系统，通过三个耦合阶段分析：溶剂化控制的界面进入、集流体调控的Na重构、以及SEI再生。研究过程将电流密度、剥离深度、压力、温度、钠库存和电池架构作为边界条件，考察它们如何决定局部界面增益在实际操作中的持续性。其意义在于通过连接配位化学、金属连续性、界面相再生和器件级约束，为预测性AFSMB设计提供机制框架。
methods_zh: 摘要未明确报告具体实验方法，这是一篇综述文章，主要通过文献综合和机制分析，提出阶段耦合框架审视AFSMBs的界面重构，涵盖溶剂化控制、集流体调控和SEI再生三个耦合阶段，并讨论边界条件的影响。
relevance_zh: 该综述与框架材料组装和电化学合成主线关联较弱，但涉及成核和配位化学，对理解电化学界面过程有参考价值。其阶段耦合框架为电池界面设计提供机制视角，但非直接涉及介孔导电MOF或共轭框架材料，作为拓展推荐，可根据需要选择性精读。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，综述中引用的具体实验数据、定量结果、机制证据和边界条件的具体数值均需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: AFSMBs应被理解为动态重构的界面系统，非均匀性在界面进入阶段引入后可通过后续沉积和剥离传播
电池失效由跨一系列短暂界面状态的连续性决定，包括体相配位、界面去溶剂化、异质成核、金属聚结、Na隔离和反复SEI再生
电流密度、剥离深度、压力、温度、钠库存和电池架构作为边界条件，决定局部界面增益能否在实际操作下持续

title: Advances in Aerogel Materials for Energy and Environmental Sustainability
abstract: ABSTRACT Aerogels have emerged as a unique class of ultralight porous materials that combine exceptional thermal insulation with low density, high porosity, and remarkable structural versatility, enabling broad opportunities across aerospace, energy, electronics, environmental remediation, and wearable technologies. However, their widespread adoption has been constrained by the high cost, limited scalability, and energy‐intensive nature of conventional manufacturing processes, particularly supercritical CO 2 drying. This review highlights recent advances in scalable and cost‐effective aerogel fabrication, including ambient‐pressure drying, templating strategies, top‐down manufacturing, chemical vapor deposition, and solution spinning, which collectively enable enhanced performance while significantly reducing production complexity and cost. We further present a unified perspective on the thermal transport physics of porous materials by systematically discussing the mechanisms of solid conduction, gas conduction, convection, and thermal radiation, and comparing aerogels with other porous architectures such as cellular foams. These fundamental insights establish rational design principles for engineering next‐generation aerogels with tailored thermal functionalities. Finally, we showcase emerging applications that extend well beyond thermal insulation, including moisture‐ and water‐driven energy harvesting, oil–water separation, high‐temperature acoustic insulation, and thermoregulating smart textiles. By bridging scalable manufacturing, fundamental thermal science, and emerging multifunctional applications, this work provides a comprehensive framework for the rational design and commercialization of next‐generation aerogels, paving the way toward their widespread adoption in advanced materials and engineering systems.

title_zh: 气凝胶材料在能源与环境可持续性方面的进展
summary_zh: 本文综述了气凝胶作为超轻多孔材料在隔热、能源和环境修复等领域的应用，重点介绍了环境压力干燥等可规模化低成本制造技术，并系统讨论了多孔材料的热输运物理机制，为下一代气凝胶的理性设计与商业化提供了综合框架。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于气凝胶虽具有优异隔热性能、低密度、高孔隙率和结构多样性，但其传统制造工艺（尤其是超临界CO2干燥）成本高、能耗大且难以规模化，限制了广泛应用。材料体系涵盖各类气凝胶及蜂窝泡沫等多孔结构。设计策略包括环境压力干燥、模板法、自上而下制造、化学气相沉积和溶液纺丝等可扩展且成本效益高的制备路线。研究过程系统梳理了固相传导、气相传导、对流和热辐射等热输运机制，并对比了气凝胶与其他多孔架构的差异，从而建立工程化设计原则。意义在于弥合可规模化制造、基础热科学与新兴多功能应用之间的鸿沟，为气凝胶在先进材料与工程系统中的商业化铺平道路。
methods_zh: 本文为综述性论文，概述了多种气凝胶制备方法，包括环境压力干燥、模板策略、自上而下制造、化学气相沉积和溶液纺丝。在表征与性能测试方面，摘要提及对热输运机制（固相传导、气相传导、对流、热辐射）的系统讨论，但未报告具体实验表征手段或性能测试数值。
relevance_zh: 该综述与本研究主线中多孔材料及模板组装技术相关，提供了气凝胶可规模化制造和热输运设计的宏观视角，但未涉及导电MOF或共轭框架材料。作为拓展推荐，可参考其模板策略和热管理设计思路，但若聚焦框架材料电化学合成，则精读价值有限。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。摘要未报告具体实验条件、表征数据、性能数值（如导热系数、孔隙率等）及制备工艺参数，这些细节需在全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 环境压力干燥、模板法、自上而下制造、化学气相沉积和溶液纺丝等策略可显著降低生产复杂性和成本，同时提升性能。
系统讨论了固相传导、气相传导、对流和热辐射机制，建立了多孔材料热输运的统一视角。
气凝胶应用已拓展至湿气/水驱动能量收集、油水分离、高温声学隔热和热调节智能纺织品等领域。

title: Tuning Polarization Fields in Zwitterionic Covalent Organic Frameworks for Efficient Photo‐Assisted Rechargeable Zinc–Air Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) with tunable topologies hold great promise for photoelectrochemical energy conversion. However, their inherently high structural symmetry and weak intramolecular polarization typically cause rapid charge recombination, thereby severely restricting their performance. Herein, we report two zwitterionic squaric acid (SQ)‐based COFs featuring a twisted three‐dimensional (3D) topology (SQ‐COF‐1) and a planar two‐dimensional (2D) topology (SQ‐COF‐2) to achieve efficient charge separation. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations demonstrate that the symmetry‐broken, 3D topology induces a larger dipole moment (3.367 vs. 1.916 debye) and a longer charge‐transfer distance (0.797 vs. 0.181 Å) compared with 2D topology, which indicates the superior charge separation capability. Photoelectrochemical measurements further reveal that the twisted 3D architecture effectively suppresses electron–hole recombination, endowing SQ‐COF‐1 with a prolonged carrier lifetime and enhanced photocurrent response compared to planar SQ‐COF‐2. Leveraging these advantages, we present the first application of SQ‐based zwitterionic COFs as photocathodes in photo‐assisted zinc–air batteries, where SQ‐COF‐1 delivers an ultralow charge–discharge voltage gap of 0.03 V and an exceptional energy efficiency of 97.7% in virtue of the accelerated photoelectrochemical reaction kinetics. This work establishes topological engineering as a straightforward strategy to tailor local polarization fields in zwitterionic COFs for high‐performance photoelectrochemical energy storage.

title_zh: 调控两性离子共价有机框架中的极化场以实现高效光辅助可充电锌空气电池
summary_zh: 本文报道了两种基于方酸的两性离子COF（SQ-COF-1三维扭曲拓扑和SQ-COF-2二维平面拓扑），通过拓扑工程打破结构对称性，增强分子偶极和电荷分离能力。DFT计算和光电化学测试表明三维扭曲结构抑制电子-空穴复合，延长载流子寿命。SQ-COF-1作为光阴极在光辅助锌空气电池中实现0.03 V超低充放电电压间隙和97.7%能量效率。
research_details_zh: 研究问题针对COF在光电化学能量转换中因高结构对称性和弱分子内极化导致快速电荷复合、性能受限的难题。材料体系为基于方酸的两性离子COF，包括具有扭曲三维拓扑的SQ-COF-1和平面二维拓扑的SQ-COF-2。设计策略是通过拓扑工程调控局部极化场，利用对称性破缺增强偶极矩和电荷转移距离。研究过程结合DFT计算和光电化学测量，揭示三维扭曲架构有效抑制电子-空穴复合，赋予SQ-COF-1更长的载流子寿命和增强的光电流响应。意义在于首次将SQ基两性离子COF用作光辅助锌空气电池的光阴极，展示拓扑工程作为调控两性离子COF局部极化场的直接策略，为高性能光电化学储能提供新途径。
methods_zh: 合成方法：通过方酸基构筑单元制备两种不同拓扑的COF（SQ-COF-1和SQ-COF-2）。表征与测试方法：DFT计算用于评估偶极矩和电荷转移距离；光电化学测量用于表征载流子寿命和光电流响应；电池性能测试用于评估充放电电压间隙和能量效率。摘要未报告具体合成条件、表征仪器或测试参数。
relevance_zh: 该工作与本研究主线中共轭COF的拓扑设计与光电性能调控高度相关，展示了拓扑工程在框架材料功能化中的核心价值。其两性离子策略和光辅助电池应用为框架材料的电化学能源应用提供了新思路，值得全文精读以获取合成细节和机制证据。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。摘要未报告COF合成的具体条件（溶剂、温度、催化剂）、结构表征数据（如PXRD、BET）、光电测试的具体参数及电池组装细节，这些关键信息需在全文核查。
key_findings_zh: DFT计算显示SQ-COF-1的偶极矩为3.367 debye，电荷转移距离为0.797 Å，均大于SQ-COF-2的1.916 debye和0.181 Å，表明三维扭曲拓扑具有更优的电荷分离能力。
光电化学测量表明三维扭曲架构有效抑制电子-空穴复合，SQ-COF-1具有更长的载流子寿命和增强的光电流响应。
SQ-COF-1作为光阴极在光辅助锌空气电池中实现0.03 V超低充放电电压间隙和97.7%的能量效率。

title: Regioisomerism‐Driven Microenvironment Modulation in Three‐Dimensional Covalent Organic Frameworks for Selective H 2 O 2 Photosynthesis
abstract: ABSTRACT Internal microenvironment within covalent organic frameworks (COFs) is essential for photocatalytic performance. Nevertheless, retaining the chemical composition of building blocks hinders precise control over internal charge distribution. Herein, a regioisomerism‐driven strategy was adopted to engineer the framework microenvironment by modulating the α/β‐connectivity of cyclooctatetrathiophene (COTh) cores. Two isostructural 3D COFs, JUC‐701 (symmetric) and JUC‐702 (asymmetric), were constructed via the condensation of specific COTh regioisomers with tetrathiafulvalene (TTF) nodes, yielding frameworks with identical chemical compositions and pts topologies. Experimental and theoretical investigations reveal that the asymmetric α/β‐linkage in JUC‐702 breaks the local structural symmetry, amplifying the intrinsic molecular dipole and charge polarization. This induces a robust built‐in electric field within the 3D channels, optimizing the local electronic structure for thermodynamically favorable two‐electron oxygen reduction reaction (2e − ORR). Moreover, the separation and interfacial transfer kinetics of photogenerated carriers was facilitated. Consequently, JUC‐702 achieves an exceptional H 2 O 2 production (6724 µmol g −1 h −1 ) in a sacrificial‐agent‐free pure water system, which is superior to other 3D COFs in such a system. This work highlights the pivotal role of positional isomerism in modulating the intrinsic properties of 3D COFs, offering a versatile blueprint for the precision engineering of local electrostatic landscapes.

title_zh: 区域异构驱动的三维共价有机框架微环境调控用于选择性H2O2光合作用
summary_zh: 本文采用区域异构策略，通过调控环辛四噻吩（COTh）核的α/β连接方式，构建了化学组成相同但结构对称性不同的两种三维COF（JUC-701对称和JUC-702不对称）。不对称α/β连接打破局部结构对称性，增强分子偶极和电荷极化，诱导内建电场，优化2e−ORR热力学。JUC-702在无牺牲剂纯水体系中实现6724 µmol g−1 h−1的H2O2产率。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于COF内部微环境对光催化性能至关重要，但保持构筑单元化学组成的同时难以精确控制内部电荷分布。材料体系为基于COTh区域异构体和四硫富瓦烯（TTF）节点缩合构建的两种同构三维COF（JUC-701和JUC-702），具有相同的化学组成和pts拓扑。设计策略是区域异构驱动，通过调节COTh核的α/β连接方式打破局部结构对称性。研究过程结合实验和理论计算，揭示不对称α/β连接放大固有分子偶极和电荷极化，在三维通道内诱导强内建电场，优化局部电子结构以利于热力学有利的2e−ORR，并促进光生载流子的分离和界面转移。意义在于突出位置异构在调控三维COF本征性质中的关键作用，为局部静电景观的精确工程提供通用蓝图。
methods_zh: 合成方法：通过特定COTh区域异构体与TTF节点缩合构建JUC-701和JUC-702。表征与测试方法：实验和理论计算结合，包括DFT计算用于分析电子结构和电荷极化；光催化性能测试用于评估H2O2产率。摘要未报告具体合成条件、结构表征手段（如PXRD、BET）或光催化测试的详细参数。
relevance_zh: 该工作与本研究主线中共轭COF的微环境调控和光催化能源转化高度相关，展示了区域异构策略在框架材料电荷分布精确调控中的创新价值。其无牺牲剂纯水体系的高效H2O2产率具有重要应用前景，值得全文精读以获取合成细节和机制验证。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读。摘要未报告COF合成的具体条件、结构表征数据（如比表面积、孔径分布）、光催化测试的光源波长和强度、H2O2定量方法等关键细节，需在全文核查。
key_findings_zh: JUC-702中不对称α/β连接打破局部结构对称性，放大分子偶极和电荷极化，诱导三维通道内的强内建电场。
JUC-702在无牺牲剂纯水体系中实现6724 µmol g−1 h−1的H2O2产率，优于其他三维COF在该体系中的表现。
不对称结构优化了局部电子结构，使2e−ORR热力学更有利，并促进光生载流子的分离和界面转移。

title: Hierarchically Porous MOF Shell Nanoengineered on Magnetic Cores as a Nanoplatform Towards Serum Glycopeptide Decoding
abstract: ABSTRACT Hierarchically porous metal‐organic frameworks (MOFs) offer promising potential for nano‐separation, yet the controlled epitaxial growth of an ordered hierarchical porous MOF shell on heterogeneous cores remains challenging due to template disruption by heterogeneous surfaces. Herein, we report a microemulsion‐mediated in situ growth strategy to construct a magnetic core–shell structure with a well‐ordered hierarchically porous MOF shell (denoted as FeM@PMOFs). Mercaptoacetic acid (MAA) serves as a molecular bridge to anchor Ce 3 + /Ce 4 + onto Fe 3 O 4 surfaces, while a P123/mesitylene soft‐template system guides the formation of hierarchical porosity. FeM@PMOFs exhibit uniform morphology, a shell thickness of about 46 nm, and hierarchical pore sizes (9–68 nm meso/macropores together with 1.58 nm micropores). Leveraging hierarchically porous, excellent hydrophilicity owing to the MOF shells, and rapid magnetic separation, FeM@PMOFs enable selective and sensitive enrichment of N‐glycopeptides with an exceptionally low detection limit of 1 amol µL −1 . When applied to human serum samples from healthy controls and patients with prostate, bladder, and renal cancers, the platform identified 324 unique N‐glycopeptides and revealed 20 candidate glycopeptide signatures distinguishing different urological malignancies. This work provides a generalizable synthetic strategy for ordered magnetic hierarchical MOF core‐shell structures and establishes a versatile nanoplatform for deep glycomics analysis in complex biological fluids.

title_zh: 磁性核上纳米工程化的分级多孔MOF壳层作为血清糖肽解码的纳米平台
summary_zh: 本研究通过微乳液介导的原位生长策略，在磁性Fe3O4核上构建了有序分级多孔MOF壳层（FeM@PMOFs），实现N-糖肽的高选择性富集，检测限低至1 amol µL⁻¹，并在多种泌尿系统癌症血清中鉴定出324种独特N-糖肽和20种候选糖肽标志物。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于在异质核上可控外延生长有序分级多孔MOF壳层的挑战，传统方法常因异质表面干扰模板而失败。材料体系为磁性Fe3O4核与分级多孔MOF壳层组成的核壳结构。设计策略采用微乳液介导的原位生长：巯基乙酸作为分子桥将Ce³⁺/Ce⁴⁺锚定在Fe3O4表面，P123/均三甲苯软模板系统引导分级孔的形成。研究过程包括合成FeM@PMOFs、表征其形貌与孔结构，并评估其在N-糖肽富集中的性能。该平台结合分级多孔性、MOF壳层的高亲水性和快速磁分离能力，实现对复杂生物流体中糖肽的深度分析，为构建磁性有序分级MOF核壳结构提供了通用策略，意义在于推动糖组学分析在疾病诊断中的应用。
methods_zh: 摘要明确提及采用微乳液介导的原位生长策略合成磁性核壳结构；使用巯基乙酸作为分子桥锚定Ce³⁺/Ce⁴⁺，P123/均三甲苯软模板系统引导分级孔形成。表征方法包括形貌观察和孔结构分析（孔径分布）。性能测试涉及N-糖肽富集的选择性和灵敏度评估，以及人血清样本的应用分析。
relevance_zh: 该工作直接契合介孔导电MOF和框架材料组装的研究主线，展示了分级多孔MOF壳层在磁性核上的可控构建，为介孔MOF的异质外延生长提供了新策略。其高灵敏度糖肽富集性能凸显了介孔结构在生物分离中的价值。局限性在于摘要未报告电化学性能或导电性，且未涉及MOF的导电功能。值得全文精读以获取合成细节和孔结构调控机制。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，关键细节如微乳液具体组成、合成条件、孔结构精确表征数据、糖肽富集实验流程及统计方法等仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: FeM@PMOFs具有均匀形貌，壳层厚度约46 nm，分级孔径为9–68 nm介孔/大孔及1.58 nm微孔。
对N-糖肽的检测限极低，为1 amol µL⁻¹。
在健康对照及前列腺癌、膀胱癌、肾癌患者血清中鉴定出324种独特N-糖肽，并揭示20种候选糖肽特征可区分不同泌尿系统恶性肿瘤。

title: Electron-Rich Azo Sites on Ordered Mesoporous Covalent Organic Frameworks Boosting Redox Kinetics in Aqueous Zn-I2 Batteries
abstract: Abstract The practical application of aqueous zinc–iodine (Zn-I2) batteries is frequently hindered by the notorious shuttle effect of polyiodides and sluggish redox kinetics. To overcome these challenges, two isostructural mesoporous covalent organic frameworks (COFs) were synthesized via the condensation of 1,3,5-triformylphloroglucinol (TP) with either 4,4′-azodianiline (AZO) or benzidine (BD), yielding AZO-TP-COF and BD-TP-COF, respectively. When employed as cathode hosts in Zn-I2 batteries, the AZO-TP-COF@I2 composite delivered a specific capacity of about 228 mAh g–1 at 0.2 A g–1, along with remarkable rate capability and long-term cycling stability (95% capacity retention after 3000 cycles at 3 A g–1), better than those of BD-TP-COF@I2. This enhanced performance of the AZO-TP-COF@I2 cathode is attributed to the electron-rich azo moieties in AZO-TP-COF, which effectively suppress the polyiodide shuttle effect and facilitate the adsorption and conversion of I–/I2/I3– species. These findings highlight the pivotal role of azo-based engineering in COFs for regulating redox mediators in metal-halogen batteries.

title_zh: 有序介孔共价有机框架上的富电子偶氮位点增强水系Zn-I2电池的氧化还原动力学
summary_zh: 本研究合成了两种同构介孔COF（AZO-TP-COF和BD-TP-COF）作为Zn-I2电池正极宿主，其中AZO-TP-COF@I2在0.2 A g⁻¹下提供约228 mAh g⁻¹比容量，并在3 A g⁻¹下经3000次循环保持95%容量，归因于富电子偶氮基团抑制多碘化物穿梭效应。
research_details_zh: 研究问题针对水系Zn-I2电池中多碘化物穿梭效应和缓慢氧化还原动力学的问题。材料体系为两种同构介孔COF，通过1,3,5-三甲酰基间苯三酚（TP）与4,4'-偶氮二苯胺（AZO）或联苯胺（BD）缩合合成，分别得到AZO-TP-COF和BD-TP-COF。设计策略是利用AZO中的富电子偶氮位点增强对碘物种的吸附和转化。研究过程包括合成两种COF、制备I₂复合物、组装电池并测试电化学性能。AZO-TP-COF@I2性能优于BD-TP-COF@I2，表明偶氮基团在调节氧化还原介体中的关键作用。意义在于为金属-卤素电池中COF的官能团工程提供设计原则，推动高性能水系电池发展。
methods_zh: 摘要明确提及通过1,3,5-三甲酰基间苯三酚与4,4'-偶氮二苯胺或联苯胺的缩合反应合成两种介孔COF。电化学测试包括在Zn-I2电池中作为正极宿主的性能评估，具体涉及比容量、倍率能力和循环稳定性测试。未报告其他表征方法。
relevance_zh: 该研究直接关联介孔COF的合成与电化学应用，展示了介孔结构结合官能团工程在能源存储中的潜力，对框架材料的功能化设计有重要参考价值。局限性在于摘要未报告COF的孔结构参数或导电性数据，且未涉及自组装或电化学合成方法。值得全文精读以获取详细的合成与电化学表征信息。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，关键细节如COF的孔径分布、比表面积、I₂负载量、电解液组成、电化学测试条件及机理验证实验等仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: AZO-TP-COF@I2在0.2 A g⁻¹下比容量约228 mAh g⁻¹。
AZO-TP-COF@I2在3 A g⁻¹下经3000次循环后容量保持率为95%。
AZO-TP-COF@I2的倍率性能和循环稳定性优于BD-TP-COF@I2，归因于富电子偶氮基团抑制多碘化物穿梭并促进I⁻/I₂/I₃⁻物种的吸附和转化。

title: Assembly‐Regulated Interfacial Polymerization for Janus Polyamide Membranes With Programmable Ion‐Transport Properties
abstract: ABSTRACT Conventional interfacial polymerization is typically governed by rapid and disordered monomer diffusion, which limits precise regulation over through‐thickness structure and electrostatic distribution in polyamide nanofiltration membranes. Here, a reaction‐induced interfacial self‐assembly strategy is developed to regulate membrane growth dynamics and construct Janus polyamide membranes with directional ion‐transport behavior. By introducing 1,14‐dibromotetradecane into the piperazine/trimesoyl chloride interfacial polymerization system, amphiphilic quaternized intermediates are preferentially generated at the water/oil interface and reorganize the local reaction environment prior to continuous polyamide formation. This process transforms conventional diffusion‐dominated interfacial polymerization into an assembly‐regulated growth pathway, resulting in a selective layer with asymmetric through‐thickness chemistry, compact sub‐nanometer transport channels, and positively enriched bottom domains. The resulting membrane exhibits synergistic size‐sieving and localized Donnan exclusion effects for Mg 2+ /Li + separation, achieving a separation factor of 333.7 at a Mg 2+ /Li + mass ratio of 80 together with stable operation over 310 h. Molecular simulations further reveal that the asymmetric electrostatic architecture imposes substantially higher transmembrane free‐energy barriers for Mg 2+ than for Li + , thereby governing directional ion transport. This work demonstrates that transport functionality can be directly encoded during membrane formation through reaction‐field regulation, providing a feasible strategy for constructing asymmetric polyamide membranes with programmable ion‐transport properties.

title_zh: 组装调控的界面聚合用于具有可编程离子传输性能的Janus聚酰胺膜
summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种反应诱导的界面自组装策略，通过引入1,14-二溴十四烷调控哌嗪/均苯三甲酰氯的界面聚合，构建具有不对称化学和正电荷富集底层的Janus聚酰胺膜，在Mg²⁺/Li⁺分离中实现333.7的分离因子和310小时稳定运行。
research_details_zh: 研究问题针对传统界面聚合中单体扩散快速无序导致聚酰胺纳滤膜厚度方向和静电分布难以精确调控的局限。材料体系为Janus聚酰胺膜，通过哌嗪和均苯三甲酰氯的界面聚合制备。设计策略是引入1,14-二溴十四烷，在油水界面优先生成两亲性季铵化中间体，重组局部反应环境，将扩散主导的聚合转变为组装调控的生长路径。研究过程包括膜合成、结构表征、离子传输性能测试及分子模拟。所得选择性层具有不对称厚度方向化学、紧凑亚纳米传输通道和正电荷富集底层，实现尺寸筛分和局部Donnan排斥的协同效应。意义在于展示通过反应场调控直接在膜形成过程中编码传输功能，为构建可编程离子传输的不对称聚酰胺膜提供可行策略。
methods_zh: 摘要明确提及采用反应诱导的界面自组装策略，在哌嗪/均苯三甲酰氯界面聚合体系中引入1,14-二溴十四烷。表征涉及选择性层的不对称厚度方向化学和亚纳米通道结构。性能测试包括Mg²⁺/Li⁺分离因子和长期稳定性评估。分子模拟用于揭示离子传输机制。
relevance_zh: 该研究涉及自组装技术调控界面聚合，与框架材料组装的研究主线相关，展示了组装调控对膜传输性能的直接影响。其价值在于提供了一种通过反应场调节实现不对称膜结构的新方法。局限性在于材料体系为聚酰胺膜而非框架材料，且摘要未报告孔结构或框架特性。可作为拓展阅读，但非核心主线，是否精读取决于对膜分离技术的兴趣。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，关键细节如膜厚度、孔径分布、表面电荷密度、具体合成条件、分离实验参数及模拟方法等仍需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 所得Janus聚酰胺膜在Mg²⁺/Li⁺质量比为80时实现333.7的分离因子。
膜在操作中稳定运行超过310小时。
分子模拟揭示不对称静电结构对Mg²⁺施加比Li⁺更高的跨膜自由能垒，从而控制定向离子传输。

title: Floating Synthesis of Porous Coordination Crystals With Absorption Capability Reinforcement
abstract: ABSTRACT ZIF‐67 was containerlessly synthesized via acoustic levitation for superior absorption performance. The acoustic streaming accelerated the solute diffusion, and the acoustic cavitation effectively promoted the coordination of Co 2+ and pyridine N in the synthesis. This speeded up the nucleation and growth of ZIF‐67 nanoparticles, refined the particles and improved the dispersion. The smaller particle and the larger Zeta potential improved the adsorption performance of ZIF‐67 synthesized in the acoustically levitated aqueous‐phase droplet for methyl orange. Accordingly, the adsorption rate and saturated adsorption capacity of ZIF‐67 synthesized in water solution were increased by 3.5 times and 25.8% respectively, compared with ordinary condition. Besides, the Co@CNTs prepared by ZIF‐67 from acoustic levitation synthesis exhibited a 16 dB decrease in reflection loss and a 0.6 GHz increase in effective bandwidth, which is ascribed to the enhanced coordination of Co 2+ and pyridine N, which contributed to the stronger catalytic effect on the carbon source, thus improving the electromagnetic wave absorption intensity owing to the enhanced diploe polarization loss. Besides, the increase in Co 2+ amount produced more lattice defects, consequently enhancing the interfacial polarization loss. This synthetic strategy provides a pathway for developing porous nanometal materials by manipulating coordination to enhance their electromagnetic absorption ability for practical applications.

title_zh: 声悬浮无容器合成多孔配位晶体及其吸收性能增强
summary_zh: 本研究通过声悬浮无容器法合成ZIF-67多孔配位晶体，利用声流和声空化加速溶质扩散并促进Co²⁺与吡啶N配位，细化颗粒并改善分散性，显著提升对甲基橙的吸附性能及衍生Co@CNTs的电磁波吸收能力。
research_details_zh: 研究问题聚焦于如何通过绿色无容器合成策略提升多孔配位晶体的吸附和电磁波吸收性能。材料体系为ZIF-67（沸石咪唑酯骨架）及其衍生的Co@CNTs复合材料。设计策略是采用声悬浮技术使水滴在无容器条件下合成ZIF-67，利用声流加速溶质扩散、声空化促进Co²⁺与吡啶N的配位，从而加速成核与生长，细化纳米颗粒并改善分散性。研究过程包括声悬浮液滴合成、吸附性能测试（以甲基橙为模型污染物）以及将ZIF-67热解制备Co@CNTs并测试电磁波吸收性能。该研究的意义在于提供了一种通过调控配位作用来增强多孔纳米金属材料电磁波吸收能力的实用合成路径。
methods_zh: 摘要明确提到采用声悬浮技术进行无容器合成ZIF-67，利用声流和声空化效应。性能测试包括甲基橙吸附实验（测定吸附速率和饱和吸附容量）以及电磁波吸收性能测试（测定反射损耗和有效带宽）。未报告其他具体表征手段。
relevance_zh: 该研究属于介孔/多孔配位晶体的非常规合成方法，与自组装和框架材料电化学合成主线相关，展示了声悬浮技术对成核过程的调控潜力。但摘要未报告孔径分布、比表面积等关键结构数据，且电磁波吸收机制解释较简略，建议精读全文以评估其方法普适性和结构-性能定量关系。
evidence_note_zh: 这是摘要级解读，仅依据摘要内容。颗粒尺寸、Zeta电位具体数值、孔径分布、比表面积、热解条件、电磁波吸收测试频率范围等关键细节摘要未报告，需全文核查。
key_findings_zh: 声悬浮合成ZIF-67的吸附速率和饱和吸附容量分别比普通条件提高3.5倍和25.8%。
由声悬浮合成ZIF-67制备的Co@CNTs反射损耗降低16 dB，有效带宽增加0.6 GHz。
Co²⁺与吡啶N配位增强导致对碳源催化作用更强，增强偶极极化损耗；Co²⁺含量增加产生更多晶格缺陷，增强界面极化损耗。

title: Tuning Ion Transport Kinetics and Interfacial Stability via a Co‐Containing Covalent Organic Framework for Stable Lithium Metal Batteries
abstract: ABSTRACT Lithium metal batteries (LMBs) are severely limited by nonuniform lithium deposition and unstable interfacial reactions, which lead to poor cycling stability and safety concerns. Regulating ion transport behavior and interfacial stability plays a decisive role in achieving stable LMBs. However, simultaneously optimizing these two aspects remains a considerable challenge. Herein, a Co‐containing covalent organic framework (Co‐COF) was developed as a multifunctional separator modifier to address these challenges. Benefiting from the ordered porous structure and lithiophilic oxygen‐containing groups, the Co‐COF@polypropylene (PP) separator homogenizes Li + flux and facilitates Li + desolvation, thereby accelerating interfacial ion transport kinetics. Meanwhile, the Co active sites moderately anchor PF 6 − anions, increasing the Li + transference number and promoting the formation of a stable LiF‐rich solid electrolyte interphase with enhanced interfacial stability. As a result, the Co‐COF@PP separator enables uniform lithium deposition, suppresses lithium dendrite growth, and improves the stability of lithium metal anodes. Consequently, Li||Li symmetric cells achieve stable lithium plating/stripping behavior for over 700 h. Furthermore, LiFePO 4 ||Li cells assembled with the Co‐COF@PP separator exhibit superior rate capability and maintain 90.1% capacity retention after 450 cycles at 1 C, significantly outperforming cells with pristine PP separators. This work provides an effective strategy for stable LMBs.
